source_text: Saat check-in, ikuti aturan properti untuk informasi identitas dan data menginap. Pastikan orang yang menerima kunci berhak atas kamar. Jangan menyebut nomor kamar keras-keras atau memperlihatkan data pada layar. Dokumen dan data tamu hanya digunakan untuk tujuan kerja yang diizinkan.
english_text: At check-in, follow the property's rules for identity and stay information. Make sure the person receiving a key is authorized for the room. Do not say room numbers aloud or expose information on a screen. Use guest documents and data only for authorized work purposes.

english_text: Politely ask for identification, match the name to the reservation, explain the form, and make sure the key goes to the right person. If the identity, party size, or payment status does not match, do not issue the key; ask a senior staff member for help and store documents in the designated place.

english_text: Food allergies can cause severe reactions. Listen to the ingredients named by the guest and record them accurately. Do not assume a dish is safe because an ingredient is not visible; mixed ingredients and cross-contact are possible. The kitchen or person in charge must check the recipe and preparation method according to property policy.

english_text: Hands, equipment, and surfaces can transfer dirt or allergens. Follow handwashing schedules, use gloves when required, and keep clean equipment separate from used equipment. Do not serve food that has fallen, touched cleaning fluid, or was not kept according to procedure.

source_text: Produksi tanaman dimulai dari jenis komoditas, varietas, musim, petak, dan tujuan pasar. Kalender budidaya menghubungkan pembibitan, penanaman, pemeliharaan, panen, serta pengiriman. Petak yang tampak sama dapat memiliki perlakuan dan masa tunggu berbeda. Identitas petak mencegah salah panen atau salah aplikasi bahan. Periksa versi rencana yang berlaku dan jangan mengganti varietas hanya karena benih tersedia. Catatan kegiatan harus dapat ditelusuri ke petak serta tanggal sebenarnya.
english_text: Crop production planning starts with the crop, variety, season, plot, and market destination. The cultivation calendar links seedling production, planting, maintenance, harvest, and shipping. Plots that look alike may require different treatments and waiting periods. Plot identification helps prevent harvesting or applying materials in the wrong place. Check the current plan and do not change varieties just because seeds are available. Activity records must be traceable to the plot and actual date.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Dua petak sayur memiliki jadwal panen berbeda tetapi label salah satunya hilang. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: konfirmasikan identitas petak sebelum bekerja. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Baca rencana dan kode petak; Cocokkan varietas dan jadwal; Kerjakan tugas yang disetujui; Catat petak dan tanggal. Catat kondisi sebelum dan sesudah tindakan, lokasi atau kelompok yang terdampak, waktu pengamatan, serta siapa yang diberi laporan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. Angka target, dosis produk, setelan alat, dan batas cuaca mengikuti instruksi lokasi, label, serta jenis tanaman atau hewan; contoh belajar bukan angka universal.
english_text: Consider this work situation: Two vegetable plots have different harvest schedules, but one plot's label is missing. Recommended action: confirm the plot's identity before starting work. Follow the sequence: Read the plan and plot code; match the variety and schedule; perform the approved task; record the plot and date. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the crop or animal; learning examples are not universal values.

source_text: Akar menyerap air serta unsur hara dan memerlukan kondisi tanah yang mendukung pertukaran udara. Daun menggunakan cahaya untuk fotosintesis, tetapi kebutuhan cahaya, suhu, dan air berbeda menurut komoditas serta fase pertumbuhan. Layu tidak selalu berarti kekurangan air; akar rusak atau tanah terlalu basah juga dapat mengganggu penyerapan. Amati tanaman bersama lingkungannya sebelum mengubah irigasi atau pupuk. Bedakan gejala yang terlihat dari dugaan penyebabnya.
english_text: Roots absorb water and nutrients and need soil conditions that allow air exchange. Leaves use light for photosynthesis, but light, temperature, and water needs vary by crop and growth stage. Wilting does not always mean a lack of water; damaged roots or waterlogged soil can also interfere with absorption. Observe the plant and its environment before changing irrigation or fertilizer. Distinguish visible symptoms from suspected causes.

source_text: Tanah mengandung partikel mineral, bahan organik, air, serta udara. Tekstur dan struktur memengaruhi retensi air, drainase, dan kemudahan akar berkembang. pH menggambarkan keasaman, bukan jumlah semua unsur hara. Kebutuhan pH berbeda menurut tanaman. Sampel dari satu titik dekat tumpukan pupuk tidak mewakili seluruh petak. Gunakan pola pengambilan dan kedalaman yang ditentukan, alat bersih, label jelas, serta metode ukur yang sesuai. Koreksi tanah mengikuti hasil penilaian dan rencana.
english_text: Soil contains mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air. Its texture and structure affect water retention, drainage, and root development. pH indicates acidity, not the amount of all nutrients. Crops have different pH requirements. A sample taken at one point near a fertilizer pile does not represent the whole plot. Use the specified sampling pattern and depth, clean tools, clear labels, and an appropriate measurement method. Amend the soil according to the assessment and plan.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Sampel hanya diambil tepat di samping tumpukan pupuk. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: ulangi pengambilan sesuai pola representatif. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Tentukan area dan metode sampel; Ambil sampel representatif dengan alat bersih; Labeli lokasi dan kedalaman; Gunakan hasil untuk arahan perbaikan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the crop or animal; learning examples are not universal values.

source_text: Pengolahan tanah menyiapkan zona akar dan kondisi penanaman. Tanah terlalu basah dapat memadat bila dilalui mesin, sedangkan bedengan dan saluran harus disesuaikan lahan serta komoditas. Drainase mengalirkan kelebihan air melalui jalur yang diizinkan; jangan membuang air tercemar ke saluran umum. Periksa batu, utilitas, dan orang di sekitar sebelum alat digunakan. Mesin hanya dioperasikan petugas terlatih dengan pengaman utuh. Penyumbatan dibersihkan setelah sumber energi diisolasi sesuai prosedur.
english_text: Soil preparation creates suitable root-zone and planting conditions. Machinery can compact overly wet soil, while raised beds and channels must suit the land and crop. Drainage carries excess water through approved routes; do not discharge contaminated water into public drains. Check for rocks, utilities, and people nearby before using equipment. Only trained staff may operate machinery with intact guards. Clear blockages only after isolating energy sources according to procedure.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Tanah masih jenuh air tetapi alat berat dijadwalkan masuk. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: konfirmasikan penundaan atau metode aman sebelum masuk. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Periksa kondisi tanah dan jalur air; Tentukan bedengan sesuai rencana; Gunakan alat secara aman; Periksa aliran dan catat genangan. Catat kondisi sebelum dan sesudah tindakan, lokasi atau kelompok yang terdampak, waktu pengamatan, serta siapa yang diberi laporan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. Angka target, dosis produk, setelan alat, dan batas cuaca mengikuti instruksi lokasi, label, serta jenis tanaman atau hewan; contoh belajar bukan angka universal.

Follow the sequence: Check the soil and drainage routes; set raised beds according to the plan; use equipment safely; check water flow and record pooling. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the crop or animal; learning examples are not universal values.

source_text: Nitrogen, fosfor, dan kalium merupakan unsur utama pada banyak label pupuk, tetapi kebutuhan tanaman tidak ditentukan oleh tiga unsur saja. english_text: Nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium are major nutrients listed on many fertilizer labels, but crop needs are not determined by these three alone. Apply fertilizer according to soil analysis, crop, growth stage, and application history. Yellow leaves alone do not confirm a nitrogen deficiency. Excess fertilizer can damage roots, increase nutrient loss to the environment, and lower crop quality. english_text: Watering should match crop needs, growing medium, weather, and growth stage. A fixed schedule without checks can lead to under- or overwatering. source_text: Rumah tanam membantu mengendalikan lingkungan, tetapi suhu dan kelembapan dapat berubah cepat. Sensor perlu ditempatkan serta diperiksa menurut prosedur agar tidak memberi pembacaan menyesatkan. Ventilasi, naungan, dan penyiraman tidak boleh diubah tanpa melihat kebutuhan komoditas dan keamanan pekerja. Panas memengaruhi tanaman sekaligus tubuh pekerja. Kenali gejala gangguan panas, jadwal istirahat, akses minum, serta cara meminta bantuan. Jangan menutup rumah tanam dengan pekerja masih terpapar bahan atau panas.
english_text: A greenhouse helps control the environment, but temperature and humidity can change quickly. Place and check sensors according to procedure to avoid misleading readings. Do not change ventilation, shade, or watering without considering crop needs and worker safety. Heat affects both plants and workers. Know the signs of heat illness, rest schedules, access to drinking water, and how to request help. Do not close a greenhouse while workers remain exposed to chemicals or heat.

source_text: Pindah tanam menghubungkan bibit dengan lokasi produksi. Pastikan bibit layak, petak sesuai, jarak dan kedalaman menurut komoditas, serta kondisi air dan cuaca memungkinkan. Mengangkat bibit dengan menarik batang dapat merusak akar atau jaringan. Penanganan gumpalan akar mengikuti jenis bibit dan wadah. Jangan memadatkan atau menanam terlalu dalam secara sembarangan. Periksa tanaman setelah penanaman untuk mendeteksi stres dan ketidaksesuaian posisi.
english_text: Transplanting moves seedlings to the production plot. Confirm that seedlings are suitable, the plot is correct, spacing and depth match the crop, and water and weather conditions allow planting. Pulling a seedling by its stem can damage roots or tissue. Handle the root ball according to the seedling and container type. Do not compact the soil or plant too deeply without cause. Check plants after transplanting for stress and incorrect positioning.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Bibit tertahan di tray dan rekan menarik batangnya kuat-kuat. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: gunakan cara pelepasan wadah yang sesuai agar akar terlindungi. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Periksa bibit petak dan jarak rencana; Lepaskan bibit tanpa merusak akar; Tanam sesuai kedalaman dan kebutuhan air; Periksa posisi serta catat jumlah. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. english_text: Consider this work situation: A seedling is stuck in its tray and a colleague is pulling hard on its stem. Recommended action: use an appropriate method to release it from the container and protect the roots. Follow the sequence: Check the seedling, plot, and planned spacing; release the seedling without damaging roots; plant at the correct depth and water requirement; check its position and record the number planted. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the crop or animal; learning examples are not universal values.

source_text: Pemangkasan, pemilihan tunas, pengikatan, dan penyerbukan berbeda menurut tanaman serta tujuan produksi. Memotong semua tunas atau bunga dapat mengurangi hasil. Alat bersih dan tajam sesuai tugas mengurangi kerusakan; luka dan getah dapat memindahkan masalah jika alat dipakai lintas tanaman tanpa prosedur. Ikatan penopang tidak boleh mencekik batang. Penyerbukan membutuhkan fase bunga dan kondisi yang tepat; periksa instruksi sebelum mengambil tindakan.
english_text: Pruning, shoot selection, tying, and pollination vary by crop and production goals. Removing all shoots or flowers can reduce yield. Clean, sharp tools suited to the task reduce damage; wounds and sap can spread problems if tools are used between plants without the required procedure. Plant ties must not constrict stems. Pollination requires the right flowering stage and conditions; check instructions before acting.

source_text: Pengendalian dimulai dari pengamatan jenis organisme, kerusakan, luas kejadian, cuaca, dan riwayat petak. Tidak semua serangga adalah hama; sebagian bermanfaat. Gulma bersaing dengan tanaman tetapi metode pengendalian harus cocok dengan sistem budidaya. Pencegahan, sanitasi, pengelolaan lingkungan, dan metode nonkimia dapat menjadi bagian pengendalian terpadu. Identifikasi yang belum pasti perlu dikonfirmasi. Menyemprot semua petak tanpa menilai risiko dapat merugikan hasil dan lingkungan.
english_text: Control starts by observing the organism, damage, affected area, weather, and plot history. Not all insects are pests; some are beneficial. Weeds compete with crops, but control methods must suit the cultivation system. Prevention, sanitation, environmental management, and nonchemical methods can all be part of integrated pest management. Confirm uncertain identifications. Spraying every plot without assessing risk can harm crops and the environment.

source_text: Produk pestisida digunakan hanya untuk penggunaan yang diizinkan dengan tanaman, sasaran, dosis, frekuensi, masa tunggu sebelum panen, dan persyaratan keselamatan pada label. APD, cuaca, arah angin, akses orang, dan pencegahan hanyutan perlu diperiksa. Penggunaan berlebih tidak berarti lebih efektif. Catat produk, lot, petak, jumlah, tanggal, serta operator. Jangan menyalin dosis dari tanaman lain atau mencampur produk tanpa izin. Masa tunggu harus dikonfirmasi sebelum hasil dipanen.
english_text: Use pesticides only for approved purposes and crops, targets, rates, frequencies, preharvest intervals, and safety requirements stated on the label. Check personal protective equipment, weather, wind direction, people's access, and drift prevention. Using more does not make a pesticide more effective. Record the product, lot, plot, amount, date, and operator. Do not copy a rate from another crop or mix products without authorization. Confirm the waiting period before harvesting.

source_text: Mesin pertanian memiliki bagian berputar, bilah, titik jepit, dan energi tersimpan. Pengaman tidak dilepas demi mempercepat tugas. Pemeriksaan dilakukan sesuai manual dan pelatihan; operator tidak boleh membawa penumpang bila alat tidak dirancang untuk itu. Sebelum membersihkan sumbatan atau mengganti aksesori, hentikan, isolasi energi, dan pastikan kondisi aman sesuai prosedur. Bahan bakar, lereng, jalan umum, serta jarak orang sekitar juga perlu dinilai sebelum operasi.
english_text: Farm machinery has rotating parts, blades, pinch points, and stored energy. Never remove guards to speed up a task. Inspect equipment according to its manual and your training; do not carry passengers unless the equipment is designed for them. Before clearing a blockage or changing an attachment, stop the machine, isolate its energy, and confirm it is safe according to procedure. Assess fuel, slopes, public roads, and the distance of nearby people before operating.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. source_text: Padi memiliki tahapan dari persiapan benih dan bibit, penanaman, pemeliharaan, pembentukan malai, hingga panen. Kebutuhan penggenangan atau pengeringan mengikuti fase, tanah, dan rencana setempat; kedalaman air tidak berlaku sama sepanjang musim. Periksa pematang, saluran, gulma, serta distribusi air tanpa merusak lahan tetangga. Catatan pertumbuhan dan anakan membantu pengamatan. Mesin tanam dan panen memerlukan pelatihan khusus, terutama dekat saluran atau tanah lunak.
english_text: Rice cultivation includes seed and seedling preparation, planting, maintenance, panicle development, and harvest. Flooding or drainage needs depend on the growth stage, soil, and local plan; water depth is not the same throughout the season. Check levees, channels, weeds, and water distribution without damaging neighboring fields. Growth and tiller records support monitoring. Planting and harvesting machinery require special training, particularly near channels or soft soil.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. english_text: Fruit crops require monitoring of buds, flowers, and fruit, as well as balanced growth according to species and season. source_text: Penyimpanan memperlambat penurunan mutu, tetapi suhu dan kelembapan sesuai tidak sama untuk semua hasil. Beberapa komoditas sensitif terhadap suhu terlalu rendah atau gas dari produk lain. Jangan menebak satu suhu universal. Hindari kondensasi, tekanan tumpukan, hama gudang, serta pencampuran bahan kimia dengan pangan. Catat penerimaan, kondisi ruang, lot, dan pengeluaran. Bila rantai kondisi terputus, pisahkan dan laporkan sebelum pengiriman agar keputusan berdasarkan data.
english_text: Storage slows quality loss, but suitable temperature and humidity vary by produce. Some crops are sensitive to very low temperatures or gases from other products. Do not guess a universal temperature. Prevent condensation, excessive stacking pressure, storage pests, and contact between chemicals and food. Record receiving, room conditions, lots, and dispatch. If storage conditions are interrupted, separate and report the affected produce before shipping so decisions are based on data.

english_text: Cattle, pigs, and poultry have different behaviors, needs, and handling risks. Workers should understand movement routes, how animals respond to sounds or motion, and safe positions. Do not stand between an animal and a fence, hit an animal to make it move faster, or approach without an exit route. Individual or group identification connects feed, health, and production records. Move animals using approved methods and enough workers for the risk; do not improvise.

source_text: Biosekuriti mencegah masuk dan menyebarnya agen penyakit melalui hewan, orang, alat, kendaraan, pakan, atau satwa liar. Batas zona, pakaian kerja, alas kaki, pembersihan, serta pencatatan pengunjung mengikuti fasilitas. Disinfektan tidak efektif hanya karena baunya kuat; permukaan kotor dan kondisi penggunaan memengaruhi hasil. Jangan melompati prosedur masuk karena kunjungan singkat. Peralatan tidak dipindahkan antar-kelompok tanpa pengolahan yang ditetapkan, terutama setelah kontak dengan hewan sakit.
english_text: Biosecurity prevents disease agents from entering or spreading through animals, people, tools, vehicles, feed, or wildlife. Zone boundaries, work clothing, footwear, cleaning, and visitor records depend on the facility. A strong-smelling disinfectant is not necessarily effective; dirty surfaces and conditions of use affect results. Do not skip entry procedures for a short visit. Do not move equipment between groups without the required treatment, especially after contact with sick animals.

english_text: Feed meets the needs of animals based on species, age, production stage, and health. Do not mix moldy, wet, or incorrectly identified feed into a ration to use up stock. english_text: Animal bedding supports comfort, cleanliness, and moisture control according to the housing system. source_text: Reproduksi melibatkan siklus, perkawinan atau inseminasi, kebuntingan, dan kelahiran yang berbeda menurut jenis hewan. english_text: Reproduction involves cycles, mating or insemination, pregnancy, and birth, which vary by animal type. Workers observe signs within their training and record dates and identification; appearance alone cannot confirm pregnancy. source_text: Persiapan kelahiran meliputi area bersih, alat sesuai protokol, catatan induk, serta jalur menghubungi petugas berwenang. Amati tanda sesuai pelatihan dan jangan melakukan penarikan paksa atau tindakan invasif tanpa kewenangan. Kesulitan atau perubahan mendadak perlu segera dilaporkan sesuai ambang fasilitas, bukan menunggu angka waktu dari ingatan. Setelah kelahiran, pengamatan induk serta anak mengikuti rencana. english_text: Prepare for calving with a clean area, protocol-approved equipment, dam records, and a way to contact authorized staff. Observe signs within your training; do not pull forcibly or perform invasive procedures without authorization. Report difficulties or sudden changes promptly according to facility thresholds rather than relying on a remembered time limit. After birth, monitor the dam and calf according to the plan. Keep the area calm and clean, and stay alert to animals whose movements can change quickly.

Recommended action: contact authorized staff immediately and follow the protocol. Follow the sequence: Check the dam's identification and calving plan; prepare the area and emergency contact; observe within your training without invasive action; report abnormalities and record the event. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, the observation time, and who was notified. If results differ from the plan, stop the risky work and ask the person in charge for guidance before changing the method. source_text: Pedet memerlukan pengawasan awal, lingkungan sesuai, dan pemberian kolostrum mengikuti rencana fasilitas serta arahan tenaga berwenang. Mutu, waktu, jumlah, dan cara pemberian tidak ditebak dari materi umum karena kondisi individu penting. Botol dan alat harus bersih sesuai prosedur agar tidak menjadi jalur penyakit. Amati kemampuan minum, aktivitas, kotoran, serta kondisi tubuh. Pedet lemah atau tidak mampu minum memerlukan laporan segera; jangan memaksa memasukkan cairan tanpa pelatihan.
english_text: Calves need early monitoring, a suitable environment, and colostrum feeding according to facility plans and directions from authorized staff. Do not guess colostrum quality, timing, amount, or feeding method from general materials; each calf's condition matters. Clean bottles and equipment according to procedure to prevent disease transmission. Monitor drinking ability, activity, droppings, and body condition. Report a weak calf or one unable to drink immediately; do not force fluids without training.

source_text: Pemerahan yang baik memadukan identitas sapi, kebersihan, kondisi ambing, operasi alat, dan pemisahan produk yang tidak memenuhi ketentuan. Periksa catatan hewan termasuk status pengobatan sebelum susu digabungkan. Prosedur persiapan, pemasangan, pelepasan, dan perawatan setelah pemerahan mengikuti sistem fasilitas. Jangan mengubah setelan vakum atau membiarkan alat rusak karena susu tetap keluar. Perubahan susu atau ambing dilaporkan sebagai fakta, bukan didiagnosis dan diobati sendiri.
english_text: Good milking combines cow identification, cleanliness, udder condition, equipment operation, and separation of nonconforming product. Check animal records, including treatment status, before mixing the milk. Follow facility procedures for preparation, attachment, removal, and post-milking care. Do not change vacuum settings or keep using damaged equipment just because milk is still flowing. Report changes in milk or udder condition as observations; do not diagnose or treat them yourself.

source_text: Susu mudah mengalami penurunan mutu bila higiene dan kondisi penyimpanan tidak terkendali. Tangki, pipa, serta alat dibersihkan melalui prosedur fasilitas dengan produk dan parameter yang sesuai. Jangan mencampurkan residu bahan pembersih dengan produk. Kondisi pendinginan dipantau serta dicatat; angka target mengikuti persyaratan fasilitas dan produk. Gangguan alat, listrik, atau penyimpangan suhu memerlukan pemisahan serta keputusan berwenang sebelum pengiriman, bukan sekadar menurunkan suhu kembali lalu menghapus kejadian.
english_text: Milk quality can decline quickly if hygiene and storage conditions are not controlled. Clean tanks, pipes, and equipment according to facility procedures using approved products and parameters. Do not let cleaning residues mix with product. Monitor and record cooling conditions; target values follow facility and product requirements. Equipment failures, power outages, or temperature deviations require product separation and an authorized decision before shipping. Do not simply cool the product again and erase the incident.

source_text: Pemeliharaan sapi potong memperhatikan fase pertumbuhan, ransum, kondisi tubuh, kesehatan kaki, serta lingkungan. Perubahan bobot atau konsumsi ditafsirkan dari catatan dan kondisi, bukan dengan menambah konsentrat secara mendadak. Pemindahan dan penimbangan memerlukan jalur aman serta alat sesuai. Hindari titik jepit dan kepadatan tidak sesuai. Kelompok yang berbeda status atau ukuran tidak dicampur tanpa rencana karena perilaku dan persaingan dapat berubah. Catatan identitas memastikan keputusan tepat individu atau kelompok.
english_text: Beef cattle care considers growth stage, ration, body condition, hoof health, and the environment. Interpret weight or intake changes using records and observed conditions; do not respond by suddenly adding concentrate. Moving and weighing cattle require safe routes and suitable equipment. Avoid pinch points and overcrowding. Do not mix groups with different status or sizes without a plan, since behavior and competition may change. Identification records help ensure decisions apply to the correct animal or group.

source_text: Babi dapat bereaksi kuat terhadap perubahan kelompok, suhu, serta perlakuan kasar. Kepadatan, akses pakan dan air, lantai, serta lingkungan mengikuti fase dan rencana fasilitas. Pemindahan memerlukan jalur dan alat bantu yang disetujui; jangan menarik telinga atau melakukan kekerasan. Perkelahian, luka, dan penurunan konsumsi dicatat lalu dilaporkan. Jangan mencampur kelompok sehat dengan hewan yang status kesehatannya belum jelas. Pembersihan kandang kosong dan perpindahan kelompok harus mematuhi biosekuriti.
english_text: Pigs may react strongly to group changes, temperature, and rough handling. Stocking density, feed and water access, flooring, and environment should follow the production stage and facility plan. Moving pigs requires approved routes and aids; never pull their ears or use force. Record and report fighting, injuries, and reduced intake. Do not mix healthy groups with animals whose health status is unclear. Clean empty pens and move groups according to biosecurity procedures.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Setelah pemindahan ada babi terluka dan tidak mendapat akses pakan. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: laporkan dan ikuti pengaturan kelompok sesuai sop. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Periksa status serta rencana kelompok babi; Siapkan jalur dan alat pemindahan; Pindahkan secara tenang sesuai pelatihan; Amati luka serta akses pakan air. Catat kondisi sebelum dan sesudah tindakan, lokasi atau kelompok yang terdampak, waktu pengamatan, serta siapa yang diberi laporan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. english_text: Consider this work situation: After moving, a pig is injured and cannot reach feed. Recommended action: report it and manage the group according to standard procedures. english_text: Waste areas and confined spaces may contain toxic gases or low oxygen even when they look normal. Odor is not a safety meter. Jangan menjawab paham bila angka atau kelompok belum jelas. Ulangi instruksi penting sebelum bekerja dan tanyakan ketidakjelasan. Contoh kebutuhan pakan 2 kg per ekor untuk 5 ekor adalah 10 kg dalam latihan hitung, bukan rekomendasi ransum nyata. Catatan pengobatan dan penggunaan produk tidak diubah tanpa kewenangan.
english_text: Work reports link identification, time, count, units, conditions, and actions taken. 飼料 means feed, 給水 means water supply, and 異常 means abnormality. source_text: Pergerakan pesawat di apron mengikuti rute, prioritas, dan komunikasi yang dikendalikan petugas berwenang. Dukungan dapat mencakup pengaturan kendaraan atau pemindahan pesawat sesuai pembagian tugas. Hanya petugas terlatih dan berizin boleh memberi isyarat, mengoperasikan alat khusus, atau memimpin pergerakan.
english_text: Aircraft movement on the apron follows routes, priorities, and communications controlled by authorized staff. Support may include directing vehicles or moving aircraft according to assigned roles. Only trained and authorized staff may signal, operate specialized equipment, or lead a movement.

source_text: Sebelum masuk jalur, pastikan izin dan komunikasi jelas. Gunakan isyarat baku di tempat kerja; jangan berimprovisasi. Jika pandangan terhalang, radio mati, atau kontak visual hilang, hentikan gerakan pada posisi aman dan laporkan agar pemimpin mengatur ulang.
english_text: Before entering a route, confirm that authorization and communication are clear. Use standard workplace signals; do not improvise. If your view is blocked, the radio fails, or visual contact is lost, stop in a safe position and report it so the lead can reorganize the movement.

english_text: Stairs, baggage tractors, and service vehicles move in tight spaces shared with aircraft and workers. Check brakes, leaks, alarms, and safety devices using the checklist. Rain, wind, lightning, slippery surfaces, and poor visibility can change the risks; follow airport operating limits.

source_text: Gunakan jalur dan kecepatan yang ditetapkan, jaga jarak dari pesawat, dan amankan alat sebelum meninggalkannya. Jangan mengoperasikan jenis alat tanpa izin. Jika rusak atau cuaca berubah, hentikan, parkir aman bila memungkinkan, beri tanda, dan laporkan.
english_text: Use the designated route and speed, keep clear of the aircraft, and secure equipment before leaving it. Do not operate equipment without authorization. If it is damaged or the weather changes, stop, park safely if possible, mark it, and report the issue.

english_text: Cargo varies in weight, shape, protection, and placement limits. Check its label, documents, packaging condition, and instructions from authorized staff. Do not calculate balance or create a loading plan yourself. Use suitable equipment or team assistance to prevent injury or damage.

source_text: Cocokkan kargo dengan daftar penerbangan dan posisi yang ditetapkan. Gunakan alat pemindah sesuai prosedur dan kunci muatan mengikuti instruksi. Jika berat atau posisi berbeda dari dokumen, tahan kargo dan minta perhitungan atau instruksi ulang.
english_text: Match the cargo to the flight list and assigned position. Use transfer equipment according to procedure and secure the load as instructed. If the weight or position differs from the documents, hold the cargo and request a recalculation or updated instructions.

english_text: Check quantity and identity as items move from sorting to a cart and then to the aircraft. Look for damaged packaging, leaking liquid, and special markings. Reports should include the flight, item number if available, location, time, condition, and any temporary action taken.

source_text: Jika barang jatuh, bocor, rusak, atau milik penerbangan lain, pisahkan dan beri tahu pengawas. Jangan menutup kerusakan tanpa otorisasi. Saat jumlah berbeda atau bagasi hilang, ikuti proses penelusuran dan teruskan status ke giliran berikutnya.
english_text: If an item is dropped, leaking, damaged, or assigned to another flight, separate it and notify the supervisor. Do not conceal damage without authorization. If the quantity differs or baggage is missing, follow the tracing process and pass the status to the next shift.

english_text: Passenger service includes queues, information, boarding assistance, and coordination when schedules change. Use data from the system or authorized staff, protect the privacy of documents, and do not promise an unverified seat or departure. Consider accessibility and safety needs.

source_text: Dengarkan pertanyaan, ulangi informasi penting, dan jawab dengan sederhana. Untuk bantuan kursi roda, kondisi kesehatan, dokumen hilang, atau kesulitan memahami instruksi, hubungi petugas layanan penumpang. Pastikan orang yang membutuhkan bantuan benar-benar diserahterimakan.

english_text: Aircraft meal service has specific timing and destinations. Match the cart quantity, flight, instructions, and seals against the documents. Keep carts and food clean. Do not mix incorrectly labeled items or items with broken seals. Trained staff must load them using approved equipment.

source_text: Periksa kebersihan, roda, pengunci, dan tanda sebelum berangkat. Ikuti rute serta arahan pengawas ketika mendekati pesawat. Pastikan troli terkunci setelah dimuat. Jika jumlah atau label tidak cocok, jangan ubah isi; minta katering memverifikasi.

Pengisian dan pemeriksaan mengikuti prosedur operator; materi ini tidak memberi kewenangan mengisi bahan bakar.
english_text: Aircraft fuel handling is restricted to trained and authorized staff. Other workers must understand restricted zones, the ban on flames and sparks, safe routes, and how to raise an alarm. Refueling and inspections follow the operator's procedures; this material does not authorize anyone to refuel aircraft.

source_text: Di sekitar operasi bahan bakar, patuhi tanda, jarak, dan instruksi pengawas. Jika melihat bau kuat, tumpahan, selang rusak, atau sumber api, jangan menyentuh atau membersihkan. Jauhi area melalui jalur aman dan beri tahu petugas bahan bakar serta pengawas.
english_text: Near fuel operations, follow signs, distance requirements, and supervisor instructions. If you notice a strong smell, a spill, a damaged hose, or an ignition source, do not touch or clean anything. Leave by a safe route and notify the fuel staff and supervisor.

source_text: Pembersihan gedung menjaga kebersihan, kesehatan lingkungan, keamanan, dan penampilan ruang. Bersih secara visual belum tentu memenuhi persyaratan higienis. Lingkup pekerjaan ditentukan kontrak dan instruksi kerja: area, permukaan, jadwal, metode, serta standar hasil. Petugas tidak mengambil tugas teknis lain hanya karena terlihat mudah. Perbaikan listrik, pengendalian bahan berbahaya, dan pekerjaan di ketinggian memerlukan kewenangan serta pelatihan tersendiri.
english_text: Building cleaning supports cleanliness, a healthy environment, safety, and the appearance of spaces. A surface that looks clean may not meet hygiene requirements. Contracts and work instructions define the area, surfaces, schedule, methods, and result standards. Staff must not take on technical tasks just because they seem easy. Electrical repairs, hazardous-material control, and work at height require separate authorization and training.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Sebelum mulai, baca daftar ruang dan batas pekerjaan. Cocokkan kebutuhan pengguna dengan jadwal gedung, lalu tanyakan bagian yang belum jelas. Perhatikan penghuni, barang pribadi, dan jalur evakuasi. Setelah selesai, bandingkan hasil dengan standar: debu dan noda terangkat, permukaan aman, perlengkapan lengkap, serta tidak ada kerusakan baru. Laporkan hambatan dengan lokasi dan fakta agar pekerjaan berikutnya dapat direncanakan.
english_text: Before starting, read the room list and work limits. Match user needs to the building schedule, then ask about anything unclear. Be mindful of occupants, personal belongings, and evacuation routes. When finished, compare the result with the standard: dust and stains removed, surfaces safe, supplies complete, and no new damage. Report obstacles with their location and facts so the next task can be planned.

source_text: Pembersihan harian menangani kotoran yang muncul dari penggunaan rutin, misalnya debu, sampah, dan bekas sentuhan. Pembersihan berkala menangani akumulasi atau pemeliharaan yang tidak perlu dilakukan setiap hari, seperti pencucian mesin lantai atau perawatan lapisan pelindung. Inspeksi bukan sekadar tanda tangan: kondisi awal dan hasil akhir harus diperiksa berdasarkan daftar area. Frekuensi disesuaikan penggunaan dan spesifikasi gedung.
english_text: Daily cleaning addresses soil from routine use, such as dust, rubbish, and fingerprints. Periodic cleaning handles buildup or maintenance that need not be done every day, such as machine floor washing or finish care. An inspection is more than a signature: check initial conditions and final results against the area checklist. Set the frequency according to building use and specifications.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Susun urutan agar area yang sudah bersih tidak terkotori kembali. Tentukan waktu untuk pekerjaan yang membutuhkan pengeringan atau pembatasan akses. Jika pekerjaan berkala tidak dapat dilakukan karena ruangan masih dipakai, catat pekerjaan yang tertunda dan koordinasikan waktu pengganti. Jangan mengganti metode berkala dengan proses cepat yang merusak bahan. Gunakan catatan inspeksi untuk menemukan noda berulang dan penyebabnya.
english_text: Plan the sequence so cleaned areas do not become dirty again. Allow time for work that requires drying or restricted access. If periodic cleaning cannot be done because a room is occupied, record the task as pending and coordinate another time. Do not replace a periodic method with a quick process that damages materials. Use inspection records to identify recurring stains and their causes.

Use official channels to report lost property and information about occupants.

source_text: Air, kabel, alat, dan perbedaan permukaan dapat menyebabkan jatuh. Rambu memperingatkan, sedangkan pembatas membantu mengendalikan akses; keduanya dipilih sesuai risiko dan aturan lokasi. Rambu ditempatkan sebelum pekerjaan basah dimulai, terlihat dari jalur datang pengguna. Jangan menutup seluruh jalur tanpa koordinasi. Pengeringan dan pemeriksaan akhir menentukan kapan area boleh dibuka, bukan semata waktu yang sudah berlalu.
english_text: Water, cables, equipment, and changes in floor surfaces can cause falls. Signs warn people, while barriers help control access; choose both according to the risk and site rules. Put signs in place before wet work begins and where people approaching can see them. Do not block an entire route without coordination. Reopen the area only after it has dried and passed a final check, not simply because a certain amount of time has passed.

source_text: Periksa jalur alternatif, pintu darurat, dan pengguna yang membutuhkan bantuan mobilitas. Kerjakan lantai dalam zona kecil sehingga akses aman tetap tersedia. Bila tidak bisa mengendalikan arus orang, hentikan pekerjaan dan koordinasikan waktu lain.
english_text: Check alternative routes, emergency exits, and whether any users need mobility assistance. Clean the floor in small zones so a safe route remains available. If a spill occurs outside the work area, secure it or request help promptly. Move signs only after the floor is dry, equipment is stored, and no slippery residue remains. If pedestrian flow cannot be controlled, stop and coordinate another time.

Gunakan alat dengan panjang sesuai tubuh, bagi beban, dan gunakan troli bila tersedia.
english_text: Choose personal protective equipment based on the task risks and product label: suitable gloves, non-slip footwear, and eye protection where splashing is possible. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene. Repeated bending, twisting while lifting, and carrying an overfilled bucket increase the risk of injury. Use tools of a suitable length, divide loads, and use a cart when available.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Periksa APD sebelum dipakai dan ganti yang robek atau terkontaminasi. Saat memindahkan beban, nilai berat dan jalurnya dahulu. Dekatkan beban ke tubuh dan hindari memutar pinggang; pindahkan kaki untuk berganti arah. Jangan memaksakan beban yang tidak dapat dikendalikan. Minta bantuan sesuai prosedur. Sesuaikan tinggi gagang dan selingi aktivitas untuk mengurangi gerakan berulang.
english_text: Inspect PPE before use and replace anything torn or contaminated. Before moving a load, assess its weight and route. Keep the load close to your body and avoid twisting at the waist; move your feet to change direction. Do not force a load you cannot control. Ask for help according to procedure. Adjust handle height and alternate tasks to reduce repetitive movement.
Wear the PPE specified on the label.
Use a cart or ask for assistance.
Check for fatigue and inspect the equipment.

source_text: Utamakan keselamatan diri dan orang di sekitar ketika terjadi insiden. Kenali cara menghubungi penanggung jawab dan nomor darurat lokasi sebelum mulai bekerja. Tumpahan tidak dikenal diperlakukan sebagai potensi bahaya; jangan menyentuh, menghirup, atau mencampurkan bahan lain. Kebakaran, cedera, atau paparan bahan ditangani mengikuti prosedur darurat dan informasi SDS. Petugas tidak boleh memasuki area berbahaya tanpa pelatihan serta perlindungan.
english_text: Prioritize your safety and the safety of others during an incident. Before beginning work, know how to contact the person in charge and the site's emergency number. Treat an unidentified spill as a potential hazard; do not touch, inhale, or mix it with anything. Handle fires, injuries, and chemical exposures under the emergency procedure and SDS information. Staff must not enter a hazardous area without training and protective equipment.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Hentikan aktivitas, batasi akses dari posisi aman, lalu laporkan lokasi, jenis kejadian, dan orang yang terdampak. Bila darurat, aktifkan respons darurat gedung tanpa menunda untuk menyelesaikan tugas. Pertolongan dilakukan sesuai pelatihan dan petunjuk petugas darurat. Simpan informasi produk untuk membantu penanganan. Catat kejadian dan nyaris celaka setelah situasi aman, termasuk tindakan yang sudah diambil.
english_text: Stop work, restrict access from a safe position, and report the location, type of incident, and anyone affected. In an emergency, activate the building's emergency response without delaying to finish the task. Provide assistance only within your training and follow emergency responders' instructions. Keep product information available to support the response. Once the situation is safe, record the incident or near miss and actions taken.
Keep yourself clear of the hazard.
Secure access from a safe position.
Report the facts once the area is safe.

source_text: Debu lepas, minyak, kerak mineral, dan noda terserap membutuhkan pendekatan berbeda. Mulai dari metode paling ringan yang efektif dan sesuai permukaan. Batu alam, kayu, logam, kaca, lapisan lantai, serta tekstil memiliki ketahanan berbeda terhadap air, gesekan, asam, dan alkali. Noda yang tampak serupa belum tentu sama; periksa spesifikasi material sebelum memilih bahan dan alat.
english_text: Loose dust, oil, mineral deposits, and absorbed stains need different methods. Start with the gentlest effective method that suits the surface. Natural stone, wood, metal, glass, floor finishes, and textiles differ in how they tolerate water, abrasion, acids, and alkalis. Stains that look alike may have different causes; check the material specifications before choosing a product and tool.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Angkat kotoran lepas terlebih dahulu agar tidak menggores ketika digosok. Jika material belum diketahui, tanyakan dan uji di area tersembunyi sesuai izin. Jangan langsung memakai bahan kuat. Perhatikan perubahan warna, kilap, atau tekstur selama uji. Jika tanda kerusakan muncul, hentikan dan laporkan. Catat metode yang berhasil untuk penggunaan berikutnya dalam instruksi lokasi.
english_text: Remove loose soil first so it does not scratch the surface during scrubbing. If the material is unknown, ask and test in a hidden area if authorized. Do not start with a strong chemical. Watch for changes in color, gloss, or texture during the test. Stop and report any sign of damage. Record the method that worked in the site instructions for future use.
Choose a gentle method and test it first.
Check for changes to the surface.

english_text: Acid can damage some types of stone; never guess whether the product is compatible.

english_text: Explain product labels, SDS, and chemical storage.

source_text: Memilih tindakan yang aman dari kasus kerja dan menjelaskan alasannya.

source_text: Label produk menjelaskan penggunaan, bahaya, pengenceran, serta perlindungan yang dibutuhkan. SDS menyediakan informasi keselamatan seperti bahaya, penanganan, pertolongan pertama, dan penyimpanan. Jangan memakai bahan dari wadah tanpa identitas. Pemindahan ke botol kerja hanya melalui prosedur berlabel yang diizinkan. Bahan yang tidak kompatibel disimpan terpisah; tutup rapat dan cegah akses pengguna gedung.
english_text: A product label explains its use, hazards, dilution, and required protection. The SDS provides safety information such as hazards, handling, first aid, and storage. Do not use a chemical from an unidentified container. Transfer to a working bottle only under an approved labeling procedure. Store incompatible products separately, close containers securely, and prevent access by building users.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Cocokkan produk dengan tugas, lalu baca label sebelum membuka. Pastikan lokasi SDS diketahui dan dapat diakses. Gunakan wadah yang sesuai serta label yang terbaca; botol minuman tidak boleh dijadikan wadah bahan kimia. Simpan dalam tempat yang ditentukan, tidak di jalur evakuasi atau dekat makanan. Jika label hilang, pisahkan dengan aman dan tanyakan penanggung jawab, jangan mencoba mengidentifikasi lewat bau.
english_text: Match the product to the task and read the label before opening it. Know where the SDS is kept and make sure it is accessible. Use a suitable container with a readable label; never use a drink bottle for chemicals. Store chemicals in the designated place, away from evacuation routes and food. If a label is missing, isolate the container safely and ask the person in charge; do not try to identify it by smell.
Check the container and its identification.
Store it according to compatibility requirements.

source_text: Jangan mencampur produk; pemutih berklorin dengan asam dapat melepaskan gas berbahaya.
english_text: Do not mix products; chlorine bleach and acid can release hazardous gas.

source_text: Larutan terlalu pekat dapat meninggalkan residu, merusak bahan, atau meningkatkan paparan; terlalu encer dapat gagal mencapai hasil. Baca definisi rasio: pengenceran 100 kali berarti volume produk merupakan seper seratus volume akhir, jika demikian tertulis pada petunjuk. Ini berbeda dari notasi 1:100 produk terhadap air. Gunakan satuan dan alat ukur yang benar. Waktu kontak disinfektan mengikuti produk; tidak ada angka universal untuk semua bahan.
english_text: A solution that is too concentrated can leave residue, damage materials, or increase exposure; one that is too dilute may not work. Read how the ratio is defined: where the instructions say so, a 100-fold dilution means the product is one hundredth of the final volume. This differs from a 1:100 product-to-water notation. Use the correct units and measuring tool. Disinfectant contact time depends on the product; there is no universal value.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Hitung kebutuhan akhir agar tidak menyiapkan berlebihan. Untuk 1 liter larutan dengan pengenceran akhir 100 kali, dibutuhkan 10 ml produk dan air hingga volume akhir 1000 ml, bukan 1000 ml air ditambah produk. Jika label memakai definisi lain, ikuti definisinya. Campurkan hanya sesuai urutan dan kondisi yang disyaratkan label. Jangan menambah bahan untuk mempercepat kerja. Tandai identitas larutan dan batas pakainya sesuai prosedur.
english_text: Calculate the final amount to avoid preparing too much. For one liter of a 100-fold final dilution, use 10 mL of product and add water to a final volume of 1,000 mL; do not add the product to 1,000 mL of water. If the label defines the ratio differently, follow that definition. Mix only in the sequence and conditions required by the label. Do not add extra product to speed up the work. Label the solution and its use-by limit according to procedure.
Read how the dilution ratio is defined on the label.

source_text: Ikuti waktu kontak dan penanganan residu
english_text: Observe the contact time and residue handling instructions.

english_text: Measure 10 mL of concentrate and add water to a total volume of 1,000 mL, following the product instructions.

source_text: Kain dan mop yang kotor dapat memindahkan kotoran antar-area. Sistem pemisahan alat berdasarkan zona membantu mencegah kontaminasi silang; warna spesifik ditentukan lokasi, bukan aturan universal. Lipat kain untuk menyediakan beberapa sisi bersih. Ganti sisi ketika kotor, lalu ganti kain sesuai prosedur. Alat toilet tidak digunakan pada meja atau area bersih. Kain lembap berbeda dari kain yang menetes.
english_text: Dirty cloths and mops can spread soil between areas. Separating tools by zone helps prevent cross-contamination; the specific colors are set by the site and are not universal. Fold a cloth to provide several clean sides. Change sides when soiled, and replace the cloth according to procedure. Do not use restroom tools on desks or clean areas. A damp cloth should not be dripping wet.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Siapkan jumlah kain cukup dan pisahkan wadah bersih dari bekas pakai. Gunakan metode lap searah atau tumpang tindih yang teratur agar area tidak terlewat. Jangan mencelupkan alat kotor ke larutan bersih bila prosedur melarangnya. Setelah tugas, cuci atau proses alat sesuai spesifikasi, keringkan, dan simpan bersih. Kain yang lembap disimpan tertutup tanpa pengeringan dapat menjadi sumber bau dan pencemaran.
english_text: Prepare enough cloths and keep clean and used containers separate. Wipe in a consistent direction or with overlapping passes so no area is missed. Do not dip a dirty tool into clean solution when procedure prohibits it. After the task, wash or process tools to their specifications, dry them, and store them clean. Damp cloths sealed away before drying can develop odors and contamination.
Keep tools separate for each zone.
Fold the cloth and use a clean side.
Wash and dry the area after the work.

source_text: Vacuum mengangkat debu melalui aliran udara dan penyaringan. Jenis kering tidak otomatis aman untuk cairan. Gunakan mesin yang dirancang untuk tugas dan bahan yang akan diangkat. Kantong atau wadah penuh dan filter tersumbat menurunkan hisap. Debu berbahaya atau bahan tak dikenal tidak ditangani dengan vacuum biasa. Pilih nozzle sesuai permukaan dan periksa roda agar tidak menggores lantai.
english_text: A vacuum removes dust through airflow and filtration. A dry vacuum is not automatically safe for liquids. Use a machine designed for the task and material being collected. A full bag or container and a clogged filter reduce suction. Do not use an ordinary vacuum for hazardous or unidentified dust. Choose a nozzle for the surface and check the wheels so they do not scratch the floor.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Sebelum memasang steker, periksa kabel, bodi, filter, dan kapasitas wadah. Rencanakan jalur kabel jauh dari arus pengguna serta genangan. Angkat benda besar secara aman terlebih dahulu. Gerakkan nozzle teratur, tidak terlalu cepat, dan tumpang tindih. Jika hisap turun, matikan dan cabut sebelum pemeriksaan sesuai manual. Buang debu menurut prosedur tanpa menghamburkannya kembali.
english_text: Before plugging in the vacuum, check its cable, body, filter, and container capacity. Plan a cable route away from pedestrian flow and puddles. Safely pick up large objects first. Move the nozzle steadily, not too quickly, with overlapping passes. If suction drops, switch off and unplug the machine before checking it according to the manual. Dispose of dust under the procedure without scattering it again.
Check the machine type and cable.
Switch it off and maintain it according to the manual.

source_text: Mesin lantai memerlukan latihan langsung dan izin penggunaan. Pad, sikat, kecepatan, larutan, serta jenis lantai harus cocok; warna pad tidak cukup untuk menentukan kompatibilitas. Periksa kabel, steker, kebocoran, serta pengaman. Tangan basah dan air di dekat sambungan listrik meningkatkan bahaya. Kabel rusak tidak diperbaiki sementara oleh operator tanpa kewenangan. Mesin bergerak tidak boleh ditinggalkan tanpa kendali.
english_text: Floor machines require hands-on training and authorization. The pad, brush, speed, solution, and floor type must be compatible; pad color alone does not establish compatibility. Check the cable, plug, leaks, and safety guards. Wet hands and water near electrical connections increase danger. Operators must not improvise repairs to a damaged cable. Never leave a running machine unattended.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Baca manual, inspeksi area, dan siapkan pembatas sebelum pemasangan. Pasang aksesori saat daya terputus sesuai petunjuk. Atur gagang agar terkendali dan kelola kabel tanpa melewati zona basah. Jangan menjalankan mesin di tangga atau bidang yang tidak diizinkan. Jika muncul suara, getaran, bau, atau percikan tidak normal, hentikan, isolasi sesuai prosedur, dan beri label alat tidak boleh dipakai.
english_text: Read the manual, inspect the area, and set up barriers before installing the equipment. Attach accessories only when the power is disconnected, as instructed. Adjust the handle for control and route the cable away from wet areas. Do not operate a machine on stairs or on surfaces where it is not approved. If there is unusual noise, vibration, odor, or sparking, stop, isolate it according to procedure, and label it as out of service.
Attach accessories only when the power is disconnected.
Operate it within the safe zone.

source_text: Menjelaskan prinsip mengangkat debu dan mengepel lantai keras.

source_text: Pasir dan debu lepas diangkat sebelum pengepelan agar tidak menjadi lumpur atau menggores. Pilih dust mop atau vacuum sesuai material dan kondisi. Pengepelan memakai kadar kelembapan yang sesuai; banyak air tidak selalu lebih bersih. Kayu, sambungan, dan beberapa lantai berlapis peka terhadap kelembapan berlebih. Bekerjalah teratur dengan jalur keluar agar tidak menginjak area yang sudah dibersihkan.
english_text: Remove loose sand and dust before mopping so they do not turn to mud or scratch the floor. Choose a dust mop or vacuum that suits the material and conditions. Use an appropriate level of moisture; more water does not mean a cleaner floor. Wood, joints, and some coated floors are sensitive to excess moisture. Work systematically toward an exit so you do not walk over cleaned areas.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Siapkan rambu, periksa kotoran tajam, dan angkat debu dari tepi ke area yang dapat dikumpulkan. Gunakan larutan sesuai label dan mop yang tidak menetes. source_text: Karpet membutuhkan pengangkatan debu teratur, terutama jalur padat pengguna. Noda ditangani segera dengan metode yang sesuai serat, pewarna, dan lapisan bawah. english_text: Carpets need regular dust removal, especially in high-traffic areas. Treat stains promptly using a method suited to the fibers, dye, and backing. Blotting a spill is different from vigorous scrubbing, which can spread the stain and damage fibers. Test the product in a hidden area. english_text: Restrooms present different contamination risks from office areas. Confirm permission to enter and respect users' privacy before closing a zone. Use PPE and dedicated tools under the building's system. The general principle is to work from cleaner to dirtier areas and from top to bottom, while following the facility's specific procedures. Do not move toilet tools to a sink or door handle.

source_text: Kategori sampah mengikuti aturan pemerintah daerah dan gedung. Jangan menganggap semua plastik atau semua kertas memiliki jalur pembuangan sama. Pisahkan bahan yang ditetapkan, lindungi data rahasia melalui prosedur khusus, dan jangan mengorek isi kantong dengan tangan. Kantong yang terlalu penuh atau bocor meningkatkan paparan serta beban. Gunakan troli dan rute pengangkutan yang tidak mencemari area bersih.
english_text: Waste categories follow local government and building rules. Do not assume that all plastics or all paper go into the same waste stream. Separate designated materials, protect confidential information under the special procedure, and never reach into a bag by hand. Overfilled or leaking bags increase exposure and lifting risks. Use a cart and a transport route that does not contaminate clean areas.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Periksa kondisi tempat sampah dan adanya benda tajam secara visual. Tutup kantong sesuai prosedur, jangan menekan isinya dengan tangan atau tubuh. Jika bocor, gunakan penanganan tambahan sesuai ketentuan tanpa menyentuh isinya langsung. Bersihkan tempat sampah dengan alat khusus dan pasang pelapis yang benar. Bawa ke titik pengumpulan yang ditentukan, jaga akses dan kebersihan jalur, lalu bersihkan tangan setelah melepas APD.
english_text: Visually check the waste bin and look for sharps. Close the bag according to procedure; do not press its contents with your hands or body. If it leaks, use the additional controls required without touching the contents directly. Clean the bin with dedicated tools and fit the correct liner. Take the waste to its designated collection point, keep the route clear and clean, then clean your hands after removing PPE.
Check the site's local waste categories.
Close it without compressing the contents by hand.
Transport it using a safe route.
Clean the tools and your hands.

source_text: Jarum, kaca pecah, darah, dan cairan tubuh tidak diperlakukan sebagai sampah atau tumpahan biasa. Hindari menyentuh langsung dan jauhkan orang dari area. Penanganan memerlukan petugas terlatih, perlindungan, alat, serta wadah yang tepat. Sarung tangan biasa tidak membuat tangan tahan tusukan. Jangan mengambil jarum, memasang ulang tutupnya, atau memasukkannya ke kantong sampah umum.
english_text: Needles, broken glass, blood, and bodily fluids are not ordinary waste or spills. Avoid direct contact and keep people away from the area. Handling requires trained staff, protective equipment, suitable tools, and the correct container. Ordinary gloves do not prevent punctures. Do not pick up a needle, recap it, or put it in a general waste bag.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Laporkan temuan dengan lokasi tepat dan tunggu bantuan sesuai protokol fasilitas. Jika tugas penanganan bukan kewenanganmu, jangan memulai. Setelah paparan atau cedera, ikuti prosedur pertolongan dan penilaian medis segera; jangan menunggu akhir shift. Informasikan jenis paparan tanpa menyebarkan identitas pengguna. Pembersihan dan disinfeksi area mengikuti protokol khusus serta instruksi produk oleh personel yang berwenang.
english_text: Report the finding with its exact location and wait for assistance under the facility protocol. Do not begin handling it if the task is outside your authority. After an exposure or injury, follow first-aid procedures and obtain prompt medical assessment; do not wait until the end of the shift. Report the type of exposure without disclosing a building user's identity. Only authorized staff should clean and disinfect the area under the special protocol and product instructions.
Follow exposure reporting procedures if an exposure occurs.

source_text: Kebersihan tangan memutus perpindahan kotoran dan mikroorganisme. Bersihkan tangan pada saat yang ditetapkan, termasuk setelah melepas sarung tangan dan setelah tugas kotor. Jika tangan terlihat kotor, gunakan pencucian dengan sabun dan air sesuai pedoman fasilitas. Disinfeksi permukaan dilakukan bila ditetapkan berdasarkan risiko, bukan sebagai pengganti pembersihan. Produk dipilih untuk permukaan serta sasaran penggunaan yang sesuai.
english_text: Hand hygiene interrupts the spread of soil and microorganisms. Clean your hands at the required times, including after removing gloves and after dirty work. If hands are visibly soiled, wash with soap and water as directed by the facility. Disinfect surfaces when required by the risk assessment, not as a substitute for cleaning. Choose a product appropriate for the surface and intended use.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Siapkan alat bersih dan alur yang tidak mempertemukan kain bekas dengan persediaan bersih. Bersihkan kotoran sebelum disinfeksi sesuai petunjuk, gunakan konsentrasi serta waktu kontak yang benar, dan tangani residu bila diwajibkan. Jangan menyemprot disinfektan ke orang atau mengaburkan ruangan tanpa prosedur khusus. Periksa titik sentuh serta kondisi alat, lalu dokumentasikan pekerjaan sesuai daftar fasilitas.
english_text: Prepare clean tools and keep used cloths separate from clean supplies. Remove soil before disinfecting as instructed, use the correct concentration and contact time, and handle residue if required. Never spray disinfectant on people or fog a room without a special procedure. Check high-touch points and equipment condition, then record the work using the facility checklist.
Keep clean and dirty workflows separate.
Disinfect when required, following the label.
Clean your hands after the task.

source_text: Instruksi kerja menjelaskan lokasi, target, alat, larutan, waktu, serta pemeriksaan. Konfirmasikan istilah, angka, dan satuan yang belum dipahami. Prioritas adalah keselamatan dan persyaratan layanan, bukan bergerak secepat mungkin. Urutan dari atas ke bawah dan dari lebih bersih ke lebih kotor membantu mengurangi pengulangan, tetapi selalu disesuaikan rencana lokasi dan risiko pengguna.
english_text: Work instructions specify the location, target, tools, solution, timing, and inspection. Confirm any terms, figures, or units you do not understand. Safety and service requirements take priority over working as quickly as possible. Working from top to bottom and from cleaner to dirtier areas can reduce repeat work, but always adapt the sequence to the site plan and risks to building users.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Baca rencana sebelum menyiapkan troli, lalu cocokkan alat dan stok. Perhitungkan waktu pengeringan, pergantian pengguna, serta titik pembuangan. Jika instruksi bertentangan dengan label atau kondisi aktual, hentikan dan tanyakan. Gunakan konfirmasi ulang dengan kata sendiri agar angka pengenceran dan ruang tujuan tidak tertukar. Jangan mengisi catatan selesai untuk pekerjaan yang belum dilakukan.
english_text: Read the plan before preparing the cart, then check the tools and supplies. Allow for drying time, changes in building use, and disposal points. If an instruction conflicts with the label or actual conditions, stop and ask. Repeat key details in your own words to avoid mixing up dilution figures or room locations. Do not mark work complete if it has not been done.

source_text: Mutu dinilai dari hasil yang dapat diperiksa: tidak ada debu atau noda sesuai standar, permukaan aman, tidak ada residu mengganggu, dan perlengkapan siap. Bandingkan kondisi sebelum serta setelah kerja untuk menemukan kerusakan. Keluhan pengguna adalah informasi yang perlu dicatat secara netral. Jangan menghapus bukti atau menyalahkan orang tanpa fakta; sampaikan kondisi dan tindakan yang dapat diverifikasi.
english_text: Quality is judged by checkable results: dust and stains are removed to the required standard, the surface is safe, no troublesome residue remains, and supplies are ready. Compare conditions before and after work to identify damage. Record user complaints neutrally. Do not erase evidence or blame anyone without facts; report conditions and actions that can be verified.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Gunakan daftar periksa area, perhatikan sudut serta titik sentuh yang mudah terlewat. Jika standar belum tercapai, perbaiki dengan metode yang diizinkan atau laporkan keterbatasannya. Catat kerusakan dengan lokasi serta waktu melalui saluran resmi, tanpa memotret data pribadi. Dengarkan keluhan sampai selesai, konfirmasikan inti masalah, dan sampaikan kepada penanggung jawab agar tindak lanjut tidak hilang.
english_text: Use the area checklist and pay attention to corners and high-touch points that are easy to miss. If the standard has not been met, correct the problem using an approved method or report the limitation. Record damage, its location, and the time through official channels without photographing personal information. Listen to a complaint fully, confirm its main point, and pass it to the person in charge so that follow-up is not missed.

source_text: Efisiensi berarti mencapai standar dengan bahan, air, energi, dan waktu yang sesuai, tanpa mengurangi keselamatan. Pengenceran benar mengurangi pemborosan serta residu. Pemeliharaan alat membantu kinerja dan umur pakai. Serah terima shift memuat pekerjaan selesai, tertunda, area masih dibatasi, kerusakan, serta kebutuhan stok. Informasi yang tidak disampaikan dapat membuat rekan membuka area yang belum aman.
english_text: Efficiency means meeting the required standard with appropriate use of products, water, energy, and time, without compromising safety. Correct dilution reduces waste and residue. Equipment maintenance helps it perform well and last longer. A shift handover should cover completed and pending tasks, restricted areas, damage, and supply needs. Missing information may lead a coworker to reopen an area that is still unsafe.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Hitung kebutuhan larutan, hindari air mengalir tanpa tujuan, dan matikan mesin setelah selesai sesuai manual. Bersihkan serta keringkan alat sebelum penyimpanan. Kembalikan bahan ke lokasi resmi dan periksa troli tidak meninggalkan bahaya. Tulis serah terima singkat dengan lokasi dan status jelas, termasuk siapa yang telah dihubungi. Rekan penerima perlu memahami area yang belum boleh dibuka.
english_text: Calculate the amount of solution needed, avoid running water unnecessarily, and switch off machines as instructed when the task is done. Clean and dry tools before storing them. Return products to their designated storage and make sure the cart does not create a hazard. Write a brief handover with clear location and status details, including who has been contacted. The next staff member must know which areas must remain closed.

source_text: Rambu dan kata larangan sering memakai bentuk singkat. 立入禁止 berarti dilarang masuk, 使用禁止 berarti dilarang menggunakan, 清掃中 berarti sedang dibersihkan, dan 注意 berarti perhatikan atau hati-hati. Jangan hanya mengenali warna rambu; baca kata serta lokasi penerapannya. Jika tidak memahami instruksi, hentikan tindakan yang berisiko dan tanyakan. Kata kerja negatif seperti 触らないでください meminta agar tidak menyentuh.
english_text: Signs and prohibitions often use short expressions. 立入禁止 means no entry, 使用禁止 means do not use, 清掃中 means cleaning in progress, and 注意 means caution. Do not rely on sign color alone; read the words and check where they apply. If you do not understand an instruction, stop the risky action and ask. A negative expression such as 触らないでください means do not touch.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Latih membaca rambu dengan menghubungkan artinya ke tindakan: menjauh dari area terlarang, memilih alat lain ketika alat diberi tanda rusak, atau memakai jalur alternatif. Jangan memindahkan tanda agar pekerjaan lebih cepat. Pada percakapan, ulangi informasi penting untuk memastikan pemahaman, misalnya lokasi dan area yang ditutup. Rambu tetap dipasang sampai syarat pembukaan area benar-benar terpenuhi.
english_text: Practice connecting signs to actions: stay out of a restricted area, choose another tool when equipment is marked as damaged, or use an alternative route. Do not move a sign to finish work sooner. In conversation, repeat important information to confirm understanding, such as the location and restricted area. Keep the sign in place until the conditions for reopening the area have actually been met.
Read the words on the sign.
Link the report to the location and action taken.

source_text: Instruksi kerja sering menggabungkan waktu, lantai gedung, volume, dan lokasi. 午前 berarti sebelum tengah hari, 午後 setelah tengah hari, 階 menunjukkan lantai, dan 毫升 biasanya ditulis ml pada produk. Angka tanpa satuan dapat menimbulkan salah tafsir. Baca jadwal secara utuh: kegiatan apa, di mana, kapan, dan syarat selesai. Untuk laporan, pisahkan fakta kejadian dari dugaan penyebab.
english_text: Work instructions often combine a time, floor, volume, and location. 午前 means before noon, 午後 means after noon, 階 indicates a floor, and 毫升 is commonly written as mL on products. A number without a unit can be misread. Read the whole schedule: what task, where, when, and what completion criteria apply. In reports, separate observed facts from assumptions about the cause.
Applying the Work Method and Checking Results

source_text: Gunakan pola lokasi + kondisi + tindakan: 三階のトイレで水漏れがあります, ada kebocoran di toilet lantai tiga. Konfirmasikan angka dengan menunjuk instruksi atau menuliskannya bila perlu. Jika pekerjaan belum selesai, katakan statusnya dengan jelas alih-alih menjawab はい tanpa memahami. Laporkan kebutuhan bantuan dan hal yang telah dilakukan. Informasi sensitif hanya melalui saluran yang disetujui.
english_text: Use the pattern location + condition + action: 三階のトイレで水漏れがあります, meaning there is a water leak in the third-floor restroom. Confirm numbers by pointing to the instructions or writing them down if needed. If work is unfinished, state its status clearly instead of saying はい without understanding. Report any assistance needed and what has already been done. Share sensitive information only through approved channels.
Report the facts and current status.

source_text: Penilaian SSW pembersihan gedung mencakup pengetahuan dan keputusan praktik. Format resmi yang ditinjau adalah CBT teori 20 soal selama 20 menit dan penilaian praktik 30 soal selama 30 menit, masing-masing memerlukan 60 persen. Penilaian praktik dapat memakai foto, ilustrasi, benar-salah, pilihan, serta urutan. english_text: The SSW building-cleaning assessment covers knowledge and practical decisions. The official format reviewed here has a 20-question theory CBT lasting 20 minutes and a 30-question practical assessment lasting 30 minutes; each requires a score of 60 percent. The practical assessment may use photographs, illustrations, true-or-false items, choices, and sequencing. This app's simulation uses multiple-choice questions and original text scenarios, so it does not reproduce every official visual format.

source_text: Pekerjaan bangunan dapat meliputi penyiapan komponen, pembesian, bekisting, pengecoran, pemasangan, atau finishing sesuai tugas. Urutan, dukungan sementara, pemeriksaan sebelum pekerjaan tertutup, dan koordinasi tim menjaga mutu serta kestabilan.
english_text: Building work may include preparing components, rebar work, formwork, concrete pouring, installation, or finishing, as assigned. Work sequence, temporary supports, inspections before work is covered, and team coordination protect quality and stability.

source_text:

english_text: Work on ライフライン・設備 covers project infrastructure and facilities such as pipe or cable networks. Follow the documents and your authorization when identifying routes, isolating systems, arranging access, testing, and coordinating with systems already in operation.

source_text: Perikanan tangkap mengambil organisme dari perairan dengan alat serta metode yang diizinkan. Tugas awak dibagi sesuai instruksi nakhoda dan kompetensi; materi tertulis tidak memberi izin mengemudikan kapal atau mengoperasikan semua alat. english_text: Capture fisheries harvest organisms from the water using permitted gear and methods. Knowing species, seasons, operating areas, sizes, and local rules helps protect product quality and resources. Crew duties are assigned according to the captain's instructions and each person's competence; written material does not authorize anyone to pilot a vessel or operate every type of gear. Before departure, learn the vessel identity, assembly point, communication methods, and emergency equipment. Do not change location or fishing gear without authorized approval.

source_text: Pelampung atau alat apung pribadi dipilih, dipakai, dan diperiksa sesuai jenis kerja serta aturan kapal. Alat yang tersedia di lemari tidak melindungi orang yang tidak memakainya saat diwajibkan. Geladak basah, ikan, es, serta gerakan kapal meningkatkan risiko terpeleset dan jatuh. english_text: Select, wear, and inspect life jackets or personal flotation devices according to the task and vessel rules. Equipment stored in a locker cannot protect someone who is required to wear it but does not. Wet decks, fish, ice, and vessel movement increase slip and fall risks. Maintain secure footing, clear routes, and safe handholds. Do not pass along a hazardous edge or sit on a rail. Protective gear must not interfere with moving equipment; check fit and size before operations.

english_text: Respond to a person overboard according to vessel drills: raise the alarm, report the location, maintain visual contact if safe, and carry out your assigned role. Do not jump in spontaneously, which could create another casualty and leave no observer. Throw or operate rescue equipment only under procedure and from a safe position. Keep communications brief and clear; repeat important instructions. Know the assembly point and how to report a missing person. Direct rescue requires the captain's control and trained personnel.

english_text: Fuel, electricity, hot machinery, and certain tasks can cause fires. Select and use fire extinguishers according to training and the type of hazard; never use water on energized electrical equipment. Enclosed spaces and tanks may contain hazardous gases or lack oxygen. Odor does not prove the air is safe. Do not enter or attempt a spontaneous rescue without the confined-space procedure. Know how to raise the alarm, contact the captain, and leave by the designated route.

english_text: Winches and rollers have moving parts that can catch clothing, gloves, or a person's body. Guards and emergency-stop buttons do not replace safe positioning and training. english_text: Gill nets catch fish when their bodies become entangled in the mesh, making gear specifications and rules important. Inspect the headline, weights, floats, and net before use. Damage can reduce the catch or cause gear to be lost. Set and haul nets on command; do not stand on a net or rope that will move. Remove the catch in a way that protects hands and product quality. Report lost gear and bycatch as required; do not conceal them.

source_text: Rawai menggunakan tali utama, cabang, serta banyak kail; pancing lain memiliki rancangan dan cara operasi berbeda. Kail tajam dan tali bergerak menimbulkan risiko tertusuk serta terseret. Umpan disiapkan dengan alat, posisi, dan higiene yang sesuai. Jangan memegang kail atau ikan berbahaya tanpa metode yang diajarkan. Penebaran serta penarikan mengikuti komando, dengan jalur bebas kaki dan pakaian. Cedera kail dilaporkan dan ditangani sesuai pertolongan yang diajarkan, bukan ditarik paksa tanpa penilaian.
english_text: Longlines use a main line, branch lines, and many hooks; other fishing lines have different designs and operating methods. Sharp hooks and moving line create risks of puncture and entanglement. Prepare bait using suitable tools, positioning, and hygiene. Do not handle hooks or hazardous fish except with trained methods. Set and haul on command, keeping line clear of feet and clothing. Report hook injuries and provide the taught first aid; do not forcefully pull a hook out without assessment.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. If the result differs from the plan, stop the risky part and ask the person in charge for direction before changing the method. source_text: Kesegaran dipengaruhi waktu, suhu, kerusakan fisik, serta pencemaran. Gunakan wadah dan es yang sesuai penggunaan, hindari kontak produk bersih dengan bahan bakar, limbah, atau alat kotor. Pendinginan dilakukan sesuai spesies serta metode fasilitas; satu rasio es tidak berlaku untuk semua kondisi. Jangan menganggap bau normal membuktikan produk aman. Ikan berduri atau berbahaya memerlukan penanganan khusus. Pisahkan hasil rusak atau meragukan untuk penilaian berwenang sebelum pengiriman.
english_text: Freshness is affected by time, temperature, physical damage, and contamination. Use containers and ice suitable for their intended use; keep clean products away from fuel, waste, and dirty equipment. Cool products according to the species and facility method; one ice ratio does not fit every condition. A normal smell does not prove a product is safe. Spiny or hazardous fish require special handling. Isolate damaged or questionable catch for an authorized assessment before shipment.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the species; practice examples are not universal values.
