source_text: Sortasi memisahkan hasil menurut jenis, mutu, ukuran, dan tujuan produk sesuai ketentuan. Timbang dengan alat yang diperiksa serta bedakan berat wadah dan hasil. Identitas lot menghubungkan kapal, waktu, area, serta perlakuan penanganan yang diperlukan. Jangan mencampur lot meragukan atau mengganti tanggal agar lolos standar. Catat hasil samping dan kerusakan secara faktual. Informasi yang benar memudahkan penelusuran bila ada keluhan atau penahanan produk, dan membantu serah terima ke petugas darat.
english_text: Sort products by species, quality, size, and destination according to requirements. Weigh them using checked equipment and distinguish container weight from product weight. Lot identification links the vessel, time, area, and required handling. Do not mix questionable lots or change dates to meet a standard. Record bycatch and damage factually. Accurate information makes tracing easier if there is a complaint or product hold and supports handover to shore staff.

source_text: Komunikasi di kapal harus singkat dan dipahami, terutama perintah berhenti, bahaya, arah, serta lokasi awak. 止まって berarti berhenti dan 危険 berarti bahaya. Jika instruksi tidak terdengar, minta pengulangan; jangan mengira semua teriakan meminta mempercepat. Laporan berisi kondisi alat, lokasi, waktu, dan tindakan yang telah diambil. Bahasa Jepang dipelajari bersama demonstrasi aman serta latihan kapal, bukan menggantikan pelatihan navigasi atau radio. Dalam ujian resmi perikanan, bahasa Jepang menjadi bagian penting pemahaman soal.
english_text: Communication aboard a vessel should be brief and understood, especially commands to stop, warnings, directions, and crew locations. 止まって means “stop,” and 危険 means “danger.” If you do not hear an instruction, ask for it to be repeated; do not assume every shout means “speed up.” Reports include equipment condition, location, time, and actions taken. Learn Japanese alongside safe demonstrations and vessel drills; it does not replace navigation or radio training. Japanese is an important part of understanding questions in the official fisheries examination.

Lakukan alur secara teratur: Dengarkan perintah dan identifikasi tugas; Ulangi bagian yang belum jelas; Laksanakan hanya setelah dipahami; Laporkan hasil serta kondisi berbahaya. english_text: Consider this work situation: You hear 「止まってください」 (“Please stop”) while equipment is operating. Recommended decision: stop under procedure and confirm the hazard. Follow an orderly process: listen to the command and identify the task; repeat any part that is unclear; act only once you understand; report the outcome and hazardous conditions. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. If the result differs from the plan, stop the risky part and ask the person in charge for direction before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the species; practice examples are not universal values.

source_text: Budi daya memelihara organisme melalui pengaturan benih, lingkungan, pemeliharaan, panen, serta catatan produksi. Sistem berpakan seperti banyak ikan berbeda dari sistem tanpa pemberian pakan seperti rumput laut dan sejumlah kerang. Tanpa pakan bukan berarti tanpa pemantauan atau risiko. Jenis organisme dan kondisi lokasi menentukan metode; satu prosedur tidak dapat diterapkan ke semua spesies. Pekerja harus memahami unit pemeliharaan, identitas kelompok, alat, serta batas kewenangan sebelum melakukan perubahan.
english_text: Aquaculture raises organisms through management of stock, environment, maintenance, harvesting, and production records. Fed systems, as used for many fish, differ from systems without feed, such as seaweed and some shellfish. No supplemental feed does not mean no monitoring or risk. The organism and site conditions determine the method; one procedure cannot be applied to every species. Before making changes, workers must understand the rearing unit, lot identity, equipment, and limits of their authority.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. source_text: Lokasi kolam, tangki, atau keramba memengaruhi pertukaran air, akses kerja, paparan pencemar, dan risiko cuaca. Sarana harus diperiksa menurut rancangan, termasuk jalur orang, pagar, pelampung, pengikatan, serta alat darurat. Jangan masuk air atau menyelam untuk memperbaiki alat tanpa kewenangan dan prosedur khusus. Kerusakan yang tampak kecil dapat membesar karena arus atau beban. Catat unit terdampak dan laporkan sebelum meneruskan kegiatan yang membuat pekerja atau organisme terpapar bahaya.
english_text: The location of a pond, tank, or cage affects water exchange, work access, exposure to contaminants, and weather risks. Inspect facilities according to their design, including walkways, barriers, floats, moorings, and emergency equipment. Do not enter the water or dive to repair equipment without authorization and a specific procedure. A small-looking defect can worsen under current or load. Record the affected unit and report it before continuing work that could expose people or stock to danger.

source_text: Suhu, oksigen terlarut, pH, salinitas, serta parameter limbah dipantau sesuai spesies dan sistem. Satu nilai tidak menjelaskan seluruh kondisi. Alat ukur harus diperiksa atau dikalibrasi sesuai manual, lokasi dan waktu sampel dicatat agar hasil dapat dibandingkan. english_text: Monitor temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, salinity, and waste parameters according to the species and system. A single reading does not describe the whole condition. Check or calibrate measuring equipment according to its manual, and record the sample location and time so results can be compared. Fish gathering at the surface or changes in consumption may signal a problem, but diagnosis requires data. Oxygen targets and corrective actions follow the facility plan, not a universal number; do not add chemicals based on a guess.

source_text: Perubahan suhu atau salinitas yang mendadak dapat menyebabkan stres. Penerimaan organisme dari lokasi lain memerlukan prosedur aklimatisasi menurut spesies, ukuran, serta sistem pengangkutan. Jangan menuangkan semua air angkut ke unit budidaya tanpa prosedur biosekuriti. Periksa kondisi wadah, waktu kedatangan, data lingkungan, dan status kelompok. Bila ada kematian atau gangguan, hentikan pemindahan yang tidak aman dan minta arahan. Proses adaptasi tidak memiliki satu durasi universal untuk semua organisme.
english_text: Sudden changes in temperature or salinity can cause stress. Receiving organisms from another site requires an acclimation procedure suited to the species, size, and transport system. Do not pour all transport water into the culture unit without following biosecurity procedures. Check the container, arrival time, environmental data, and lot status. If mortality or distress is present, stop any unsafe transfer and ask for direction. There is no single acclimation duration that applies to every organism.

Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. Biosekuriti dapat mensyaratkan pemisahan, penilaian kesehatan, atau prosedur lain sesuai fasilitas. Jangan menganggap semua organisme dari pemasok sama mempunyai status seragam. Catatan lot memudahkan pengamatan pertumbuhan, mortalitas, dan perlakuan. Penanganan dilakukan lembut dengan alat yang sesuai agar kerusakan fisik dan waktu di luar kondisi aman diminimalkan.
english_text: Check the origin, species, size, quantity, condition, and required documents for incoming juvenile stock. Confirm any mismatch between the label and contents before mixing the stock. Biosecurity may require separation, a health assessment, or other facility procedures. Do not assume that organisms from the same supplier all have the same status. Lot records help monitor growth, mortality, and treatments. Handle stock gently with suitable equipment to limit physical damage and time outside safe conditions.

source_text: Kepadatan memengaruhi akses pakan, kualitas air, pertumbuhan, dan risiko stres. Target bergantung spesies, ukuran, sarana, dan kapasitas pengelolaan air. Grading memisahkan ukuran bila diperlukan dengan alat dan waktu penanganan yang sesuai. Jumlah hidup dihitung dari data awal, penambahan, pemindahan, serta kematian yang dicatat; angka perkiraan harus dibedakan dari hitungan pasti. Jangan menaikkan kepadatan hanya karena ruang tampak masih luas atau menghapus mortalitas agar catatan terlihat baik.
english_text: Stocking density affects access to feed, water quality, growth, and stress risk. Targets depend on species, size, facilities, and water-management capacity. When needed, grading separates size groups using suitable equipment and handling times. Calculate live counts from starting data, additions, transfers, and recorded mortalities; distinguish estimates from exact counts. Do not increase density just because space appears available or omit mortalities to make records look better.

source_text: Pakan dipilih menurut spesies, ukuran, fase, dan rencana produksi. Kondisi air, cuaca, kesehatan, serta respons makan memengaruhi pelaksanaan harian. Pakan berlebih bukan cara pasti mempercepat pertumbuhan; sisa dapat memperburuk lingkungan. Simpan pakan berlabel dan terlindung dari air serta hama. Jangan memberikan produk berjamur atau obat tanpa kewenangan. Catat jumlah aktual dan respons organisme, bukan hanya jatah rencana. Penurunan respons perlu dilaporkan bersama data lingkungan.
english_text: Choose feed according to species, size, life stage, and production plan. Water conditions, weather, health, and feeding response affect daily feeding. Excess feed does not reliably speed growth; leftovers may worsen the environment. Store labeled feed protected from water and pests. Do not use moldy products or administer medication without authorization. Record the amount actually given and the organisms' response, not just the planned ration. Report reduced feeding response together with environmental data.

source_text: Biomassa adalah perkiraan total berat organisme dalam unit. Pengukuran contoh harus mengikuti metode yang ditetapkan agar tidak memilih hanya individu terbesar. Contoh 100 ekor dengan berat rata-rata 0,2 kilogram menghasilkan biomassa 20 kilogram. Bila rencana latihan menggunakan 2 persen biomassa per hari, hasil hitung 0,4 kilogram pakan. Angka ini contoh matematika, bukan rekomendasi untuk semua spesies atau kondisi. Konfirmasikan satuan, jumlah hidup, metode sampling, dan rencana aktual sebelum pemberian.
english_text: Biomass is the estimated total weight of organisms in a unit. Sample measurements must follow the specified method so the largest individuals are not selectively chosen. source_text: Jaring keramba menjaga organisme tetap di unit serta memungkinkan pertukaran air. Robekan menimbulkan risiko lepas, sedangkan organisme penempel dapat mengurangi pertukaran dan menambah beban. Pemeriksaan mencakup jaring, sambungan, pelampung, tali, serta kondisi sekitar dengan metode aman. Pembersihan atau penggantian mengikuti rencana agar organisme tidak terpapar stres atau pencemar. Jangan menyelam atau menggunakan bahan antifouling tanpa pelatihan dan izin. Catat kerusakan serta tindakan untuk unit yang tepat.
english_text: Cage nets keep stock in the unit while allowing water exchange. Tears create an escape risk, while fouling can reduce water exchange and add weight. Using safe methods, inspect the net, connections, floats, ropes, and surrounding conditions. Clean or replace equipment according to the plan to avoid exposing stock to stress or contaminants. Do not dive or apply antifouling substances without training and authorization. Record damage and actions against the correct unit.

source_text: Banyak kerang memperoleh makanan dengan menyaring partikel dari air, sehingga kualitas lokasi sangat penting. english_text: Many shellfish feed by filtering particles from water, so site quality is critical. Systems without supplemental feed still require juvenile stock and facilities, growth and density monitoring, and assessment of environmental risks. Follow harvest-area closures and biotoxin warnings; washing shellfish does not automatically remove every hazard. Do not judge safety only by whether the shells look normal. Move, harvest, and ship stock according to area status and facility plans, maintaining lot identification.

source_text: Rumput laut tumbuh dengan kondisi cahaya, suhu, salinitas, arus, dan unsur lingkungan yang sesuai spesies. Budidaya tanpa pakan tetap memerlukan penyiapan benih, pemasangan, pengaturan kepadatan, serta pemeriksaan tali dan organisme penempel. Penempatan terlalu padat dapat memengaruhi cahaya dan aliran, tetapi koreksi mengikuti rencana, bukan satu angka universal. Perubahan warna atau jaringan rusak dicatat dan dilaporkan. Panen serta pengeringan atau penyimpanan disesuaikan produk, dengan pencegahan pencemaran dari alat dan tempat kerja.
english_text: Seaweed grows under light, temperature, salinity, current, and other environmental conditions suited to the species. Unfed aquaculture still requires stock preparation and deployment, density management, and checks of lines and fouling organisms. Excessive density may affect light and water flow, but adjustments follow the plan rather than one universal number. Record and report color changes or tissue damage. Adapt harvesting, drying, or storage to the product and prevent contamination from equipment and the work area.

english_text: Harvest readiness depends on stock condition, quality targets, treatment status, market needs, and handling facilities. Do not assume one withholding period applies to every case. Prepare clean equipment and containers, work from a safe position, and use trained handling methods to reduce injury and quality loss.

source_text: Hasil budidaya ditangani dengan wadah, air, es, serta area yang sesuai produk. Jalur bersih dipisahkan dari limbah, bahan kimia, dan alat tercemar. Pendinginan atau proses lain mengikuti kebutuhan komoditas; bahan hidup, ikan segar, kerang, dan rumput laut dapat memerlukan penanganan berbeda. Jangan menyamakan suhu atau metode untuk semuanya. Catatan waktu dan kondisi mendukung penilaian jika terjadi penyimpangan. Lot yang meragukan dipisahkan agar keputusan tidak hanya berdasarkan bau atau warna.
english_text: Handle aquaculture products using containers, water, ice, and areas suitable for each product. Keep clean routes separate from waste, chemicals, and contaminated equipment. Cooling and other processes must meet the commodity's needs; live stock, fresh fish, shellfish, and seaweed may require different handling. Do not use one temperature or method for everything. Time and condition records support assessment when deviations occur. Separate questionable lots so decisions are not based only on odor or color.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Wadah bersih tercampur dengan alat bekas menangani kematian. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: pisahkan dan proses alat sesuai higiene sebelum kontak produk. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Cocokkan produk dengan metode penanganan; Periksa kebersihan alat dan area; Pantau kondisi penyimpanan sesuai spesifikasi; Labeli lot serta laporkan penyimpangan. Catat kondisi sebelum dan sesudah tindakan, lokasi atau kelompok yang terdampak, waktu pengamatan, serta siapa yang diberi laporan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. Angka target, dosis produk, setelan alat, dan batas cuaca mengikuti instruksi lokasi, label, serta jenis tanaman atau hewan; contoh belajar bukan angka universal.
english_text: Consider this work situation: A clean container has been mixed with equipment used to handle mortalities. Recommended decision: separate and sanitize the equipment before it contacts the product. Follow an orderly process: match the product to its handling method; inspect the cleanliness of equipment and work area; monitor storage conditions against specifications; label the lot and report deviations. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. If the result differs from the plan, stop the risky part and ask the person in charge for direction before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the species; practice examples are not universal values.

english_text: Follow standard procedures and stay within your authority. Moving machinery, chemicals, veterinary medicines, work in water, and emergencies require training and authorized personnel. Do not guess a dose or carry out a hazardous task based only on written materials.

source_text: Laporan unit memuat spesies atau kelompok, waktu, parameter air, pakan aktual, mortalitas, pemindahan, serta tindakan yang telah disetujui. 給餌量 adalah jumlah pakan dan 水温 adalah suhu air. Ketidakjelasan satuan dapat mengubah keputusan; minta pengulangan dan konfirmasikan angka sebelum tindakan. Bedakan data ukur dari perkiraan. Ujian resmi budi daya menggunakan bahasa Jepang, sedangkan materi ini memberi jembatan Indonesia dengan kosakata dan kasus. Pemahaman tertulis tidak menggantikan pelatihan pengukuran, alat, atau keselamatan kerja di air.
english_text: Unit reports include species or lot, time, water parameters, actual feed, mortality, transfers, and approved actions. 給餌量 means “feed amount,” and 水温 means “water temperature.” Unclear units can change a decision; ask for repetition and confirm figures before acting. Distinguish measured data from estimates. The official aquaculture examination is in Japanese, while this material provides an Indonesian bridge through vocabulary and cases. Reading comprehension does not replace training in measurement, equipment, or water-work safety.

source_text: Bayangkan kondisi kerja berikut: Instruksi berbunyi 「水温を確認してください」. Keputusan yang dianjurkan adalah: periksa suhu air sesuai metode yang ditetapkan. Lakukan alur secara teratur: Baca unit waktu parameter dan satuan; Konfirmasikan instruksi yang belum jelas; Catat hasil aktual secara objektif; Serahkan laporan dan tugas tindak lanjut. Catat kondisi sebelum dan sesudah tindakan, lokasi atau kelompok yang terdampak, waktu pengamatan, serta siapa yang diberi laporan. Jika hasil berbeda dari rencana, hentikan bagian yang berisiko dan minta arahan penanggung jawab sebelum mengubah metode. Angka target, dosis produk, setelan alat, dan batas cuaca mengikuti instruksi lokasi, label, serta jenis tanaman atau hewan; contoh belajar bukan angka universal.
english_text: Consider this work situation: The instruction says 「水温を確認してください」 (“Please check the water temperature”). Recommended decision: check the water temperature using the specified method. Follow an orderly process: read the parameter, time unit, and measurement unit; clarify any unclear instruction; record the actual result objectively; hand over the report and follow-up task. Record conditions before and after the action, the affected location or group, observation time, and who received the report. If the result differs from the plan, stop the risky part and ask the person in charge for direction before changing the method. Target values, product doses, equipment settings, and weather limits depend on site instructions, product labels, and the species; practice examples are not universal values.

source_text: Pekerja dapat membawa cemaran lewat tangan, rambut, pakaian, atau luka. Pemeriksaan awal membantu menemukan demam, diare, muntah, luka, atau pakaian kotor sebelum produk terpapar. Ikuti rencana higiene fasilitas: pekerja melapor, lalu penanggung jawab menentukan tugas yang aman.
english_text: Workers can carry contaminants on their hands, hair, clothing, or wounds. An entry check can identify fever, diarrhea, vomiting, wounds, or dirty clothing before products are exposed. Follow the facility's hygiene plan: report the issue, and let the person in charge assign safe duties.

source_text:
Sebelum masuk, baca papan instruksi, simpan barang pribadi, ganti pakaian sesuai zona, tutup rambut, dan periksa perlengkapan. Bila merasa tidak sehat atau penutup luka lepas, hentikan tugas yang bersentuhan dengan pangan dan beri tahu pemimpin. Jangan menutupi masalah kesehatan demi target produksi.

Kasus latihan: Sebelum giliran dimulai, seorang pekerja mengalami diare dan akan memakai sarung tangan untuk mengemas produk siap makan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Laporkan gejala kepada pemimpin dan jangan menangani pangan; tunggu penetapan tugas aman sesuai prosedur fasilitas.
english_text:
Before entering, read the posted instructions, store personal items, change clothing according to the zone, cover your hair, and check your equipment. If you feel unwell or a wound dressing comes loose, stop tasks involving food and tell the leader. Do not hide a health problem to meet production targets.

Practice scenario: Before the shift begins, a worker has diarrhea and plans to wear gloves while packaging ready-to-eat product.
Suggested response: Report the symptoms to the leader and do not handle food; wait to be assigned safe duties under facility procedures.

source_text: Tangan dapat memindahkan kotoran atau mikroorganisme dari toilet, sampah, uang, bahan mentah, telepon, dan permukaan ke pangan. Sarung tangan sekali pakai juga dapat tercemar dan bukan pengganti cuci tangan. Rencana fasilitas menentukan urutan cuci, pengeringan, sanitasi, serta kapan sarung tangan harus diganti.
english_text: Hands can transfer dirt or microorganisms from toilets, waste, money, raw ingredients, phones, and surfaces to food. Disposable gloves can also become contaminated and do not replace handwashing. The facility's plan specifies the washing, drying, and sanitizing steps and when gloves must be changed.

source_text:
Cuci tangan sebelum mulai, setelah dari toilet, setelah menyentuh bahan mentah atau sampah, dan ketika berpindah dari tugas kotor ke tugas bersih. Lepas sarung tangan tanpa menyentuh pangan, buang sesuai aturan, cuci tangan, lalu gunakan pasangan baru. Ikuti pencatatan yang diminta.

Kasus latihan: Pekerja menyentuh gagang tempat sampah dengan sarung tangan, lalu hendak mengisi wadah produk siap makan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan lanjut mengisi. Buang sarung tangan, cuci tangan sesuai prosedur, dan kenakan sarung tangan baru sebelum kembali ke produk.
english_text:
Wash your hands before starting, after using the toilet, after touching raw ingredients or waste, and when moving from a dirty task to a clean one. Remove gloves without touching food, discard them as required, wash your hands, and put on a new pair. Complete any required records.

Practice scenario: A worker touches a waste-bin handle with gloves and then prepares to fill a container with ready-to-eat product.
Suggested response: Do not continue filling. Remove the gloves, wash your hands as required, and put on new gloves before handling the product again.

source_text: Pembersihan mengangkat sisa pangan dan kotoran; sanitasi dilakukan menurut prosedur setelah tahap pembersihan yang diwajibkan. Alat yang terlihat bersih belum tentu siap dipakai. Penanda, lokasi simpan, dan jadwal fasilitas menunjukkan status alat serta batas antara area bahan mentah, proses, dan produk siap makan.
english_text: Cleaning removes food residue and soil; sanitize according to procedure after the required cleaning steps. Equipment that looks clean is not necessarily ready to use. Facility markers, storage locations, and schedules show equipment status and boundaries between raw-material, processing, and ready-to-eat areas.

source_text:
Sebelum mulai, periksa label status dan kondisi alat. Setelah tugas kotor, kirim alat ke tempat pencucian yang benar; jangan taruh kembali di rak alat bersih. Jika wadah bersih jatuh atau terkena percikan dari area kotor, pisahkan dan minta penilaian ulang. Simpan bahan kimia pembersih terpisah dari pangan.

Kasus latihan: Wadah berlabel bersih jatuh ke lantai dekat area bahan mentah; pekerja ingin segera menggunakannya kembali.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan wadah itu sebagai belum siap pakai dan minta pencucian serta sanitasi ulang sesuai aturan fasilitas.
english_text:
Before starting, check equipment status labels and condition. After a dirty task, send tools to the correct wash area; do not put them back on the clean-equipment shelf. If a clean container falls or is splashed from a dirty area, set it aside and request a reassessment. Keep cleaning chemicals separate from food.

Practice scenario: A container marked clean falls on the floor near the raw-ingredient area, and a worker wants to reuse it immediately.
Suggested response: Set the container aside as not ready for use and request washing and sanitizing again according to facility rules.

english_text: Receiving links suppliers, ingredients, and lots to the finished product. Acceptance criteria come from ingredient specifications and facility plans; hold nonconforming items for a decision by the person in charge.

Suggested response: Set the problem box aside, record the quantity and visible lot number, and ask the person in charge to decide whether to accept it.

source_text: Setiap bahan memiliki syarat penyimpanan yang ditentukan oleh produk, spesifikasi, dan sistem kendali fasilitas. Suhu ruang pendingin atau pembeku dipantau dengan alat dan batas tertulis; tidak ada satu angka umum yang cocok untuk semua produk. Bahan mentah dan produk siap makan juga dipisahkan untuk mencegah tetesan atau sentuhan silang.
english_text: Each ingredient has storage requirements set by the product, specification, and facility control system. Monitor refrigerator and freezer temperatures with the specified instruments and written limits; there is no single value that applies to every product. Separate raw ingredients from ready-to-eat products to prevent drips or contact.

source_text:
Periksa label penyimpanan, gunakan rak dan wadah bertanda, lalu catat pembacaan alat ukur pada waktu yang ditentukan. Jika suhu melewati batas, pintu terbuka lama, atau alat ukur meragukan, tahan lot dan laporkan. Jangan mengubah setelan atau menetapkan sendiri bahwa bahan masih aman.

Kasus latihan: Catatan ruang pendingin menunjukkan suhu di atas batas kerja pada formulir, tetapi satu lot akan segera dipakai.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tahan lot yang terdampak, catat waktu dan pembacaan, lalu laporkan agar penanggung jawab menentukan penanganannya.
english_text:
Check storage labels, use marked shelves and containers, and record instrument readings at designated times. If temperature exceeds a limit, a door has been left open, or an instrument is questionable, hold the lot and report it. Do not change settings or decide on your own that the ingredients are still safe.

Practice scenario: Cold-room records show a temperature above the form's operating limit, but a lot is about to be used.
Suggested response: Hold the affected lot, record the time and reading, and report it so the person in charge can determine how to handle it.

source_text: Resep produksi mengendalikan komposisi, hasil, mutu, dan informasi alergen. Timbangan harus sesuai satuan kerja, wadah tara diperhitungkan, dan bahan ditambahkan pada urutan yang ditetapkan. Pergantian formula atau substitusi bukan keputusan pekerja lini kecuali disetujui dan dicatat oleh pihak berwenang.
english_text: The production recipe controls composition, yield, quality, and allergen information. Use scales suited to the required units, account for container tare, and add ingredients in the specified order. Line workers may not change a recipe or substitute ingredients unless an authorized person approves and records the change.

source_text:
Cocokkan nama bahan dan lot dengan lembar formula sebelum membuka kemasan. Timbang satu bahan pada satu waktu, catat nilai aktual, lalu tandai langkah yang selesai. Bila angka, label, atau jumlah tidak sesuai, hentikan pencampuran dan minta pemeriksaan kedua; jangan menambahkan bahan pengganti dari stok terdekat.

Kasus latihan: Lembar formula meminta bubuk bahan A, tetapi wadah di meja berlabel bahan B dan pekerja belum mulai menimbang.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan mulai pencampuran. Pisahkan wadah, cocokkan identitas dengan daftar bahan, dan minta konfirmasi penanggung jawab.
english_text:
Before opening a package, match the ingredient name and lot to the recipe sheet. Weigh one ingredient at a time, record the actual value, and mark each completed step. If a number, label, or quantity does not match, stop mixing and request a second check; do not substitute a nearby stock item.

Practice scenario: The recipe calls for ingredient A powder, but the container on the table is labeled ingredient B, and weighing has not started.
Suggested response: Do not start mixing. Set the container aside, match its identity to the ingredient list, and ask the person in charge to confirm.

source_text: Mesin pangan seperti pengaduk, pemotong, dan konveyor dapat menjepit atau melukai. Pemeriksaan sebelum kerja memastikan pelindung, tombol darurat, kabel, dan area bebas dari alat lepas. Pengoperasian dan pembersihan hanya dilakukan oleh pekerja yang telah mendapat instruksi; isolasi energi dan perbaikan mengikuti prosedur serta kewenangan setempat.
english_text: Food-processing machines such as mixers, cutters, and conveyors can trap or injure workers. Before work, check guards, emergency stops, cables, and the area for loose tools. Only instructed workers may operate or clean equipment; energy isolation and repairs follow local procedures and authorization.

source_text:
Bandingkan kondisi mesin dengan daftar pemeriksaan awal. Bila pelindung longgar, bunyi atau getaran tidak biasa, atau tombol tidak dapat diuji sesuai instruksi, jangan jalankan mesin. Pasang tanda bila diwajibkan dan panggil penanggung jawab atau teknisi. Jangan memasukkan tangan ke bagian bergerak untuk mengatasi sumbatan.

Kasus latihan: Pelindung pada pengaduk terasa longgar, tetapi lini sedang mengejar jumlah produksi.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan menyalakan pengaduk. Jauhkan orang dari area berbahaya dan beri tahu pemimpin agar mesin diperiksa.
english_text:
Compare the machine with the startup checklist. Do not run it if a guard is loose, there is unusual noise or vibration, or a control cannot be tested as instructed. Post a sign if required and call the person in charge or a technician. Never put your hand near moving parts to clear a blockage.

Practice scenario: A mixer guard feels loose, but the line is trying to meet its production target.
Suggested response: Do not start the mixer. Keep people away from the danger area and tell the leader so the machine can be inspected.

source_text: Pemanasan, pendinginan, pencampuran, dan proses lain memiliki parameter yang ditetapkan untuk produk tertentu. Pekerja memeriksa instruksi lot, memakai alat yang disyaratkan, dan mencatat hasil aktual pada titik pengawasan. Jika pembacaan di luar batas atau alat gagal, produk sejak pemeriksaan terakhir mungkin perlu ditahan untuk penilaian.
english_text: Heating, cooling, mixing, and other processes have parameters set for specific products. Check the lot instructions, use required instruments, and record actual results at monitoring points. If a reading is outside limits or an instrument fails, product made since the last check may need to be held for assessment.

source_text:
Sebelum proses, pastikan kode produk, setelan, dan alat ukur cocok dengan instruksi. Catat waktu mulai, pembacaan, dan identitas lot tanpa membulatkan angka untuk menutupi selisih. Saat alarm berbunyi atau batas terlampaui, hentikan alur sesuai instruksi, tandai produk terdampak, dan laporkan segera.

Kasus latihan: Catatan pemanasan menunjukkan pembacaan belum mencapai batas pada instruksi produk, tetapi baki berikutnya sudah menunggu.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan pelepasan lot, tahan produk yang terdampak, catat pembacaan dan waktu, lalu minta keputusan penanggung jawab.
english_text:
Before processing, verify that the product code, settings, and measuring instruments match the instructions. Record the start time, readings, and lot identity without rounding to hide a discrepancy. When an alarm sounds or a limit is exceeded, stop the line as instructed, mark affected product, and report it immediately.

Practice scenario: Heating records show a reading below the limit in the product instructions, but the next trays are waiting.
Suggested response: Stop lot release, hold affected products, record the reading and time, and ask the person in charge to decide what to do.

source_text: Alergen dapat berpindah melalui sisa bahan di mesin, meja, sarung tangan, alat ukur, atau kemasan. Daftar alergen dan informasi label dapat berubah mengikuti ketentuan terkini; pekerja memakai spesifikasi produk dan matriks yang berlaku di fasilitas. Pergantian produksi memerlukan persetujuan, pembersihan sesuai prosedur, serta pemeriksaan ulang label dan identitas lot.
english_text: Allergens can transfer through residue on machines, tables, gloves, measuring tools, or packaging. Allergen lists and label information may change under current requirements; use the product specifications and matrix in force at your facility. Production changeovers require approval, cleaning according to procedure, and another check of labels and lot identity.

source_text:
Saat berganti ke produk dengan profil alergen berbeda, tahan awal produksi sampai prosedur pergantian selesai. Periksa alat yang ditetapkan, bahan dan label baru, lalu minta pemeriksaan silang bila diwajibkan. Bila label tertukar atau residu terlihat, hentikan lini, pisahkan produk sejak titik terakhir yang diyakini benar, dan laporkan; jangan menjanjikan produk bebas alergen tanpa data resmi.

Kasus latihan: Setelah produk yang memakai susu, gulungan label produk tanpa susu dipasang sebelum catatan pembersihan pergantian selesai.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan lini dan tahan produk sejak pergantian label; laporkan urutan kejadian dan tunggu pemeriksaan pembersihan serta label.
english_text:
When changing to a product with a different allergen profile, hold startup until the changeover procedure is complete. Check designated equipment, new ingredients, and labels, and request a second check if required. If labels are mixed up or residue is visible, stop the line, separate product made since the last known-correct point, and report it. Do not promise an allergen-free product without official data.

Practice scenario: After a product containing milk, a label roll for a milk-free product is installed before the changeover cleaning record is complete.
Suggested response: Stop the line and hold product from the label change onward; report the sequence of events and wait for cleaning and label checks.

source_text: Kemasan melindungi pangan; label menyampaikan identitas dan informasi penting kepada pengguna. Karena itu, gulungan label, kemasan, dan produk harus sesuai dengan rencana produksi. Salah label dapat membuat informasi produk dan alergen keliru walaupun isi kemasan benar. Pemeriksaan dilakukan saat mulai, saat bahan kemas berganti, dan pada titik lain yang ditetapkan fasilitas.
english_text: Packaging protects food, and labels provide consumers with product identity and important information. Label rolls, packages, and products must therefore match the production plan. A wrong label can misstate product or allergen information even when the contents are correct. Check labels at startup, when packaging materials change, and at other points set by the facility.

source_text:
Baca kode pada lembar kerja dan kemasan, lalu cocokkan dengan sampel label yang disetujui. Periksa tanggal cetak, keterbacaan, segel, dan arah label. Kasus latihan: Kode label pada gulungan baru berbeda satu angka dari lembar produksi; beberapa bungkus sudah dibuat.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan pengemasan, tahan bungkus sejak titik pemeriksaan terakhir, catat jumlah dan kode, lalu laporkan untuk pemeriksaan ulang.
english_text:
Read the code on the work sheet and package, then compare it with the approved label sample. Check the print date, legibility, seal, and label orientation. If anything differs, stop packaging, hold product made since the last satisfactory check, record the code and quantity, and ask the person in charge to arrange a recheck.

Practice scenario: The label code on a new roll differs by one digit from the production sheet, and several packages have already been made.
Suggested response: Stop packaging, hold packages made since the last check, record the quantity and code, and report them for reinspection.

source_text: Pemeriksaan visual dan alat pemeriksa yang ditetapkan membantu menemukan kemasan rusak, perubahan warna, bagian yang hilang, atau benda asing. Kriteria penerimaan berbeda menurut jenis produk. Pekerja mengikuti sampel standar dan batas fasilitas, bukan menilai sendiri bahwa cacat aman. Perangkat pemeriksa tidak boleh dilewati atau disetel tanpa otorisasi.
english_text: Visual checks and designated inspection devices help detect damaged packaging, discoloration, missing parts, or foreign objects. Acceptance criteria vary by product. Follow standard samples and facility limits; do not decide on your own that a defect is safe. Do not bypass or adjust inspection devices without authorization.

source_text:
Saat menemukan benda asing atau alarm alat pemeriksa, hentikan aliran sesuai instruksi dan gunakan wadah tahan yang beridentitas. Catat waktu, mesin, produk, lot, serta jumlah sejak cek terakhir yang diterima. Jangan buang barang bukti atau memasukkan produk yang sama kembali ke aliran sebelum penilaian dilakukan.

Kasus latihan: Seorang pekerja melihat serpihan plastik di dekat produk di konveyor dan tidak tahu apakah serpihan berasal dari kemasan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan atau tahan aliran sesuai instruksi, pisahkan produk terkait, dan laporkan lokasi serta waktu temuan untuk pemeriksaan.
english_text:
If you find a foreign object or an inspection-device alarm occurs, stop the line as instructed and use an identified hold container. Record the time, machine, product, lot, and quantity since the last accepted check. Do not discard evidence or put the same product back into the line before assessment.

Practice scenario: A worker sees a plastic fragment near a product on the conveyor and does not know whether it came from the packaging.
Suggested response: Stop or hold the line as instructed, separate the affected products, and report where and when the item was found for inspection.

source_text: Catatan produksi menghubungkan bahan, parameter, pemeriksaan, kemasan, dan hasil lot. Catatan harus berisi fakta aktual, waktu, identitas produk, serta tindakan yang dilakukan. Pada pergantian giliran, status barang tahan, mesin bermasalah, dan pemeriksaan yang belum selesai perlu disampaikan lisan dan tertulis menurut sistem fasilitas.
english_text: Production records link ingredients, parameters, inspections, packaging, and lot results. Record actual facts, times, product identity, and actions taken. At shift change, communicate the status of held items, faulty machines, and unfinished checks verbally and in writing according to the facility's system.

source_text:
Isi formulir saat pekerjaan dilakukan, bukan dari ingatan di akhir giliran. Jangan menghapus nilai yang salah; ikuti cara koreksi resmi agar perubahan terlihat. Saat serah terima, sebutkan nomor lot, lokasi barang tahan, alasan, hasil yang sudah dicek, dan siapa yang perlu menindaklanjuti. Minta penerima mengulang poin penting bila belum jelas.

Kasus latihan: Pada akhir giliran, satu lot masih menunggu pemeriksaan label, tetapi pekerja berikutnya hanya menerima catatan jumlah produksi.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tambahkan status lot, lokasi tahan, alasan dan pemeriksaan terbuka sesuai aturan koreksi, lalu serahkan langsung kepada penerima giliran.
english_text:
Complete forms as work is performed rather than from memory at shift end. Do not erase an incorrect value; use the official correction method so the change remains visible. During handover, state the lot number, hold location and reason, checks already completed, and who must follow up. Ask the recipient to repeat key points if anything is unclear.

Practice scenario: At shift end, a lot is still awaiting a label check, but the next worker receives only the production quantity record.
Suggested response: Record the lot status, hold location, reason, and outstanding check according to correction rules, then hand it over directly to the next shift.

english_text: Health and Preparation Before a Shift

source_text: Melaporkan gejala sakit dan menyiapkan seragam, rambut, kuku, serta perlengkapan sebelum menangani makanan.
english_text: Report illness symptoms and prepare your uniform, hair, nails, and equipment before handling food.

source_text: Pekerja restoran menyentuh bahan, alat, piring, dan permukaan yang digunakan pelanggan. Gejala seperti demam, diare, atau muntah serta luka pada tangan dapat meningkatkan risiko cemaran. Setiap tempat memiliki aturan pelaporan dan penugasan; pekerja memberi tahu pemimpin agar tugas aman ditentukan sebelum mulai.
english_text: Restaurant workers handle ingredients, tools, dishes, and surfaces used by customers. Symptoms such as fever, diarrhea, or vomiting, as well as hand injuries, can increase contamination risks. Each workplace has reporting and task-assignment rules; tell the supervisor so safe duties can be assigned before work begins.

source_text:
Sebelum giliran, ganti seragam, tutup rambut, simpan barang pribadi, dan periksa tangan serta kondisi tubuh. Bila merasa sakit saat bekerja, berhenti menangani makanan dan beri tahu pemimpin. Jangan menyembunyikan gejala atau hanya memakai sarung tangan untuk meneruskan tugas yang berisiko.

Kasus latihan: Sebelum menyiapkan salad, seorang pekerja merasa mual dan muntah sejak pagi, tetapi restoran sedang ramai.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Beri tahu pemimpin, jangan menyiapkan makanan, dan tunggu penetapan tugas sesuai prosedur restoran.
english_text:
Before your shift, change into your uniform, cover your hair, store personal belongings, and check your hands and general condition. If you feel ill while working, stop handling food and tell the supervisor. Do not hide symptoms or simply put on gloves to continue a risky task.

Practice scenario: Before preparing a salad, a worker feels nauseated and has been vomiting since morning, but the restaurant is busy.
Recommended response: Tell the supervisor, do not prepare food, and wait for a task assignment according to restaurant procedures.

source_text: Cuci tangan dan pisahkan bahan mentah
english_text: Wash Hands and Separate Raw Ingredients

source_text: Mencuci tangan pada saat yang tepat dan mencegah alat atau tangan memindahkan cemaran ke makanan siap makan.
english_text: Wash your hands at the right times and prevent tools or hands from transferring contamination to ready-to-eat food.

source_text: Memilih tindakan aman pada satu situasi kerja dan menjelaskan alasannya.
english_text: Choose a safe action in a work situation and explain why.

source_text: Tangan, pisau, talenan, dan meja dapat memindahkan cemaran dari bahan mentah ke makanan yang tidak dimasak lagi. Cuci tangan setelah menyentuh daging mentah, sampah, toilet, uang, telepon, atau tugas pembersihan. Sarung tangan yang sama juga dapat memindahkan cemaran; ikuti aturan pergantian dan pemisahan alat restoran.
english_text: Hands, knives, cutting boards, and counters can transfer contamination from raw ingredients to food that will not be cooked again. Wash your hands after touching raw meat, waste, toilets, money, phones, or cleaning tasks. The same gloves can also spread contamination; follow the restaurant's rules for changing gloves and separating equipment.

source_text:
Simpan bahan dan talenan sesuai label atau warna yang ditetapkan restoran. Setelah menyiapkan daging mentah, hentikan tugas, cuci tangan, ganti sarung tangan jika digunakan, dan gunakan permukaan yang telah dibersihkan untuk makanan siap makan. Jika alat bersih terkena cairan mentah, pisahkan dan minta pencucian ulang.

Kasus latihan: Setelah memotong ayam mentah, pekerja mengambil irisan tomat dengan sarung tangan yang sama untuk salad.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan penyajian salad, pisahkan alat dan bahan yang mungkin terkena, cuci tangan, lalu beri tahu pemimpin untuk penanganan ulang.
english_text:
Store ingredients and cutting boards according to the restaurant's labels or color coding. After preparing raw meat, stop, wash your hands, change gloves if worn, and use a cleaned surface for ready-to-eat food. If a clean tool is exposed to raw juices, set it aside and request rewashing.

Practice scenario: After cutting raw chicken, a worker uses the same gloves to pick up tomato slices for a salad.
Recommended response: Stop serving the salad, separate tools and ingredients that may be affected, wash your hands, and tell the supervisor so they can be handled again.

source_text: Bahan dingin, panas, dan makanan siap saji memiliki syarat penyimpanan sesuai produk dan rencana restoran. Pekerja menggunakan termometer dan batas yang ditulis untuk bahan tersebut, bukan mengandalkan sentuhan atau angka hafalan. Penutup wadah, label waktu, dan pemisahan bahan membantu menjaga keamanan dan mutu selama giliran.
english_text: Cold, hot, and ready-to-eat foods have storage requirements based on the product and restaurant plan. Use a thermometer and the limits written for that ingredient rather than relying on touch or memorized numbers. Container lids, time labels, and ingredient separation help maintain safety and quality during a shift.

english_text:
Check the temperature with the designated instrument, clean the probe according to procedure, and record the time and result. Keep containers covered with readable identification. If the temperature or time exceeds restaurant limits, a label is missing, or equipment does not work, hold the ingredient and ask the supervisor to decide what to do next.

Practice scenario: Soup ready to be served has no time label, and the station thermometer is displaying an error.
Recommended response: Do not serve the soup. Hold the container, report the missing label and faulty instrument, and wait for an inspection according to procedure.

Makanan siap makan dipisahkan dari bahan mentah; pisau, panas, dan alat listrik digunakan hanya sesuai pelatihan.
english_text: Organized preparation reduces ingredient mix-ups, waiting, and repeated movements during busy service. Check the recipe, portions, tools, and ingredient condition before setting up a station. Keep ready-to-eat food separate from raw ingredients; use knives, heat, and electrical equipment only within your training.

source_text:

Kasus latihan: Tiket memesan sup sayur, tetapi wadah di stasiun tidak berlabel dan isinya tidak dapat dikenali.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan gunakan isi wadah. Pisahkan dan minta identifikasi dari pemimpin sebelum menyiapkan pesanan.
english_text:
Arrange ingredients in labeled containers, take only what is needed for the shift, and store the rest as required. Read tickets carefully; if a note is unreadable, confirm it before cooking. Clean spills promptly without contaminating ingredients or making the floor slippery.

Practice scenario: The ticket is for vegetable soup, but an unlabelled container at the station has unidentified contents.
Recommended response: Do not use the contents. Set the container aside and ask the supervisor to identify them before preparing the order.

source_text: Alergi makanan dapat menimbulkan reaksi serius. Informasi bahan dan risiko kontak silang dapat berbeda menurut menu, pemasok, serta cara memasak. Pelayan memakai panduan alergi restoran yang terbaru dan bertanya kepada pihak berwenang bila jawaban tidak jelas; jangan menebak dari nama hidangan atau menjamin bahwa hidangan bebas alergen tanpa dasar.
english_text: Food allergies can cause serious reactions. Ingredient information and cross-contact risks can vary by menu, supplier, and cooking method. Use the restaurant's current allergy guide and ask an authorized person when an answer is unclear. Do not guess from a dish's name or claim it is allergen-free without confirmation.

source_text:
Dengarkan nama bahan yang dihindari, ulangi untuk memastikan, lalu periksa panduan atau sistem menu. Sampaikan jawaban yang diketahui dengan jelas; bila informasi tidak cukup, beri tahu pelanggan bahwa Anda akan memastikan dan segera hubungi pemimpin atau dapur. Jangan mengubah resep atau menyuruh dapur mengabaikan prosedur.

Kasus latihan: Pelanggan bertanya apakah saus mengandung kacang, tetapi daftar bahan di stasiun belum diperbarui.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan menebak. Katakan akan memeriksa, tahan rekomendasi hidangan, dan minta pemimpin memverifikasi informasi terbaru.
english_text:
Listen to the ingredient the customer needs to avoid, repeat it to confirm, then check the guide or menu system. Clearly share what is known. If the information is insufficient, tell the customer you will confirm it and contact the supervisor or kitchen right away. Do not change the recipe or ask the kitchen to ignore procedures.

Practice scenario: A customer asks whether a sauce contains peanuts, but the ingredient list at the station has not been updated.
Recommended response: Do not guess. Say you will check, hold off on recommending the dish, and ask the supervisor to verify the latest information.

source_text: Catatan seperti tanpa telur atau pisahkan saus mengubah cara dapur menyiapkan dan menyajikan hidangan. Tiket harus memuat perubahan dengan jelas dan terhubung ke meja atau nomor pesanan yang benar. Jika permintaan berkaitan dengan alergi, dapur memakai prosedur kontak silang yang sudah ditetapkan; perubahan kecil tidak boleh dianggap sepele.
english_text: Notes such as “no egg” or “sauce on the side” change how the kitchen prepares and serves a dish. The ticket must state the change clearly and be linked to the correct table or order number. For allergy-related requests, the kitchen follows established cross-contact procedures; do not treat small changes as unimportant.

source_text:
Ulangi perubahan kepada pelanggan, masukkan pada sistem atau tiket, lalu pastikan dapur menerima versi yang benar. Bila tiket tertukar atau modifikasi belum dikonfirmasi, tahan hidangan sebelum dibawa. Gunakan piring dan alat yang ditentukan untuk pesanan tersebut; jangan sekadar mengikis bahan dari hidangan jadi.

Kasus latihan: Pelanggan meminta hidangan tanpa telur karena alergi; tiket lama sudah masuk dapur tanpa catatan itu.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan bawa hidangan lama. Hentikan penyajian, beri tahu dapur dan pemimpin, lalu buat tiket yang benar dan ikuti prosedur alergi.
english_text:
Repeat the change to the customer, enter it in the system or ticket, and make sure the kitchen receives the correct version. If tickets are mixed up or a modification is unconfirmed, hold the dish before it is carried out. Use the plate and tools designated for the order; do not simply scrape an ingredient off a finished dish.

Practice scenario: A customer requests an egg-free dish because of an allergy, but the original ticket has already gone to the kitchen without that note.
Recommended response: Do not bring out the original dish. Stop service, tell the kitchen and supervisor, then create the correct ticket and follow allergy procedures.

Pekerja memakai salam sopan, menanyakan jumlah orang bila diperlukan, dan memastikan reservasi tanpa menyebut informasi pribadi dengan suara keras. Jalur pelayanan harus bebas dari kereta, barang, dan tumpahan agar tamu maupun staf dapat lewat dengan aman.
english_text: A warm greeting helps guests feel welcome and supports table flow. Greet guests politely, ask the party size when needed, and confirm reservations without saying personal information aloud. Keep service routes clear of carts, belongings, and spills so guests and staff can pass safely.

source_text:
Sapa tamu, dengarkan jawaban, lalu ulangi informasi penting seperti nama reservasi atau jumlah orang. Bila meja belum siap, jelaskan perkiraan hanya setelah memeriksa keadaan dan minta mereka menunggu di tempat yang ditentukan. Jangan menjanjikan meja tertentu tanpa konfirmasi sistem.

Greet guests, listen to their answers, and repeat important information such as the reservation name or party size. If a table is not ready, give an estimated wait only after checking and ask guests to wait in the designated area. Do not promise a particular table without confirming it in the system.

Practice scenario: Guests arrive without a reservation, and a recently vacated table has not yet been cleaned.
Recommended response: Greet them, explain that the table is being prepared, and ask them to wait in the designated area until the table is confirmed ready.

source_text: Pesanan mencakup hidangan, jumlah, pilihan ukuran, tingkat kematangan bila berlaku, dan permintaan khusus. Mengulang pesanan membantu menemukan salah dengar sebelum tiket dikirim. Bila kata atau pilihan tidak dipahami, pekerja bertanya dengan sopan dan menggunakan gambar menu atau nomor hidangan sebagai bantuan.
english_text: An order includes the dish, quantity, size, cooking level when applicable, and special requests. Repeating the order helps catch misunderstandings before sending the ticket. If a word or choice is unclear, ask politely and use the menu picture or dish number to help.

source_text:

Kasus latihan: Pelanggan memesan dua hidangan dan menyebut satu tanpa bawang, tetapi pekerja hanya mencatat nama hidangannya.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Konfirmasi kembali permintaan tanpa bawang, perbarui tiket meja yang benar, lalu pastikan dapur menerima catatan itu.
english_text:
Record orders promptly in the system or on a ticket for the correct table. Repeat the items and quantities, ask again about unclear choices, then send the ticket to the kitchen. Do not enter allergy notes as ordinary preferences; tell the supervisor and follow the restaurant's special procedure.

Practice scenario: A customer orders two dishes and requests one without onions, but the worker records only the dish names.
Recommended response: Confirm the no-onion request, update the ticket for the correct table, and make sure the kitchen receives the note.

source_text: Keluhan dapat berkaitan dengan hidangan salah, keterlambatan, mutu, alergi, atau keselamatan. Pekerja tetap tenang, mendengarkan tanpa berdebat, meminta maaf atas ketidaknyamanan, dan mengumpulkan fakta. Penggantian, pengembalian uang, atau penanganan insiden mengikuti wewenang restoran; masalah kesehatan segera diserahkan kepada pemimpin.
english_text: Complaints may concern an incorrect dish, delays, quality, allergies, or safety. Stay calm, listen without arguing, apologize for the inconvenience, and gather the facts. Replacements, refunds, and incident handling must follow the restaurant's authority rules; immediately refer health concerns to the supervisor.

source_text:
Ucapkan bahwa Anda akan memeriksa, ulangi masalah agar pelanggan merasa didengar, lalu hubungi pemimpin. Jangan menyalahkan dapur atau menjanjikan kompensasi yang tidak Anda berwenang berikan. Jika pelanggan merasa sakit atau ada kemungkinan bahaya makanan, hentikan penjualan hidangan terkait dan laporkan segera.

Kasus latihan: Pelanggan mengatakan setelah mencicipi hidangan, ia merasa tidak sehat dan ingin tahu siapa yang bertanggung jawab.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tanggapi dengan tenang, hentikan penyajian hidangan terkait, panggil pemimpin, dan catat waktu serta hidangan tanpa berspekulasi.
english_text:
Say that you will check, repeat the issue so the customer knows they were heard, then contact the supervisor. Do not blame the kitchen or promise compensation beyond your authority. If the customer feels ill or food may be unsafe, stop selling the related dish and report it immediately.

Practice scenario: After tasting a dish, a customer says they feel unwell and asks who is responsible.
Recommended response: Respond calmly, stop serving the dish, call the supervisor, and record the time and dish without speculation.

english_text: Accurate payment depends on the table bill, amount, payment method, and cashier procedures. Check the total in the system and explain charges clearly if customers ask. Recommended response: Check the transaction status in the system or ask the supervisor before retrying, so the customer is not charged twice.

Catatan pergantian giliran perlu menjelaskan stok rendah, alat rusak, bahan ditahan, atau tugas yang belum selesai.
english_text: Closing a restaurant includes cleaning tools and tables, storing ingredients, disposing of waste, and checking remaining tasks. Store ingredients according to their labels and required conditions; keep cleaning chemicals separate. Shift handover notes should identify low stock, damaged equipment, held ingredients, and unfinished tasks.

source_text:
Ikuti daftar penutupan dari area bersih ke area kotor dengan alat pembersih yang sesuai. Pastikan bahan dikemas, diberi identitas, dan ditempatkan di lokasi simpan yang benar. Sebelum pulang, sampaikan kekurangan stok atau masalah peralatan kepada penerima giliran; jangan menulis pekerjaan selesai bila belum dilakukan.

Kasus latihan: Pada akhir giliran, wadah bahan terbuka belum diberi label waktu dan pembersihan lemari pendingin belum dicatat.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan wadah untuk penilaian sesuai aturan, catat pembersihan yang belum selesai, dan serahkan kedua hal itu kepada pemimpin.
english_text:

Before leaving, tell the next shift about low stock or equipment problems; do not mark work complete if it has not been done.

Practice scenario: At the end of a shift, an open ingredient container has no time label and refrigerator cleaning has not been recorded.
Recommended response: Set the container aside for assessment according to rules, record the unfinished cleaning, and hand both items over to the supervisor.

english_text: Forestry includes forest maintenance and timber production, and daily tasks vary by site and plan. Weather, terrain, and distance from roads can change conditions; workers must not change routes or tasks on their own.

source_text: Medan hutan dapat memiliki lereng licin, akar, lubang, batu lepas, pohon mati, dan cabang menggantung. Pekerja memperhatikan area di atas dan di bawah, menjaga jarak, serta mengikuti jalur yang disetujui. Hujan, angin, kabut, atau kondisi gelap dapat mengubah risiko; penilaian ulang dilakukan bersama pemimpin.
english_text: Forest terrain may include slippery slopes, roots, holes, loose rocks, dead trees, and hanging branches. Watch the areas above and below, keep your distance, and use approved routes. Rain, wind, fog, or darkness can change the risks; reassess conditions with the leader.

source_text:
Berjalan dengan kecepatan yang memungkinkan melihat pijakan, jangan melewati bawah pohon atau cabang yang tampak tidak stabil, dan tandai bahaya sesuai aturan kru. Jika tanah bergerak atau jarak pandang turun, beri tahu tim dan tunggu arahan. Jangan mencoba memindahkan pohon atau batu berat sendirian.

Kasus latihan: Setelah hujan, jalur ke titik kerja memiliki tanah yang ambles dan satu cabang besar menggantung di atas lintasan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan melewati titik itu. Beri tanda atau jarak aman sesuai aturan kru dan laporkan agar pemimpin memilih jalur atau tindakan aman.
english_text:
Walk at a pace that lets you see where you are stepping. Do not pass beneath a tree or branch that appears unstable; mark hazards as the crew requires. If the ground shifts or visibility drops, notify the team and wait for instructions. Do not try to move a tree or heavy rock alone.

Practice scenario: After rain, the path to the work site has subsided ground, and a large branch hangs over the route.
Suggested response: Do not pass that point. Mark it or keep a safe distance as the crew requires, and report it so the leader can choose a safe route or action.

source_text: Pekerjaan kehutanan memiliki bahaya dari benda jatuh, alat tajam, mesin, kebisingan, cuaca, dan medan. Perlengkapan seperti helm, pelindung mata atau wajah, pelindung pendengaran, sarung tangan, sepatu kerja, dan pakaian pelindung dipilih menurut tugas dan aturan perusahaan. Tugas dengan gergaji mesin memerlukan pelatihan dan penetapan tugas yang sesuai.
english_text: Forestry work involves hazards from falling objects, sharp tools, machinery, noise, weather, and terrain. Select equipment such as a helmet, eye or face protection, hearing protection, gloves, work boots, and protective clothing according to the task and company rules. Chainsaw work requires suitable training and assignment.

source_text:
Sebelum bekerja, periksa kerusakan, ukuran, pengencang, dan kecocokan perlengkapan. Bila helm retak, tali rusak, atau pelindung tidak sesuai, jangan mulai; minta penggantian. Jangan meminjam atau mengoperasikan alat yang belum diajarkan kepada Anda, sekalipun rekan meminta bantuan cepat.

Kasus latihan: Rekan meminta pekerja baru menggunakan gergaji mesin, tetapi ia belum mengikuti pelatihan yang diwajibkan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tolak dengan sopan, jangan menyalakan gergaji, dan beri tahu pemimpin agar pekerjaan diberikan kepada orang yang berwenang.
english_text:
Before work, check equipment for damage, fit, fasteners, and suitability. If a helmet is cracked, a strap is damaged, or protection is unsuitable, do not start; request a replacement. Do not borrow or operate equipment you have not been trained to use, even if a coworker asks for quick help.

Practice scenario: A coworker asks a new worker to use a chainsaw, but the worker has not completed the required training.
Suggested response: Politely refuse, do not start the saw, and tell the leader so the task can be assigned to an authorized person.

english_text: Prepare planting plots according to plan and keep work routes from damaging soil or waterways.

source_text: Sebelum menanam, kru memastikan batas petak, jenis pekerjaan, jarak, alat, serta titik yang harus dihindari. Tanah dan vegetasi menjaga fungsi hutan; jalur yang tidak direncanakan dapat menyebabkan erosi atau kerusakan akar. Peta dan tanda lapangan harus dicocokkan sebelum area dibuka.
english_text: Before planting, confirm plot boundaries, the task, spacing, tools, and areas to avoid. Soil and vegetation help maintain forest functions; unplanned routes can cause erosion or damage roots. Match the map to field markers before opening an area.

source_text:
Ikuti tanda petak dan jalur yang telah ditunjukkan. Letakkan alat dengan aman, jaga saluran air dan area yang ditandai, lalu laporkan batas yang tidak terlihat atau berbeda dari peta. Jangan memperlebar jalur atau memindahkan tanda sendiri demi mempercepat pekerjaan.

Kasus latihan: Tanda batas petak tidak terlihat di satu sisi dan jalur kerja mengarah ke dekat aliran air.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Berhenti sebelum batas yang diragukan, hindari memasuki area dekat aliran, dan minta pemimpin mengonfirmasi peta serta tanda.
english_text:
Follow the plot markers and designated routes. Put tools down safely, protect waterways and marked areas, and report any boundary that is missing or differs from the map. Do not widen a route or move markers to speed up the work.

Practice scenario: A plot boundary marker is missing on one side, and the work route leads close to a stream.
Suggested response: Stop before the uncertain boundary, stay clear of the stream area, and ask the leader to confirm the map and markers.

source_text: Bibit yang sehat dan sesuai petak membantu tegakan tumbuh merata. Pekerja memeriksa jenis dan jumlah menurut catatan, menjaga akar tetap terlindung, serta mengikuti jarak atau tanda penanaman. Cara tanam mengikuti arahan teknis setempat; pekerja pemula tidak mengubah posisi, kedalaman, atau jenis tanpa bertanya.
english_text: Healthy seedlings suited to the plot help the stand grow evenly. Check their species and quantity against the records, protect their roots, and follow the specified spacing or planting marks. Follow local technical instructions; new workers must not change the position, depth, or species without asking.

source_text:
Pisahkan bibit yang kering, patah, atau tidak sesuai catatan lalu laporkan jumlahnya. Bawa bibit dengan cara yang tidak merusak akar, tanam pada titik yang ditandai, dan pastikan tanah menutup sesuai instruksi. Jika titik tertutup batu atau genangan, jangan memilih posisi baru sendiri; minta arahan.

Kasus latihan: Di satu bundel terdapat bibit dengan label jenis berbeda dari petak yang sedang ditanami.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan bundel itu, jangan tanam, dan minta pemimpin memastikan jenis bibit sebelum pekerjaan dilanjutkan.
english_text:
Set aside dry, broken, or record-mismatched seedlings and report the quantity. Carry them without damaging the roots, plant at marked points, and cover them with soil as instructed. If a point is blocked by a rock or standing water, do not choose a new position yourself; ask for guidance.

Practice scenario: A bundle contains seedlings labeled as a different species from the one assigned to the plot.
Suggested response: Set the bundle aside, do not plant it, and ask the leader to verify the species before work resumes.

source_text: Pemeliharaan dapat meliputi membersihkan vegetasi pengganggu atau merawat tegakan sesuai rencana. Tanda petak dan instruksi menentukan tanaman mana yang dipertahankan; pekerja menjaga jarak aman dari rekan yang menggunakan alat. Pergerakan alat, lereng, dan vegetasi rapat memerlukan komunikasi sebelum mulai atau berpindah.
english_text: Maintenance may involve clearing unwanted vegetation or caring for a stand according to plan. Plot markers and instructions show which plants to keep. Maintain a safe distance from coworkers using tools. Communicate before starting or moving equipment on slopes or through dense vegetation.

source_text:
Sebelum membersihkan, identifikasi tanaman sasaran dan yang harus dibiarkan. Pastikan rekan mengetahui posisi Anda, gunakan alat sesuai pelatihan, dan berhenti jika seseorang masuk ke zona kerja. Bila tanda tidak jelas atau ada bibit yang rusak, tandai lokasi dan laporkan, jangan meneruskan berdasarkan tebakan.

Kasus latihan: Tanda tanaman sasaran tertutup semak, sementara seorang rekan bergerak di sisi lereng yang sama.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan alat, panggil rekan dan pemimpin, lalu pastikan batas sasaran serta jarak aman sebelum bekerja lagi.
english_text:
Before clearing vegetation, identify the target plants and those that must remain. Make sure coworkers know your position, use tools only as trained, and stop if someone enters the work zone. If a marker is unclear or a seedling is damaged, mark the location and report it; do not proceed by guessing.

Practice scenario: Brush covers the target-plant marker while a coworker is moving on the same slope.
Suggested response: Stop the tool, call the coworker and leader, and confirm the target boundary and safe distance before resuming.

source_text: Penebangan dan pengolahan kayu melibatkan pohon yang dapat jatuh, dahan, dan alat bertenaga. Rencana kerja dan pengaturan zona menentukan siapa boleh berada di mana; pekerja menjaga jarak sesuai arahan dan memakai komunikasi yang disepakati. Metode penebangan hanya dilakukan oleh orang dengan pelatihan dan penugasan yang sesuai.
english_text: Tree felling and timber processing involve falling trees, branches, and powered equipment. The work plan and zone controls specify where each person may be; keep the instructed distance and use agreed communication. Only workers with the required training and assignment may fell trees.

source_text:
Sebelum mendekati lokasi, pastikan kru memberi tanda bahwa area aman untuk lewat. Bila tidak melihat pekerja atau tidak menerima isyarat yang dipahami, berhenti di batas dan hubungi pemimpin. Jangan mencoba menilai arah jatuh atau mendekati pohon yang masih bergerak.

Kasus latihan: Pekerja perlu mengambil alat di sisi lain zona, tetapi tidak melihat kru dan tidak mendengar tanda aman.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tetap di luar batas, hubungi pemimpin melalui cara yang ditetapkan, dan masuk hanya setelah menerima izin yang jelas.
english_text:
Before approaching, make sure the crew has signaled that the area is safe to cross. If you cannot see the workers or have not received a signal you understand, stop at the boundary and contact the leader. Do not try to predict a tree's fall direction or approach a tree that is still moving.

Practice scenario: A worker needs to retrieve a tool on the other side of a zone but cannot see the crew or hear an all-clear signal.
Suggested response: Stay outside the boundary, contact the leader using the designated method, and enter only after receiving clear permission.

source_text: Hasil produksi perlu dikenali menurut petak, jenis, ukuran, atau tujuan sesuai sistem perusahaan. Penandaan menghubungkan kayu dengan catatan dan membantu pemindahan berikutnya. english_text: Identify production output by plot, species, size, or destination according to the company's system. Marking links timber to its records and supports later handling. Measure or mark items only by the method you were taught; do not change the grade or destination yourself.

Kasus latihan: Satu batang kayu di tempat pengumpulan tidak memiliki tanda petak, sementara dua kelompok dari petak berbeda sedang disiapkan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan batang itu di tempat tahan, catat lokasi dan kondisi, lalu minta pemimpin menelusuri identitas sebelum dimuat.
english_text:
Before moving timber, match its label or mark to the work records. Set aside unmarked or mismatched material at the designated location. Record the actual quantity and visible condition, then ask the leader to confirm its destination group. Do not combine timber from different plots without instructions.

Practice scenario: One log at the collection point has no plot mark, while two groups from different plots are being prepared.
Suggested response: Isolate the log in the hold area, record its location and condition, and ask the leader to trace its identity before loading.

source_text: Kendaraan dan alat pemindah kayu memiliki titik buta, beban yang dapat bergeser, dan area putar. Pekerja tidak berdiri di bawah beban atau di jalur kendaraan, dan hanya operator berwenang yang mengendalikan alat. Isyarat, batas jalur, dan zona tunggu harus dipahami sebelum kru bergerak atau melakukan pemuatan.
english_text: Vehicles and timber-moving equipment have blind spots, shifting loads, and turning areas. Never stand beneath a load or in a vehicle route. Only authorized operators may control the equipment. Before movement or loading begins, everyone must understand the signals, route boundaries, and waiting zones.

source_text:
Tetap di lokasi tunggu yang ditentukan, jaga kontak visual dengan pemberi isyarat, dan jangan melintas di belakang alat bergerak. Bila beban bergeser, suara peringatan terdengar, atau orang masuk ke jalur, beri tanda berhenti sesuai prosedur dan menjauh ke tempat aman. Laporkan kerusakan atau kondisi jalan.

Kasus latihan: Satu batang bergeser pada muatan alat berat, sedangkan pekerja berdiri di jalur samping untuk memberi isyarat.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Berikan tanda berhenti sesuai prosedur dan pindah ke zona aman; beri tahu operator serta pemimpin tentang batang yang bergeser.
english_text:
Stay in the designated waiting area, maintain visual contact with the signaler, and do not cross behind moving equipment. If a load shifts, a warning sounds, or someone enters the route, give the stop signal according to procedure and move to a safe place. Report damage or road conditions.

Practice scenario: A log shifts on a heavy-equipment load while a worker stands beside the route to signal.
Suggested response: Give the stop signal as required and move to the safe zone; tell the operator and leader that the log has shifted.

source_text: Tanah hutan menahan air dan mendukung pertumbuhan; lintasan alat dan pekerjaan yang tidak sesuai dapat menggerus permukaan atau membawa sedimen ke aliran. Petak dan rute yang ditandai membantu mengurangi gangguan. Bila pekerja menemukan genangan, tanah tergerus, atau kebocoran bahan, ia melapor dan tidak memindahkan material sendiri.
english_text: Forest soil stores water and supports growth. Equipment routes and unsuitable work can erode the surface or carry sediment into waterways. Marked plots and routes help limit disturbance. If a worker finds standing water, erosion, or a material leak, report it and do not move the material yourself.

source_text:
Gunakan jalur dan tempat simpan yang ditunjukkan, jangan mencuci alat atau membuang cairan ke aliran. Bila melihat lumpur masuk ke parit atau tanah retak, hentikan pergerakan di titik itu dan beri tahu pemimpin. Ikuti arahan untuk mengamankan area tanpa menutup saluran atau merusak vegetasi.

Kasus latihan: Roda kendaraan meninggalkan alur dalam yang mengarah ke saluran air setelah hujan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan kendaraan di tempat aman, laporkan alur dan arah aliran, lalu tunggu keputusan pemimpin mengenai rute berikutnya.
english_text:
Use the designated routes and storage areas. Do not wash tools or dump liquids into waterways. If you see mud entering a ditch or cracked soil, stop movement at that point and notify the leader. Follow directions to secure the area without blocking a channel or damaging vegetation.

Practice scenario: After rain, a vehicle wheel leaves a deep rut leading toward a water channel.
Suggested response: Stop the vehicle in a safe place, report the rut and direction of flow, then wait for the leader to decide on the next route.

source_text: Pekerja lapangan dapat menemukan pohon rusak, serangan hama, asap, api, sampah, atau wadah bahan yang bocor. Tindakan awal adalah menjaga jarak, memberi peringatan kepada kru, dan melaporkan lokasi serta ciri yang terlihat. Pengendalian hama, api, atau bahan berbahaya dilakukan oleh orang yang ditunjuk dan sesuai rencana.
english_text: Field workers may find damaged trees, pest activity, smoke, fire, rubbish, or leaking containers. First, keep your distance, warn the crew, and report the location and visible signs. Pest control, firefighting, and hazardous-material handling must be carried out by designated people under the applicable plan.

source_text:
Catat petak, waktu, arah, dan tanda yang dapat diamati; jangan menyebut penyebab jika belum diketahui. Bila ada asap atau api, beri tahu kru melalui saluran darurat dan ikuti rute evakuasi. Jangan menyentuh wadah bocor atau mengangkut limbah menggunakan kendaraan tanpa arahan.

Kasus latihan: Pekerja melihat asap tipis dan bau hangus dari area yang belum diperiksa.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jauhi area, beri tahu kru dan pemimpin melalui jalur darurat, lalu ikuti rute evakuasi yang ditentukan.
english_text:
Record the plot, time, direction, and observable signs; do not state a cause that has not been established. If there is smoke or fire, alert the crew through the emergency channel and follow the evacuation route. Do not touch a leaking container or transport waste by vehicle without instructions.

Practice scenario: A worker sees light smoke and smells something burning in an area that has not been inspected.
Suggested response: Stay away, alert the crew and leader through the emergency channel, and follow the designated evacuation route.

Laporan harus membedakan jumlah yang selesai, kerusakan, material tertahan, dan tugas yang belum dilakukan. Penutupan memastikan masalah lapangan tidak hilang saat kru meninggalkan lokasi.
english_text: At the end of the job, confirm that all people and tools are accounted for, review the plot, and record results using company units. Reports must distinguish completed quantities, damage, materials on hold, and unfinished tasks. Closeout ensures field issues are not overlooked when the crew leaves.

Respons yang dianjurkan: Beri tahu pemimpin sebelum meninggalkan petak, cari alat sesuai prosedur, dan catat jalur yang belum dinyatakan aman.
english_text:
Inspect your assigned area, return tools according to the checklist, and compare output quantities with the records. Report locations and the status of markers, routes, or hazards requiring follow-up. Do not declare an area safe if it has not been inspected, or alter quantities to meet a target.

english_text: Segregate defective or questionable products so they are not mixed with accepted products. Status labels, hold locations, quantities, and lot numbers help prevent accidental shipment. Only authorized personnel may decide disposition under the quality system.

Respons: Pisahkan komponen dan tahan kelompok yang mungkin terdampak untuk pemeriksaan sesuai prosedur.
english_text:

Practice scenario: You find a crack in one component, but the adjacent box has not been inspected.
Response: Segregate the component and hold the potentially affected group for inspection according to procedure.

english_text: Guards, interlocks, and safety controls protect workers from moving parts and hazardous energy. Only designated personnel may lock out, isolate, adjust, or repair equipment under facility procedures.
Putting the Work Process into Practice

source_text:
Periksa keberadaan pelindung tanpa menonaktifkan sistem. Jika pelindung hilang atau interlock tidak bekerja, jangan jalankan mesin dan segera laporkan. Perawatan dilakukan setelah proses pengamanan resmi oleh petugas kompeten.

Skenario latihan: Mesin berhenti karena penutup pengaman tidak terkunci.
Respons: Jangan menahan sakelar atau melewati interlock; beri tahu teknisi/penanggung jawab sesuai prosedur.
english_text:
Check that guards are present without disabling the system. If a guard is missing or an interlock does not work, do not run the machine and report it immediately. Maintenance must follow the formal isolation process and be performed by competent staff.

Practice scenario: The machine stops because its safety cover is not locked.
Response: Do not hold the switch or bypass the interlock; notify the technician or person in charge according to procedure.

english_text: Loads can injure workers or fall while being lifted and moved. Consider the route, weight, shape, center of gravity, lifting aids, and team communication. Use lifting equipment only if you are authorized and trained.

Practice scenario: A heavy box blocks your view, and it must be carried across a wet floor.
Response: Do not lift it alone; secure the route, use an aid or coworker's help, and clean or report the floor condition.

Response: Mark and hold the product according to procedure; report the actual value without changing the record or approving it yourself.
