english_text: Protect clean products from floors, dust, water, and soiled items. Use containers, carts, and shipping units according to facility rules and order identity. Organize routes to prevent goods from falling or becoming mixed. Storage and vehicle conditions must meet local standards.

source_text:

Kasus latihan: Kontainer pengiriman berisi sisa cairan dan satu bundel bersih akan segera dimasukkan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tunda pemuatan dan minta kontainer dibersihkan serta dikeringkan sesuai prosedur sebelum produk bersih dimasukkan.

Check that carts are undamaged, routes are clear, and labels are visible. Do not stack above safe limits or put products on the floor. If packaging is wet, torn, or falls into an unclean area, hold it and follow the reassessment procedure.

Practice case: A shipping container has liquid residue, and a bundle of clean linen is about to be loaded.
Recommended response: Delay loading and have the container cleaned and dried under procedure before placing clean products inside.

source_text: Produksi melintasi beberapa tahap dan giliran. Handover yang berguna menyebut nomor kelompok, lokasi, waktu, kondisi yang diamati, tindakan yang telah dilakukan, dan pihak yang diberi tahu. Catatan faktual mencegah pengulangan pemeriksaan dan membantu penelusuran. Hindari istilah samar tanpa rincian yang dapat diamati.
english_text: Production spans several stages and shifts. A useful handover gives the lot number, location, time, observed condition, actions taken, and people notified. Factual records prevent repeated checks and support traceability. Avoid vague terms without observable detail.

source_text:
Selesaikan catatan pada sistem perusahaan, tandai barang yang ditahan, lalu serahkan langsung isu berisiko. Penerima giliran mengulang informasi penting bila belum jelas. Jangan menandai tugas selesai sebelum pemeriksaan atau perbaikan benar-benar dilakukan.

Kasus latihan: Pada pergantian giliran, satu lini masih berhenti dan penyebabnya belum ditemukan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tulis waktu, indikator yang terlihat, langkah aman yang telah dilakukan, dan status menunggu pemeriksaan; serahkan kepada pemimpin giliran berikutnya.
english_text:
Complete records in the company system, mark held goods, and directly hand over risky issues. The receiving shift should repeat key information when anything is unclear. Do not mark a task complete until inspection or repair has actually taken place.

Practice case: At shift change, one line is still stopped and the cause has not been identified.
Recommended response: Record the time, visible indicator, safe actions taken, and pending-inspection status; hand this information to the next shift lead.

source_text: Penerimaan adalah awal penelusuran barang. Cocokkan nomor pesanan atau tanda kirim, nama barang, satuan hitung, jumlah, dan penerima dengan dokumen. Barang dapat diterima dalam kotak, palet, atau wadah lain. Sistem setiap gudang berbeda, sehingga nama kolom dan langkah pencatatan mengikuti instruksi kerja yang berlaku.
english_text: Receiving begins the traceability record for goods. Match the order number or shipping reference, item name, counting unit, quantity, and recipient to the documents. Goods may arrive in boxes, on pallets, or in other containers. Warehouse systems differ, so use the field names and recording steps in the applicable work instructions.

source_text: Periksa satu kelompok pada satu waktu agar barang dua pesanan tidak tercampur. Pindai label atau catat nomor secara benar, lalu tandai status masuk sesuai prosedur. Jika label tidak terbaca atau dokumen belum ada, letakkan di area tahan yang ditetapkan dan minta petugas memeriksa. Kasus: nomor pesanan di label berbeda dari lembar penerimaan. Respons: jangan menerima ke stok aktif sampai ketidaksesuaian dikonfirmasi.
english_text: Check one lot at a time so goods for two orders are not mixed. Scan the label or record the number accurately, then mark receipt according to procedure. If a label cannot be read or documents are missing, place the goods in the designated hold area and ask staff to inspect them. Case: the order number on the label differs from the receiving sheet. Response: do not add the goods to active stock until the discrepancy is confirmed.

english_text: Receive documents and goods in the designated area.

source_text: Petugas memeriksa jumlah dan kondisi luar barang masuk dengan cara yang ditetapkan: per kotak, unit, atau palet. Robekan, penyok, basah, segel rusak, atau jumlah kurang dicatat sebagai keadaan yang terlihat. Pemeriksaan saat penerimaan membantu menemukan kapan suatu masalah terjadi, tetapi pekerja tidak boleh menyimpulkan siapa penyebabnya tanpa bukti.
english_text: Staff inspect the quantity and external condition of incoming goods using the specified method: by box, unit, or pallet. Record visible conditions such as tears, dents, wetness, broken seals, or shortages. Receiving inspections help establish when a problem occurred, but workers must not assign blame without evidence.

source_text: Gunakan tanda tahan atau area karantina sesuai aturan gudang. Ambil foto hanya bila instruksi mengizinkan. Jangan membuka kemasan khusus atau membuang label sebelum ada arahan. Kasus: satu dari enam kotak basah dan segelnya terbuka. Respons: pisahkan kotak itu, catat kondisi serta jumlah, beri tahu penanggung jawab, dan tunggu keputusan tentang pemeriksaan lanjutan.
english_text: Use the hold status or quarantine area required by warehouse rules. Take photographs only when instructions permit. Do not open special packaging or remove labels without direction. Case: one of six boxes is wet and its seal is open. Response: separate the box, record its condition and quantity, notify the person in charge, and wait for a decision about further inspection.

source_text: Setelah diterima, barang diarahkan ke lokasi yang ditentukan oleh sistem atau instruksi kerja. Setiap lokasi dapat mempunyai kode zona, lorong, rak, atau tingkat. english_text: After receiving, goods are sent to the location specified by the system or work instruction. Each location may have a zone, aisle, rack, or level code. Goods that look alike may have different item numbers, sizes, lots, or use-by limits, so do not choose a location simply because it is empty.

source_text: Pindai atau catat barang dan lokasi pada saat pemindahan sesuai prosedur. Pastikan jumlah pada sistem berpindah bersama barang secara tepat. Bila lokasi tidak cocok, penuh, atau label tidak bisa dibaca, tahan pemindahan dan minta instruksi. Kasus: aplikasi mengarahkan ke rak yang sudah berisi barang dengan label berbeda. Respons: jangan menaruh barang di sela rak; laporkan lokasi penuh dan minta lokasi yang disahkan.
english_text: Scan or record the item and location during movement as required by procedure. Make sure the system quantity moves with the goods accurately. If a location does not match, is full, or has an unreadable label, hold the movement and ask for instructions. Case: the app directs you to a rack holding items with a different label. Response: do not squeeze the goods into the rack; report that it is full and request an approved location.

source_text: Gudang dapat memisahkan barang menurut pemilik, jenis, ukuran, lot, suhu, atau instruksi penanganan. Zona pada layar atau label menjadi petunjuk operasional. Jangan menganggap dua barang boleh disimpan bersama karena bentuk kemasannya mirip. Barang yang punya syarat khusus memerlukan lokasi dan pengawasan sesuai petunjuk fasilitas.
english_text: A warehouse may separate goods by owner, type, size, lot, temperature, or handling instructions. Zone information on the screen or label guides operations. Do not assume two items can be stored together because their packaging looks similar. Goods with special requirements need locations and monitoring according to facility instructions.

source_text: Cocokkan kode barang dan lokasi sebelum menaruh. Pastikan label menghadap atau ditempatkan agar terbaca dan jalur pemeriksaan tidak tertutup. Jika ada tanda kondisi khusus yang tidak Anda pahami, hentikan penempatan dan tanyakan kepada penanggung jawab. Kasus: dua kotak produk serupa memiliki label lot berbeda. Respons: pertahankan pemisahan lot dan catat lokasi masing-masing sesuai sistem.
english_text: Match the item code and location before putting goods away. Make sure labels face outward or are positioned so they can be read, and do not block inspection routes. If you do not understand a special-condition label, stop and ask the person in charge. Case: two similar product boxes have different lot labels. Response: keep the lots separate and record each location in the system.
Check the code and storage instructions.

english_text: Put away goods while keeping labels readable.

english_text: Do not mix lots, owners, or zones because the packages look alike.

source_text: Dua kotak terlihat sama tetapi mencantumkan nomor lot berbeda.

english_text: Store each lot in a separate or designated location, then record where each group is kept to maintain traceability.

source_text: Latihan orisinal untuk menjaga identitas barang selama penyimpanan. Urutan rotasi, batas susun, peralatan, dan kondisi khusus mengikuti ketentuan fasilitas dan karakter barang.
english_text: Original practice in maintaining goods identity during storage. Rotation order, stacking limits, equipment, and special conditions follow facility requirements and the characteristics of the goods.

source_text: Menjaga jalur pergerakan barang tetap tertata dan bebas penghalang.
english_text: Keep goods-movement routes orderly and clear of obstructions.

source_text: Menggunakan alat pemindahan hanya sesuai pelatihan dan izin.
english_text: Use material-handling equipment only with appropriate training and authorization.

source_text: Melaporkan tumpahan, barang jatuh, atau kerusakan rak.
english_text: Report spills, fallen goods, or rack damage.

source_text: Barang berpindah dengan tangan atau alat yang sesuai di fasilitas. Jalur pejalan kaki, area alat, dan tempat tunggu perlu dijaga agar pekerja tidak saling menghalangi. Tumpukan, palet, dan rak mengikuti batas serta petunjuk gudang; tidak ada satu cara susun yang berlaku untuk semua jenis barang. Hanya pekerja terlatih dan berwenang yang menggunakan mesin pemindah.
english_text: Goods move by hand or suitable equipment within a facility. Keep pedestrian routes, equipment areas, and staging spaces organized so workers do not obstruct one another. Stack goods and use pallets and racks within warehouse limits and instructions; no single arrangement works for every type of item. Only trained and authorized workers may operate material-handling machinery.

source_text: Sebelum mendorong atau membawa, periksa rute, kondisi wadah, dan apakah bantuan diperlukan. Jangan meletakkan barang di depan pintu, alat pemadam, jalur keluar, atau jalur alat. Bila barang jatuh atau rak tampak berubah, jangan mencoba mengangkat atau memperbaiki sendiri jika berisiko; batasi dari posisi aman dan laporkan. Kasus: palet retak ditemukan di jalur pemindahan. Respons: jangan memindahkannya dengan alat tanpa persetujuan; minta bantuan petugas.
english_text: Before pushing or carrying goods, check the route and container condition and decide whether assistance is needed. Do not place goods in front of doors, fire equipment, exits, or equipment routes. If goods fall or a rack appears altered, do not attempt a risky lift or repair yourself; keep clear from a safe position and report it. Case: a cracked pallet is found in a movement route. Response: do not move it with equipment without approval; request staff assistance.
Check the goods, container, and route.

source_text: Pastikan alat dan penggunaannya sesuai izin
english_text: Confirm the equipment and its use are authorized.
Move goods according to facility instructions.

source_text: Rapikan jalur dan laporkan kondisi tidak aman
english_text: Clear the route and report unsafe conditions.

source_text: Jangan mengoperasikan alat angkat tanpa pelatihan atau memblokir jalur dengan barang.
english_text: Do not operate lifting equipment without training or block a route with goods.

source_text: Palet retak membawa barang dan berada di jalur pemindahan.
english_text: A cracked pallet carrying goods is in a material-handling route.

source_text: Jaga jarak dan beri tahu penanggung jawab. Minta petugas terlatih menentukan cara memindahkan palet serta lindungi jalur dari lalu lintas lain.
english_text: Keep clear and notify the person in charge. Have trained staff decide how to move the pallet and keep other traffic out of the route.

english_text: Compare the physical count with system records in an orderly way.

source_text: Tidak memperbarui stok sebelum selisih diperiksa.
english_text: Do not update stock before the discrepancy has been checked.

source_text: Mencatat temuan dan menjaga kelompok terkait tetap dapat ditelusuri.
english_text: Record findings and keep the relevant lot traceable.

source_text: Penghitungan stok memeriksa jumlah barang di lokasi terhadap catatan. Perbedaan dapat muncul akibat transaksi belum tercatat, salah lokasi, salah hitung, atau barang rusak. Penghitung mengulang sesuai instruksi, memeriksa label dan satuan, lalu melaporkan hasil. Sistem tidak boleh diubah hanya untuk menyamakan angka.
english_text: A stock count compares the quantity at a location with the records. Discrepancies may result from an unrecorded transaction, wrong location, counting error, or damaged goods. Recount as instructed, check labels and units, and report the result. Do not alter the system merely to make the numbers match.

source_text: Berhenti memindahkan barang dari lokasi yang sedang dihitung jika prosedur memintanya. Periksa satuan, nomor, dan transaksi yang baru terjadi; minta petugas yang berwenang menyetujui koreksi. Kasus: sistem mencatat 30 unit tetapi rak berisi 28. Respons: hitung ulang, periksa lokasi sekitar sesuai arahan, catat selisih, lalu tunggu pemeriksaan sebelum koreksi stok.
english_text: Stop moving goods from a location being counted if procedure requires it. Check the unit, item number, and recent transactions; ask authorized staff to approve any correction. Case: the system records 30 units, but the shelf holds 28. Response: recount, check nearby locations as directed, record the discrepancy, and wait for review before adjusting stock.

source_text: Pilih lokasi dan barang sesuai daftar hitung
english_text: Select the location and goods according to the count list.
Match the item number and unit.

source_text: Hitung ulang dan periksa transaksi terkait
Catat selisih dan tunggu persetujuan koreksi
english_text: Record the discrepancy and wait for approval to adjust it.

source_text: Jangan mengubah angka sistem atau mengambil barang untuk menutup selisih tanpa izin.
english_text: Do not change system quantities or take goods to cover a discrepancy without authorization.

source_text: Catatan menunjukkan 30 unit, tetapi hitungan rak hanya 28.
english_text: The record shows 30 units, but the shelf count is only 28.

source_text: Hitung ulang dengan satuan yang benar, periksa apakah transaksi terbaru belum dicatat, lalu dokumentasikan 28 unit dan laporkan untuk pemeriksaan.
english_text: Recount using the correct unit, check whether the latest transaction has not yet been recorded, then document the 28 units and report the discrepancy for review.

source_text: Latihan orisinal untuk memilih barang sesuai pesanan, memeriksa hasil picking, mengemas, dan menempatkannya pada alur pengiriman. Identitas pesanan dan jejak perpindahan dipertahankan sampai serah terima.
english_text: Original practice in selecting goods for an order, checking picked items, packing them, and placing them in the dispatch flow. Preserve order identity and movement history through handover.

source_text: Membaca kode barang, jumlah, serta lokasi pada daftar picking.
english_text: Read item codes, quantities, and locations on the picking list.

source_text: Mengambil barang dari lokasi yang cocok dan memindai transaksi.
english_text: Pick goods from the matching location and scan the transaction.

source_text: Meminta bantuan ketika barang tidak ada atau label berbeda.
english_text: Request assistance when goods are missing or labels do not match.

source_text: Picking mengambil barang dari stok untuk memenuhi pesanan. Daftar atau alat pemindai menunjukkan produk, jumlah, lokasi, dan aturan pilihan yang berlaku. Barang yang namanya mirip belum tentu sama. Prinsip rotasi seperti lot atau tanggal hanya dipakai bila instruksi sistem atau fasilitas menetapkannya; pekerja tidak mengubah aturan urutan berdasarkan kebiasaan.
english_text: Picking retrieves stock to fulfill an order. A list or scanner shows the item, quantity, location, and applicable selection rules. Items with similar names may not be the same. Rotation rules based on lots or dates apply only when specified by the system or facility; workers must not change the sequence based on habit.

source_text: Cocokkan kode barang dan lokasi sebelum mengambil, hitung sesuai satuan, lalu konfirmasi transaksi dengan alat kerja. Jika jumlah kurang, lokasi kosong, atau label berbeda, jangan mengganti barang dengan produk serupa. Kasus: rak memiliki dua ukuran produk dan pesanan meminta ukuran tertentu. Respons: cocokkan kode lengkap, ambil ukuran yang benar, dan laporkan kekurangan bila jumlah tidak cukup.
english_text: Match the item code and location before picking, count using the specified unit, and confirm the transaction with the work device. If the quantity is short, the location is empty, or the label differs, do not substitute a similar product. Case: the shelf has two product sizes, but the order requires one size. Response: match the full item code, pick the correct size, and report a shortage if there are not enough.

source_text: Baca kode, jumlah, dan lokasi pesanan
english_text: Read the order's item code, quantity, and location.
Check the goods label at the location.

source_text: Ambil dan pindai jumlah yang diminta
english_text: Pick and scan the requested quantity.
Report an empty location or mismatch.

source_text: Jangan mengganti jenis, ukuran, lot, atau jumlah tanpa persetujuan.
english_text: Do not substitute the type, size, lot, or quantity without approval.

source_text: Pesanan meminta ukuran kecil, tetapi lokasi berisi kotak ukuran kecil dan besar.
english_text: The order calls for the small size, but the location contains boxes in both small and large sizes.

source_text: Cocokkan kode produk lengkap dengan pesanan sebelum mengambil. Jika jumlah ukuran kecil kurang, catat kekurangannya dan hubungi petugas, bukan mengganti dengan ukuran besar.
english_text: Match the full product code to the order before picking. If there are too few small items, record the shortage and contact staff instead of substituting the large size.

english_text: Original practice in selecting goods for an order, checking picked items, packing them, and placing them in the dispatch flow. Preserve order identity and movement history through handover.

source_text: Pemeriksaan hasil picking dan pengelolaan lot
english_text: Checking Picked Orders and Managing Lots

source_text: Memeriksa hasil pengambilan terhadap daftar sebelum dikemas.
english_text: Check picked goods against the list before packing.

source_text: Menjaga nomor lot, tanggal, dan identitas pesanan sesuai aturan fasilitas.
english_text: Keep lot numbers, dates, and order identity in line with facility rules.

source_text: Memisahkan barang salah atau rusak agar tidak terkirim.
english_text: Separate incorrect or damaged goods to prevent dispatch.

source_text: Sebelum pengepakan, hasil picking diperiksa sekali lagi: kode, jumlah, lot atau tanggal bila diminta, serta kondisi barang. Beberapa fasilitas menggunakan pemindaian untuk mengurangi salah kirim. Sistem menunjukkan cara rotasi dan pemilihan lot untuk produk tertentu. Pekerja tidak menganggap selalu berlaku satu urutan untuk semua barang.
english_text: Before packing, check picked items again: item code, quantity, lot or date when required, and condition. Some facilities use scanning to reduce shipping errors. The system indicates rotation and lot-selection methods for particular products. Do not assume one sequence applies to all goods.

source_text: Bandingkan produk yang terkumpul dengan pesanan dan pindai sesuai instruksi. Jika barang salah, rusak, atau lot tidak cocok, pisahkan dari pesanan siap kirim, beri status sesuai prosedur, dan minta penggantian yang benar. Kasus: pada rak pengemasan ditemukan satu produk dengan label berbeda dari daftar. Respons: jangan mengemasnya; tahan dan periksa kembali lokasi asal serta transaksi.
english_text: Compare assembled products with the order and scan them as instructed. If an item is incorrect, damaged, or from the wrong lot, separate it from ready-to-ship orders, assign the status required by procedure, and request the correct replacement. Case: an item in the packing area has a label that differs from the list. Response: do not pack it; hold it and recheck its source location and transaction.

source_text: Kumpulkan hasil picking pada area pesanan
english_text: Gather picked items in the order area.

source_text: Cocokkan kode, jumlah, dan lot yang diminta
english_text: Match the requested item code, quantity, and lot.
Check the condition of the goods and their labels.
Separate the incorrect item and record its replacement.

source_text: Jangan mengemas barang yang identitas atau statusnya belum cocok.
english_text: Do not pack goods until their identity and status match.

source_text: Satu barang pada area pengepakan memiliki label lot berbeda dari daftar pesanan.
english_text: An item in the packing area has a lot label that differs from the order list.

source_text: Tahan barang itu, cocokkan pesanan dan transaksi picking, lalu laporkan agar lot yang benar dipilih sebelum pengemasan.
english_text: Hold the item, check the order and picking transaction, and report it so the correct lot can be selected before packing.

english_text: この番号は注文と違います。

source_text: Latihan orisinal untuk memilih barang sesuai pesanan, memeriksa hasil picking, mengemas, dan menempatkannya pada alur pengiriman. Identitas pesanan dan jejak perpindahan dipertahankan sampai serah terima.
english_text: Original practice in selecting goods for an order, checking picked items, packing them, and placing them in the dispatch flow. Preserve order identity and movement history through handover.

source_text: Mengemas barang dengan bahan dan cara yang ditetapkan untuk pesanan.
english_text: Pack goods using the materials and method specified for the order.

source_text: Memastikan label pengiriman dapat dibaca dan terkait dengan pesanan yang benar.
english_text: Ensure the dispatch label is readable and linked to the correct order.

source_text: Menata kiriman pada area tunggu yang sesuai tujuan.
english_text: Arrange shipments in the staging area for the correct destination.

source_text: Pengemasan melindungi barang dan mempertahankan identitas pesanan selama perpindahan. Cara kemas, bahan pengisi, segel, dan label tergantung produk serta aturan pelanggan. Label yang benar menghubungkan nomor pesanan, jumlah, tujuan, dan informasi penanganan yang diperlukan. Area kirim diatur agar kiriman berbeda tidak tertukar saat diambil pengangkut.
english_text: Packing protects goods and preserves order identity during movement. Packaging methods, filler, seals, and labels depend on the product and customer requirements. A correct label links the order number, quantity, destination, and required handling information. Organize the dispatch area so different shipments are not mixed up when collected by carriers.

source_text: Pilih kemasan sesuai instruksi, periksa label sebelum ditempel, lalu cocokkan kembali dengan pesanan. Jika label buram, dobel, atau tujuan berbeda, tahan paket dan cetak ulang melalui prosedur. Letakkan di zona tujuan yang benar dan jangan menaruh paket di jalur lewat. Kasus: label salah tujuan menempel pada paket yang sudah tertutup. Respons: tahan, minta koreksi label, dan catat paket belum siap kirim.
english_text: Choose packaging as instructed, check the label before applying it, and compare it with the order again. If a label is blurred, duplicated, or has the wrong destination, hold the package and reprint according to procedure. Place it in the correct destination zone and keep it out of walkways. Case: a package is sealed with a label for the wrong destination. Response: hold it, request a corrected label, and record that it is not ready to ship.

source_text: Pilih kemasan sesuai barang dan instruksi
english_text: Choose packaging suited to the goods and instructions.
Protect the goods and close the package.

source_text: Cocokkan label dengan nomor pesanan dan tujuan
english_text: Match the label to the order number and destination.

source_text: Tempatkan pada zona kirim yang benar
english_text: Place the goods in the correct dispatch zone.

source_text: Jangan mengirim paket berlabel ganda, tidak terbaca, atau berbeda tujuan.
english_text: Do not ship a package with duplicate, unreadable, or wrong-destination labels.

source_text: Paket tertutup tetapi labelnya menunjukkan tujuan pelanggan lain.
english_text: A sealed package has a label for another customer's destination.

source_text: Tahan paket di area pemeriksaan, jangan menutupinya dengan label baru tanpa prosedur, dan minta label dikoreksi serta diverifikasi terhadap pesanan.
english_text: Hold the package in the inspection area. Do not cover it with a new label outside procedure; request a corrected label and verify it against the order.

english_text: ラベルの配送先が違います。

english_text: らべるのはいそうさきがちがいます。

english_text: 出荷を止めて、伝票と確認します。

english_text: しゅっかをとめて、でんぴょうとかくにんします。

source_text: Hentikan pengiriman dan periksa dengan dokumen.
english_text: Stop the shipment and check it against the documents.

source_text: Traceabilitas, proses distribusi, dan serah terima

Latihan orisinal untuk menjaga jejak barang dan menangani aktivitas pendukung gudang, termasuk pelaporan, penataan, pembersihan, dan persiapan cuaca buruk. Ini berfokus pada kerja gudang, bukan proses manufaktur produk.
english_text: Original practice in maintaining goods traceability and handling supporting warehouse activities, including reporting, organization, cleaning, and preparation for severe weather. The focus is warehouse work, not product manufacturing.

source_text: Serah barang keluar dan bukti pengiriman
english_text: Outbound Handover and Proof of Delivery

source_text: Mencocokkan kiriman, tujuan, dan jumlah sebelum serah terima.
english_text: Match the shipment, destination, and quantity before handover.

source_text: Mencatat siapa atau bagian mana yang menerima kiriman sesuai prosedur.
english_text: Record who or which department received the shipment according to procedure.

source_text: Menjaga status tetap terbuka ketika bukti serah belum tersedia.
english_text: Keep the status open when proof of handover is not yet available.

source_text: Tahap keluar memastikan barang yang sudah dipilih dan dikemas diserahkan kepada pengangkut atau proses berikutnya dengan tujuan yang benar. Dokumen serah terima, jumlah koli, nomor kiriman, dan waktu menjadi bagian jejak barang. Nama dokumen dan metode tanda tangan berbeda tiap fasilitas; gunakan sistem yang ditentukan.
english_text: The outbound stage ensures that picked and packed goods are handed to the carrier or next process for the correct destination. Handover documents, package count, shipment number, and time form part of the goods' traceability record. Document names and signature methods vary by facility; use the designated system.

source_text: Cocokkan paket dan daftar sebelum serah. Catat perbedaan jumlah atau kerusakan sebelum kendaraan meninggalkan area. Jangan menandai barang diterima bila belum ada konfirmasi. Kasus: daftar menunjukkan 8 paket, tetapi pengangkut hanya mengambil 7. Respons: tahan status selesai, hitung ulang, dan minta pengangkut serta petugas memastikan paket yang tertinggal.
english_text: Match packages to the list before handover. Record quantity differences or damage before the vehicle leaves the area. Do not mark goods as received without confirmation. Case: the list shows eight packages, but the carrier takes only seven. Response: keep the status open, recount, and ask the carrier and staff to confirm the package left behind.

source_text: Cocokkan nomor dan jumlah dengan daftar
english_text: Match the item number and quantity to the list.

source_text: Serahkan dan catat penerima serta waktu
english_text: Hand over the goods and record the recipient and time.

source_text: Laporkan paket yang tertinggal atau berbeda
english_text: Report packages left behind or discrepancies.

source_text: Jangan menutup pengiriman atau membubuhkan tanda terima sebelum jumlah aktual dipastikan.
english_text: Do not close a shipment or sign a receipt before confirming the actual quantity.

source_text: Daftar memuat delapan paket, tetapi pengangkut akan membawa tujuh.
english_text: The list shows eight packages, but the carrier is taking seven.

source_text: Hentikan penutupan transaksi, hitung ulang, catat satu paket yang tertinggal, lalu koordinasikan apakah paket itu dikirim terpisah atau ditahan.
english_text: Stop closing the transaction, recount, record the one package left behind, and coordinate whether it should be sent separately or held.

english_text: リストは八個ですが、七個だけです。

Membedakan proses distribusi ringan dari pembuatan atau perubahan fungsi produk.
english_text: Distinguish light distribution work from manufacturing or changing a product's function.

source_text: Mengikuti instruksi untuk pelabelan, set, atau pengemasan ulang.

source_text: Mempertahankan identitas barang dan catatan sebelum serta setelah proses.

source_text: Pekerjaan gudang dapat mencakup kegiatan distribusi ringan seperti membagi jumlah ke kemasan lebih kecil, menempel label, atau menyusun beberapa barang menjadi satu set sesuai pesanan. Tujuannya menyiapkan barang untuk aliran distribusi. Perubahan yang membuat atau meningkatkan fungsi produk termasuk kegiatan manufaktur dan berada di luar latihan gudang ini.
english_text: Warehouse work may include light distribution tasks such as dividing quantities into smaller packages, applying labels, or assembling several items into an order set. These tasks prepare goods for distribution. Changes that create or enhance a product's function are manufacturing activities and are outside this warehouse practice.

source_text: Sebelum mulai, pastikan instruksi, nomor barang, jumlah tiap kemasan, bahan, dan label yang akan digunakan. Jaga agar produk dan label lama tetap dapat ditelusuri sesuai prosedur. Jangan mengubah isi, spesifikasi, atau keterangan produk sendiri. Kasus: instruksi meminta set tiga barang, tetapi hanya dua jenis tersedia. Respons: jangan mengganti jenis ketiga; tahan pesanan dan laporkan kekurangan.
english_text: Before starting, confirm the instructions, item number, quantity in each package, materials, and labels to be used. Keep the product and previous label traceable under procedure. Do not change the product contents, specifications, or description on your own. Case: the instruction calls for a set of three items, but only two types are available. Response: do not substitute the third type; hold the order and report the shortage.

english_text: Original practice in maintaining goods traceability and handling supporting warehouse activities, including reporting, organization, cleaning, and preparation for severe weather. The focus is warehouse work, not product manufacturing.

source_text: Membantu penataan dan perlindungan barang sesuai arahan saat cuaca buruk.
english_text: Help organize and protect goods as directed during severe weather.

source_text: Menyerahkan status persediaan dan hambatan kepada giliran berikutnya.
english_text: Hand over inventory status and obstacles to the next shift.

source_text: Gudang mengandalkan laporan agar barang tetap dapat ditelusuri sepanjang penerimaan, penyimpanan, picking, dan pengiriman. Tumpahan, air masuk, atap bocor, label hilang, atau sistem tidak tersedia harus dicatat bersama lokasi dan tindakan aman yang telah dilakukan. Saat cuaca buruk mendekat, rencana fasilitas dapat memindahkan barang atau melindungi area dari hujan.
english_text: Warehouses rely on reports to keep goods traceable through receiving, storage, picking, and dispatch. Record spills, water ingress, roof leaks, missing labels, or system outages along with the location and safe actions taken. As severe weather approaches, the facility plan may call for moving goods or protecting areas from rain.

source_text: Ikuti instruksi penanggung jawab dan jangan memindahkan barang sensitif tanpa mencatat lokasi baru. Laporkan kejadian segera, lalu pada serah terima jelaskan lot, rak, jumlah, status, waktu, dan tindakan yang masih diperlukan. Kasus: air mulai masuk dekat rak barang. Respons: beri tahu pengawas, lindungi diri, dan pindahkan barang hanya bila diarahkan melalui prosedur yang aman; catat lokasi perpindahan.
english_text: Follow the person in charge's instructions and do not move sensitive goods without recording the new location. Report an incident immediately; at handover, explain the lot, rack, quantity, status, time, and any action still needed. Case: water is starting to enter near a rack. Response: notify a supervisor, protect yourself, and move goods only when directed through a safe procedure; record the new location.

english_text: Identify and report exceptions with their locations.

english_text: Report the location and conditions to a supervisor, follow the warehouse protection plan, and record every box moved and its new location.

english_text: Keep a safe distance and monitor platform conditions while on duty.

source_text: Memberikan arah sederhana tanpa menghalangi arus penumpang.
english_text: Give simple directions without obstructing passenger flow.

source_text: Segera melaporkan benda atau keadaan yang berisiko.
english_text: Promptly report objects or conditions that pose a risk.

source_text: Petugas stasiun membantu penumpang menemukan peron, pintu keluar, atau fasilitas. Area dekat tepi peron dan pintu kereta memerlukan perhatian khusus. Posisi tubuh, penggunaan jalur pejalan kaki, dan komunikasi harus mengikuti prosedur operator. Pengamatan dilakukan sambil menjaga diri sendiri dan tidak masuk ke area terbatas tanpa kewenangan.
english_text: Station staff help passengers find platforms, exits, and facilities. Areas near platform edges and train doors require particular attention. Body position, use of walkways, and communication must follow operator procedures. Stay alert while protecting yourself, and do not enter restricted areas without authorization.

source_text: Jawab pertanyaan dengan petunjuk singkat seperti nama peron atau arah tangga yang sudah dipastikan. Bila melihat barang tertinggal, penumpang terjatuh, atau kerumunan mendekati area berbahaya, beri tahu petugas yang bertanggung jawab. Jangan mengejar barang ke jalur atau menahan kereta dengan tindakan di luar prosedur. Kasus: tas tertinggal dekat garis peringatan. Respons: jaga jarak, beri tahu petugas, dan ikuti cara pengamanan setempat.
english_text: Answer with brief, confirmed directions, such as a platform name or the direction of a staircase. Report unattended belongings, a fallen passenger, or a crowd approaching a dangerous area to the staff member in charge. Do not chase an object onto the track or try to stop a train outside procedure. Example: a bag is left near the warning line. Response: keep your distance, notify staff, and follow local safety procedures.

source_text: Keterlambatan, perubahan jalur, atau pengalihan dapat membingungkan penumpang. Petugas memberi pengumuman sesuai informasi resmi operator. Gunakan kata sederhana: nama layanan, peron atau arah yang benar, dan tempat bertanya bila informasi belum tersedia. Jangan membuat perkiraan sendiri tentang waktu berangkat atau menyuruh penumpang berpindah ke jalur lain tanpa konfirmasi.
english_text: Delays, track changes, and diversions can confuse passengers. Staff make announcements using the operator's official information. Use simple wording: the service name, the correct platform or direction, and where to ask if information is not yet available. Do not estimate departure times or direct passengers to another track without confirmation.

source_text: Bila menerima kabar yang belum pasti, sampaikan bahwa informasi sedang diperiksa dan segera hubungi atasan atau pusat informasi. Saat mengarahkan kelompok, tunjukkan jalur pejalan kaki dan hindari membuat orang berlari. Kasus: penumpang bertanya kereta berikutnya setelah pengumuman gangguan yang belum menyebut waktu. Respons: jelaskan bahwa waktunya belum dikonfirmasi dan arahkan ke sumber informasi operator.
english_text: If you receive unconfirmed information, say that it is being checked and promptly contact a supervisor or information center. When directing a group, point out the walking route and avoid making people rush. Example: after a disruption announcement that gives no time, a passenger asks when the next train will leave. Response: explain that the time is not confirmed and direct them to the operator's information source.

source_text: Melaporkan kerusakan atau kontaminasi yang membutuhkan petugas lain.
english_text: Report damage or contamination that requires another staff member's attention.

source_text: Pekerjaan pembersihan mencakup bagian dalam dan luar kereta, peron, concourse, serta fasilitas stasiun sesuai penugasan. Pekerja membedakan area yang sedang dibersihkan dan area yang masih digunakan penumpang. Alat, bahan, sarung tangan, tanda peringatan, dan metode kerja mengikuti petunjuk fasilitas; bahan yang berbeda tidak boleh dicampur atau digunakan berdasarkan dugaan.
english_text: Cleaning duties may cover train interiors and exteriors, platforms, concourses, and station facilities as assigned. Distinguish areas being cleaned from those still in use by passengers. Use tools, supplies, gloves, warning signs, and methods according to facility instructions; do not mix different substances or use them based on a guess.

source_text: Simpan alat agar tidak masuk jalur berjalan atau menjadi penghalang. Gunakan tanda peringatan sesuai prosedur jika lantai basah. Jika menemukan benda tajam, cairan tidak dikenal, fasilitas rusak, atau kerusakan di dekat jalur kereta, jangan menyentuhnya; batasi area dari posisi aman dan laporkan. Kasus: lantai concourse basah saat ramai. Respons: ikuti cara penandaan, jaga jalur lewat yang aman, dan minta bantuan bila area tidak dapat diamankan.
english_text: Keep tools out of walkways and clear of obstructions. Follow procedure for warning signs on wet floors. Do not touch sharp objects, unidentified liquids, damaged facilities, or damage near the railway; restrict access from a safe position and report it. Example: the concourse floor is wet during a busy period. Response: use the prescribed signs, maintain a safe passage, and request help if the area cannot be secured.

english_text: Do not touch or mix the substance. Notify the person in charge, follow area-restriction procedures, and use a cleaning product only after it has been identified.

english_text: Original practice in railway movement communication and control. Route changes, signals, operating equipment, and traffic control are handled only by authorized staff with the procedures and qualifications set by the operator.

source_text: Dalam operasi kereta, jalur, wesel, sinyal, dan peralatan terkait menentukan arah gerak. Salah memahami instruksi dapat berdampak besar, maka hanya pekerja yang ditugaskan dan berkualifikasi yang menangani alat operasi. Pekerja lain menjaga jarak dan menyampaikan pengamatan; aturan perusahaan, sinyal resmi, dan arahan petugas operasi selalu menjadi rujukan.
english_text: In railway operations, tracks, points, signals, and related equipment determine movement. Misunderstanding an instruction can have serious consequences, so only assigned and qualified workers handle operating equipment. Other workers keep clear and report what they observe. Company rules, official signals, and instructions from operations staff are authoritative.

source_text: Sebelum tindakan yang menjadi kewenangan Anda, konfirmasi identitas jalur, maksud perintah, dan komunikasi yang diwajibkan operator. Gunakan pengulangan kembali bila prosedur memintanya. Jika indikator alat tidak sesuai atau pesan tidak terdengar jelas, jangan melanjutkan dengan tebakan; tahan dan laporkan. Kasus: lampu penunjuk tidak sama dengan instruksi lisan. Respons: hentikan tindakan di tempat aman dan minta konfirmasi petugas pengendali.
english_text: Before taking an action within your authority, confirm the track identity, the intent of the instruction, and any communication required by the operator. Repeat the instruction if procedure requires it. If an indicator does not match or a message is unclear, do not guess; hold and report. Example: an indicator light conflicts with a verbal instruction. Response: stop in a safe place and ask the controller to confirm.

source_text: Pemindahan atau langsir kendaraan dapat melibatkan petugas pemberi isyarat, pengemudi, dan pengawas. Setiap operator memiliki kode, posisi berdiri, dan cara komunikasi resmi. Pekerja harus tahu tugasnya sebelum gerak dimulai. Ketika isyarat hilang, terhalang, atau berbeda dengan yang disepakati, pergerakan dihentikan sesuai prosedur dan dilaporkan.
english_text: Moving or shunting vehicles may involve a signaler, driver, and supervisor. Each operator has official codes, standing positions, and communication methods. Workers must know their duties before movement begins. If a signal is lost, obscured, or differs from the agreed signal, stop movement according to procedure and report it.

source_text: Jangan berdiri di antara kendaraan atau masuk ke lintasan gerak. Gunakan alat komunikasi dan isyarat hanya sebagaimana dilatih. Pastikan jalur kerja serta orang yang terlibat sesuai daftar pemeriksaan. Kasus: petugas isyarat tidak terlihat saat pemindahan hendak dimulai. Respons: jangan memberi tanda maju atau bergerak; tunggu sampai komunikasi kembali jelas dan pengawas mengonfirmasi.
english_text: Do not stand between vehicles or enter their path of movement. Use communication devices and signals only as trained. Check the work route and personnel against the checklist. Example: the signaler is not visible when a move is about to start. Response: do not signal or move; wait until communication is clear again and the supervisor confirms.

english_text: Original practice in railway movement communication and control. Route changes, signals, operating equipment, and traffic control are handled only by authorized staff with the procedures and qualifications set by the operator.

Catat hal yang terlihat, waktu, tindakan yang sudah dilakukan, dan status yang menunggu keputusan.
english_text: Controllers and field staff must use the correct station name, train service number, or track. During a disruption, prompt and accurate information helps the operator manage service, passenger safety, and technical assistance. Record observable facts, the time, actions taken, and any status awaiting a decision.

english_text: Keep work communications concise: identify yourself, your location, the service or equipment involved, what you observed, and the help needed. Do not attempt repairs or announce a new route unless assigned. Example: a station ticket gate does not respond and a queue forms. Response: keep passengers in a safe place, notify operations staff, and give directions based on confirmed instructions.

english_text: Original practice in track and railway electrical-facility maintenance. Work includes inspections, maintenance, and reporting; access and technical work are governed by the operator's safety system and supervision by authorized personnel.

source_text: Mengamati kondisi jalur sesuai area dan daftar tugas.

source_text: Pekerjaan jalur mencakup pengukuran kondisi lintasan, penggantian komponen, penanganan balas, dan pemeriksaan peralatan keselamatan. Pemeriksaan dilakukan oleh tim yang memahami batas lokasi, jadwal perlindungan, dan alat yang digunakan. Pekerja baru tidak memasuki jalur atau menggunakan alat kerja tanpa arahan dan pengawasan sesuai prosedur operator.
english_text: Track work includes measuring track condition, replacing components, handling ballast, and inspecting safety equipment. Inspections are performed by teams familiar with site boundaries, protection schedules, and the tools used. New workers must not enter a track or use work tools without direction and supervision under operator procedures.

source_text: Catat titik lokasi, jenis temuan, waktu, dan foto atau kode yang diizinkan oleh aturan perusahaan. Jangan menyentuh rel, pengikat, atau kabel untuk menguji kekuatannya. Bila temuan tampak mendesak, segera beri tahu pengawas dari posisi aman. Kasus: ditemukan komponen lepas di jalur inspeksi. Respons: berhenti di area aman, tandai lokasi hanya dengan cara yang diizinkan, dan lapor kepada pengawas.
english_text: Record the location, type of finding, and time, and take photos or use codes only when company rules allow. Do not touch rails, fasteners, or cables to test them. If a finding appears urgent, notify the supervisor promptly from a safe position. Example: a loose component is found on an inspection route. Response: stop in a safe area, mark the location only as permitted, and report to the supervisor.

source_text: Fasilitas listrik rel meliputi kabel, gardu, peralatan listrik, sinyal, komunikasi, dan perangkat keselamatan perlintasan. Sebagian peralatan tetap berbahaya meskipun terlihat tidak aktif. Pekerja harus memakai otorisasi, pemisahan sumber energi, dan metode pemeriksaan yang berlaku di lokasi; pelajaran ini tidak memberi izin atau petunjuk teknis untuk mengerjakan alat.
english_text: Railway electrical facilities include cables, substations, electrical equipment, signals, communications, and level-crossing safety devices. Some equipment remains dangerous even when it appears inactive. Workers must follow the site's authorization, energy-isolation, and inspection methods; this lesson does not grant permission or provide technical instructions for working on equipment.

source_text: Jika melihat kabel putus, sinyal gelap, alarm, percikan, atau pagar perlintasan rusak, jangan mendekati atau mengoperasikan alat. Jaga jarak dari posisi aman dan laporkan lokasi serta gejalanya kepada penanggung jawab yang ditetapkan. Kasus: alarm perlintasan berbunyi terus dan palang terlihat tidak bergerak. Respons: jangan mencoba mengangkat palang; segera laporkan dan ikuti arahan pengamanan.
english_text: If you see a broken cable, dark signal, alarm, sparks, or damaged crossing barrier, do not approach or operate the equipment. Keep your distance from a safe position and report the location and symptoms to the designated person in charge. Example: a crossing alarm sounds continuously and the barrier appears stationary. Response: do not try to lift it; report the problem promptly and follow safety instructions.

english_text: Do not assume a cable or device is safe because it appears switched off or motionless.

english_text: A level-crossing barrier is not moving as usual while the alarm continues to sound.

source_text: Tetap di tempat aman, jangan menyentuh palang atau alat, lalu laporkan keadaan kepada petugas operasi agar pengamanan dilakukan.
english_text: Stay in a safe place, do not touch the barrier or equipment, and report the situation to operations staff so safeguards can be put in place.

source_text: Memastikan alat dan personel diperiksa sebelum area dikembalikan.
english_text: Ensure tools and personnel are accounted for before the area is returned to service.

source_text: Pemeliharaan jalur atau listrik dilakukan dengan tim dan sistem perlindungan operator. Sebelum bekerja, anggota memahami siapa pengawasnya, lokasi aman, batas akses, alat komunikasi, serta cara berhenti. Kembalinya area ke layanan juga mengikuti pemeriksaan dan izin yang ditetapkan. Satu pekerja tidak boleh menganggap pekerjaan selesai hanya karena tugas pribadinya telah rampung.
english_text: Track or electrical maintenance is carried out by a team under the operator's protection system. Before work, members must know the supervisor, safe locations, access limits, communication equipment, and stop procedure. Returning an area to service also requires the designated inspection and authorization. A worker must not assume the job is complete just because their own task is finished.

source_text: Ikuti pengarahan sebelum kerja dan ulangi instruksi yang belum dipahami. Jika komunikasi terputus, batas berubah, atau ada orang di area yang salah, berhenti sesuai prosedur dan beri tahu pengawas. Pada akhir kerja, serahkan alat, sisa material, dan status temuan; jangan melepas pembatas atau memberi izin jalur dibuka. Kasus: ada alat tertinggal ketika tim hendak menutup pekerjaan. Respons: laporkan dan periksa kembali bersama tim sebelum penanggung jawab menyatakan area siap.
english_text: Attend the pre-work briefing and repeat any instruction you do not understand. If communication is lost, boundaries change, or someone is in the wrong area, stop according to procedure and notify the supervisor. At the end, hand over tools, leftover materials, and finding status; do not remove barriers or authorize reopening the track. Example: a tool remains when the team is preparing to close the job. Response: report it and check again as a team before the person in charge declares the area ready.

english_text: Original practice in rail-vehicle inspection, parts management, vehicle production, and station and train cleaning. Technical inspection, assembly, and equipment operation require specific training and supervision.

source_text: Mengikuti daftar inspeksi kendaraan dan tidak melewati butir yang belum pasti.
english_text: Follow the vehicle inspection checklist and do not skip uncertain items.

source_text: Mencatat gejala sebagai fakta, bukan langsung menyimpulkan penyebab.
english_text: Record symptoms as facts instead of immediately concluding what caused them.

source_text: Menyerahkan temuan kepada petugas teknis atau pengawas.
english_text: Pass findings to technical staff or the supervisor.

source_text: Pekerjaan kendaraan dapat meliputi inspeksi terjadwal atau insidental pada rem, pintu, perangkat listrik, pendingin udara, roda, dan bagian lain. Prosedur perusahaan menentukan siapa yang memeriksa, alat apa yang digunakan, serta keputusan apakah kendaraan siap. Pekerja baru mempelajari batas kewenangan dan tidak mengubah komponen tanpa instruksi.
english_text: Vehicle work may include scheduled or unscheduled checks of brakes, doors, electrical devices, air conditioning, wheels, and other parts. Company procedures specify who inspects, which tools are used, and how vehicle readiness is decided. New workers must learn the limits of their authority and must not alter components without instruction.

source_text: Tandai nomor kendaraan atau bagian, kondisi yang terlihat atau terdengar, waktu pemeriksaan, dan langkah yang sudah dilakukan. Jika ada tanda yang berbeda dari daftar, tahan item terkait dan laporkan. Kasus: terdengar bunyi tidak biasa ketika pintu diuji. Respons: jangan melanjutkan penggunaan kendaraan tanpa konfirmasi dari petugas yang berwenang.
english_text: Record the vehicle or part number, conditions seen or heard, inspection time, and actions taken. If something differs from the checklist, hold the relevant item and report it. Example: an unusual sound is heard while testing a door. Response: do not continue using the vehicle without confirmation from authorized staff.

Latihan orisinal untuk pemeriksaan kendaraan rel, pengelolaan suku cadang, produksi kendaraan, serta pembersihan stasiun dan kereta. Pemeriksaan teknis, perakitan, dan pengoperasian alat memerlukan pelatihan dan pengawasan khusus.
english_text: Original practice in rail-vehicle inspection, parts management, vehicle production, and station and train cleaning. Technical inspection, assembly, and equipment operation require specific training and supervision.

source_text: Mencocokkan nomor dan kelompok bahan dengan instruksi kerja produksi.
english_text: Match part numbers and material batches to the production work order.

source_text: Mengikuti penugasan perakitan serta melaporkan bahan yang rusak atau tidak cocok.
english_text: Follow the assembly assignment and report damaged or mismatched materials.

source_text: Mencatat hasil kerja agar bahan dan kendaraan yang dibuat dapat ditelusuri.
english_text: Record work results so materials and vehicles can be traced.

source_text: Bengkel dan pabrik kereta menerima bahan, memasang atau merakit komponen, lalu memeriksa hasil kerja sesuai perintah produksi. Setiap komponen dapat mempunyai nomor, kelompok bahan, gambar kerja, dan posisi pemasangan tertentu. Komponen yang terlihat serupa belum tentu dapat saling menggantikan. Alat, bahan, perakitan, dan pemeriksaan hanya dilakukan sesuai tugas, pelatihan, dan pengawasan perusahaan. Catatan bahan yang digunakan serta hasil pemeriksaan menjaga riwayat kendaraan tetap dapat ditelusuri.
english_text: Rail workshops and factories receive materials, install or assemble parts, and inspect work against production orders. Each part may have a specific number, material batch, drawing, and installation position. Parts that look alike are not necessarily interchangeable. Use tools and materials, assemble, and inspect only as assigned and under company training and supervision. Records of materials used and inspection results keep vehicle histories traceable.

source_text: Sebelum mulai, cocokkan nomor bagian dan kelompok bahan dengan perintah kerja. Ikuti gambar atau urutan yang diberikan, gunakan hanya alat yang menjadi tugas Anda, dan catat pemeriksaan yang benar-benar dilakukan. Bila nomor tidak cocok, bahan rusak, atau hasil rakitan terlihat berbeda dari instruksi, hentikan tahap itu dan beri tahu pengawas. Kasus: label kotak menyebut model berbeda dari daftar kerja. Respons: jangan berikan ke jalur perakitan, laporkan selisih, dan tunggu konfirmasi.
english_text: Before starting, match part numbers and material batches to the work order. If a number does not match, material is damaged, or an assembly differs from instructions, stop that stage and tell the supervisor. Example: a box label gives a different model from the work list. english_text: This sector focuses on intermediate waste processing for recycling or appropriate treatment, not every type of collection work. Each facility has its own acceptance criteria and record format. Lot identity links incoming material to sorting, processing, and subsequent output.

english_text:

Suggested response: Do not continue normal unloading. Hold the vehicle in a safe location, record the discrepancy, and request an inspection by the person in charge.

source_text: Muatan dapat mengandung benda tajam, baterai, tabung, cairan, bahan kimia, atau benda tertutup yang tidak sesuai dengan keterangan awal. Bahan tidak dikenal tidak aman untuk dibuka atau dipilah dengan tangan. Kriteria dan jalur penanganan ditetapkan fasilitas; pekerja menghentikan pekerjaan, menjaga orang lain menjauh, dan meminta petugas yang terlatih menilai.
english_text: A load may contain sharp objects, batteries, cylinders, liquids, chemicals, or sealed items that do not match the initial description. It is unsafe to open or hand-sort unidentified material. The facility sets handling criteria and routes; workers must stop, keep others back, and request an assessment by trained staff.

source_text:
Amati dari posisi aman tanpa mengguncang atau membuka wadah. Beri tanda atau batas sesuai prosedur, sampaikan lokasi, bentuk, tulisan, dan bau yang teramati, lalu tunggu instruksi. Jangan menyentuh cairan, baterai rusak, tabung, atau bahan berdebu tanpa penugasan dan perlindungan yang sesuai.

Kasus latihan: Pada ban berjalan terlihat baterai menggembung dan mengeluarkan bau, sementara pekerja lain akan mengambilnya.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Berikan tanda berhenti sesuai aturan, jaga jarak, peringatkan kru, dan laporkan segera agar petugas terlatih menentukan penanganan.
english_text:

Mark or cordon off the area as required, report the location, shape, markings, and any odor you notice, then wait for instructions. Do not touch liquid, damaged batteries, cylinders, or dusty materials unless assigned and properly protected.

Practice scenario: A swollen, odorous battery is visible on the conveyor while another worker is about to pick it up.
Suggested response: Give the stop signal as required, keep your distance, warn the crew, and report it immediately so trained staff can decide how to handle it.

english_text: Sorting directs material to the appropriate process and prevents cross-contamination between fractions. Do not classify material by color or shape alone; use labels, acceptance lists, examples, and line instructions. Identify mixed material that cannot yet be sorted safely and handle it according to workplace rules.

english_text: Sorted material may be compacted, wrapped, or prepared for the next processing stage. Containers and labels preserve the fraction identity, quantity, and destination process. Suggested response: Hold the output, record the visible markings, and ask the person in charge to trace the lot before moving it to the next process.

source_text: Hasil proses dapat menjadi bahan baku untuk tahap lain, produk yang dapat digunakan kembali, atau residu yang memerlukan jalur berbeda. Catatan fasilitas menghubungkan berat dan identitas bahan masuk dengan hasil serta tujuan berikutnya. Format dan data yang dicatat mengikuti prosedur setempat; pekerja tidak menebak kategori atau tujuan.
english_text: Processed material may become feedstock for another stage, a reusable product, or residue that needs a different route. Facility records link incoming material weight and identity to the output and its next destination. Follow local procedures for record formats and data; do not guess the category or destination.

source_text:
Periksa label dan kartu proses sebelum pemindahan, timbang atau hitung sesuai instruksi, lalu catat hasil aktual. Bila jumlah tidak cocok atau tanda tujuan hilang, tahan hasil di lokasi yang ditetapkan. Jangan mengisi dokumen dengan angka target atau memindahkan bahan ke area lain tanpa izin.

Kasus latihan: Berat keluaran pada alat timbang berbeda dari catatan, dan label tujuan pada wadah terlepas.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tahan wadah, catat hasil timbang aktual dan informasi yang masih ada, lalu minta penanggung jawab memulihkan tujuan sebelum pengiriman internal.
english_text:
Before transfer, check the label and process card, weigh or count as instructed, and record the actual result. If the quantity does not match or the destination marking is missing, hold the output in the designated location. Do not enter target figures in the records or move material elsewhere without permission.

Practice scenario: The output weight on the scale differs from the record, and the container's destination label has come off.
Suggested response: Hold the container, record the actual weight and any remaining information, and ask the person in charge to restore its destination before internal transfer.

source_text: Menjaga area simpan tertata dan melaporkan debu, tumpahan, bau, atau bahan yang dapat mencemari lingkungan.

source_text: Area simpan dapat memiliki material berbeda dengan batas tumpukan, penutup, dan rute kendaraan tersendiri. Debu, cairan, atau serpihan dapat menyebabkan gangguan pernapasan, lantai licin, atau pencemaran. Pengendalian mengikuti perlengkapan dan prosedur fasilitas; pekerja tidak menyapu, menyiram, atau memindahkan tumpahan berbahaya tanpa arahan.
english_text: Storage areas may contain different materials with specific stacking limits, covers, and vehicle routes. Dust, liquid, or fragments can cause breathing problems, slippery floors, or contamination. Follow the facility's controls and equipment requirements; do not sweep, wash, or move a hazardous spill without instructions.

source_text:
Letakkan wadah pada area bertanda, jaga jalur keluar tetap kosong, dan periksa penutup serta kebocoran. Bila debu berlebihan atau cairan keluar dari wadah, beri peringatan, jaga jarak, dan laporkan lokasi serta jenis yang diketahui. Gunakan alat pelindung dan prosedur hanya jika tugas itu diberikan kepada Anda.

Kasus latihan: Cairan keluar dari drum penyimpanan di dekat saluran lantai dan pekerja tidak mengetahui isi drum.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan menyentuh atau menyiram cairan. Jauhkan orang, tandai area sesuai aturan, dan hubungi petugas berwenang.
english_text:
Place containers in marked areas, keep exit routes clear, and check lids and for leaks. If there is excessive dust or liquid escaping, warn others, keep your distance, and report the location and any known material type. Use protective equipment and procedures only if assigned to the task.

Practice scenario: Liquid is leaking from a storage drum near a floor drain, and the worker does not know what the drum contains.
Suggested response: Do not touch or wash away the liquid. Keep people back, mark the area as required, and contact authorized staff.

source_text: Pekerjaan fasilitas berlangsung lintas proses dan giliran. Serah terima yang jelas menyebut lokasi, nomor lot, status mesin, jumlah yang dicatat, serta tindakan berikutnya. Catatan faktual membantu melanjutkan pekerjaan tanpa mencampur keluaran atau mengulang langkah yang sudah selesai. Bahaya yang masih aktif harus diserahkan langsung.
english_text: Facility work spans processes and shifts. A clear handover states the location, lot number, machine status, recorded quantity, and next action. Factual records help the next team continue without mixing output or repeating completed steps. Hand over active hazards directly.

source_text:
Periksa daftar akhir, kembalikan alat pada lokasi, dan tandai lot yang masih menunggu hasil. Beri tahu penerima tentang kerusakan, tanda yang hilang, atau area yang dibatasi. Jangan menulis pekerjaan selesai jika belum dilakukan; minta penerima mengulang informasi penting untuk memastikan pemahaman.

Kasus latihan: Pada akhir giliran, satu wadah hasil masih menunggu verifikasi lot dan jalur di dekat mesin diberi tanda batas.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pertahankan tanda tahan dan batas jalur, catat nomor wadah serta alasan, lalu serahkan langsung kepada penerima giliran dan pemimpin.
english_text:
Complete the closing checklist, return tools to their locations, and mark lots still awaiting results. Tell the next person about damage, missing labels, or restricted areas. Do not mark unfinished work as complete; ask the recipient to repeat key information to confirm understanding.

Practice scenario: At the end of the shift, one output container is still awaiting lot verification, and the route near the machine has been marked off.
Suggested response: Keep the hold marker and route boundary in place, record the container number and reason, and hand over directly to the next shift and leader.

english_text: Original practice material for truck drivers: vehicle inspections and transport instructions, cargo handling, and trip communications. The official work scope includes commercial freight transport and related duties; detailed procedures follow company rules and the person in charge.

source_text: Pengemudi memulai giliran dengan membaca tujuan, jadwal, jenis muatan, dan pesan dari pengatur kendaraan. Periksa kendaraan memakai daftar yang berlaku di perusahaan: lihat kondisi luar, lampu, ban, kaca, pintu muatan, dan tanda peringatan pada panel. Pemeriksaan ini membantu menemukan masalah lebih awal; daftar latihan ini tidak menggantikan pemeriksaan yang diwajibkan atau pelatihan resmi.
english_text: Drivers start a shift by reviewing destinations, schedules, cargo type, and dispatcher messages. Inspect the vehicle using the company checklist: check the exterior, lights, tires, windows, cargo doors, and dashboard warning indicators. These checks help identify problems early; this practice checklist does not replace required inspections or formal training.

source_text: Lakukan pemeriksaan di tempat yang aman dan ikuti urutan perusahaan. Jangan membuka atau memperbaiki bagian kendaraan jika tidak berwenang. Bila ada lampu peringatan, kebocoran, kerusakan, atau catatan yang belum jelas, jangan berangkat dengan menebak bahwa kendaraan baik; beri tahu penanggung jawab dan tunggu keputusan. Kasus: lampu peringatan menyala saat pemeriksaan. Respons: catat tandanya, sampaikan kepada pengatur, dan gunakan kendaraan hanya setelah mendapat izin sesuai prosedur.
english_text: Carry out inspections in a safe location and follow the company's sequence. Do not open or repair vehicle components unless authorized. If there is a warning light, leak, defect, or unclear record, do not assume the vehicle is fit to drive; inform the person in charge and wait for a decision. Case: a warning light comes on during inspection. Response: record the indicator, report it to the dispatcher, and use the vehicle only after receiving approval under procedure.

source_text: Menyampaikan selisih atau risiko muatan sebelum kendaraan berjalan.
english_text: Report cargo discrepancies or risks before the vehicle moves.

source_text: Tugas truk berpusat pada barang. Cocokkan nama atau nomor tujuan, jumlah koli, dan tanda penanganan pada barang dengan dokumen. Susunan muatan dan alat pengikat harus mengikuti pelatihan, batas kendaraan, serta petunjuk perusahaan agar barang tidak bergeser atau jatuh. Kertas yang terlihat cocok belum membuktikan bahwa jumlah dan kondisi fisik sudah benar.
english_text: Truck duties center on goods. Match the recipient name or destination number, package count, and handling labels to the documents. Arrange and secure the load according to training, vehicle limits, and company instructions so goods do not shift or fall. Documents that appear to match do not prove that the quantity and physical condition are correct.

source_text: Periksa jenis dan kondisi kemasan bersama petugas muat. Gunakan alat hanya jika sudah dilatih dan diberi izin; jangan berdiri di area gerak alat. Bila jumlah berbeda, tanda barang rapuh tidak terlihat, atau pengikat tampak longgar, hentikan tahap itu dan minta koreksi. Kasus: dokumen menunjukkan 12 kotak tetapi hitungan ada 11. Respons: pisahkan muatan, catat selisih, dan minta konfirmasi sebelum berangkat.
english_text: Check package type and condition with the loading staff. Use equipment only if trained and authorized; stay out of its operating area. If the quantity differs, a fragile-item label is missing, or a strap looks loose, stop that stage and ask for correction. Case: the documents list 12 boxes, but the count is 11. Response: separate the load, record the discrepancy, and request confirmation before departure.

english_text: Keep communication brief and clear when the destination cannot yet be reached.

source_text: Dalam perjalanan, kemacetan, cuaca, penutupan jalan, atau alamat yang sulit ditemukan dapat mengubah rencana. Pengemudi memberi tahu pengatur sesuai kanal perusahaan agar jadwal dan penerima dapat dikoordinasikan. Untuk serah barang, ikuti cara verifikasi penerima dan bukti serah yang ditentukan perusahaan; jangan meninggalkan barang di tempat lain atas keputusan sendiri.
english_text: During a trip, traffic, weather, road closures, or a hard-to-find address may change the plan. The driver informs the dispatcher through the company channel so schedules and recipients can be coordinated. For goods delivery, follow the company's recipient-verification and proof-of-delivery procedures; do not leave goods elsewhere on your own decision.

source_text: Saat berhenti di lokasi aman, sampaikan nomor perjalanan, posisi atau tujuan, masalah yang diamati, dan perkiraan yang dapat dipastikan. Catat waktu tiba, jumlah yang diserahkan, kondisi kemasan, serta penerima sesuai prosedur. Kasus: alamat tujuan tutup dan tidak ada petugas. Respons: lindungi muatan, laporkan keadaan, lalu tunggu instruksi untuk pengantaran ulang atau lokasi lain.
english_text: Once stopped in a safe location, report the trip number, position or destination, observed problem, and any estimate that can be confirmed. Record arrival time, quantity delivered, package condition, and recipient according to procedure. Case: the destination is closed and no staff member is present. Response: secure the cargo, report the situation, and wait for instructions about redelivery or another location.

english_text: Inspect the bus using the work checklist and report abnormal conditions.

source_text: Membedakan tugas bus penumpang dari pengiriman barang.
english_text: Distinguish passenger-bus duties from goods delivery.

source_text: Bus mengangkut penumpang pada layanan yang telah ditetapkan. Sebelum berangkat, pengemudi membaca rute, jadwal, pemberitahuan gangguan, dan catatan kendaraan. Pemeriksaan sebelum serta sesudah operasi dilakukan menurut daftar perusahaan, termasuk area pintu, kabin, lampu, serta tanda peringatan. Pengemudi mengikuti batas tugas dan arahan petugas operasi.
english_text: A bus carries passengers on an assigned service. Before departure, the driver reviews the route, schedule, disruption notices, and vehicle records. Pre- and post-operation checks follow the company checklist and include the door area, cabin, lights, and warning indicators. Drivers stay within their assigned duties and follow operations staff instructions.

source_text: Jika ada masalah kendaraan atau informasi rute tidak cocok, laporkan sebelum mengangkut penumpang. Jangan mengubah urutan pemberhentian, mematikan sistem peringatan, atau membawa bus yang belum dinyatakan siap. Kasus: pemberitahuan di terminal menyebut perubahan rute, tetapi lembar tugas masih menunjukkan rute lama. Respons: minta konfirmasi dan gunakan informasi yang sudah disahkan.
english_text: Report vehicle problems or route discrepancies before carrying passengers. Do not change the order of stops, disable a warning system, or take a bus that has not been cleared for service. Case: a terminal notice gives a route change, but the duty sheet still shows the old route. Response: ask for confirmation and use the information that has been authorized.

english_text: Do not choose one route yourself. Contact operations staff, repeat the conflicting information, and wait for a confirmed route.

english_text: Passenger Boarding, Alighting, and Clear Assistance

source_text: Menggunakan komunikasi sopan saat penumpang bertanya tentang tujuan dan pemberhentian.
english_text: Communicate politely when passengers ask about destinations and stops.

source_text: Menjaga perhatian pada naik-turun penumpang sesuai prosedur bus.
english_text: Monitor passenger boarding and alighting according to bus procedures.

source_text: Meminta bantuan saat kebutuhan penumpang tidak dapat ditangani dengan aman.
english_text: Request assistance when a passenger's needs cannot be handled safely.

source_text: Pada bus, keselamatan penumpang berlaku saat mereka menunggu, naik, duduk, dan turun. Pengemudi berhenti pada tempat layanan yang ditetapkan, mengikuti prosedur pintu, dan mengamati keadaan sebelum bergerak. Pertanyaan tentang tujuan atau pemberhentian dijawab dengan bahasa sederhana. Kebutuhan khusus atau masalah yang tidak jelas diteruskan kepada petugas yang dapat membantu.
english_text: On a bus, passenger safety matters while people wait, board, sit, and alight. Drivers stop at designated service points, follow door procedures, and check conditions before moving. Answer questions about destinations or stops in simple language. Refer special needs or unclear problems to staff who can help.

source_text: Sampaikan informasi tanpa mengganggu perhatian saat kendaraan bergerak. Beri waktu penumpang naik atau turun sesuai prosedur dan jangan menutup pintu ketika ada orang di area pintu. Bila penumpang jatuh, sakit, atau meminta bantuan yang tidak dapat diberikan saat mengemudi, hentikan layanan sesuai prosedur aman dan hubungi pihak terkait. Kasus: penumpang lanjut usia belum duduk. Respons: tunggu sampai aman sebelum melanjutkan.
english_text: Provide information without distracting the driver while the vehicle is moving. Give passengers time to board or alight under procedure, and do not close the doors while anyone is in the doorway. If a passenger falls, becomes ill, or needs help that cannot be given while driving, stop the service safely under procedure and contact the relevant party. Case: an older passenger has not yet sat down. Response: wait until it is safe before continuing.

source_text: Berhenti di tempat layanan yang ditentukan
english_text: Stop at the designated service point.

source_text: Buka pintu dan amati proses naik-turun
english_text: Open the doors and monitor boarding and alighting.

source_text: Pastikan area pintu aman menurut prosedur
english_text: Make sure the doorway is safe under procedure.

source_text: Berangkat dan jawab pertanyaan saat aman
english_text: Depart and answer questions when it is safe.

source_text: Jangan mulai bergerak ketika penumpang masih berada di area pintu atau belum siap menurut prosedur.
english_text: Do not move while a passenger is still in the doorway or not yet ready under procedure.

source_text: Seorang penumpang naik perlahan dan masih berdiri dekat pintu ketika bus akan berangkat.
english_text: A passenger boards slowly and is still standing near the door when the bus is about to leave.

source_text: Tunggu sampai penumpang berada pada keadaan aman sesuai prosedur, amati area pintu, lalu berangkat setelah aman.
english_text: Wait until the passenger is in a safe position under procedure, watch the doorway, and depart only when it is safe.

english_text: Inform passengers about changes that have been confirmed.

source_text: Melaporkan gangguan kepada petugas operasi dengan fakta yang dapat diamati.
english_text: Report a disruption to operations staff using observable facts.

source_text: Menjaga penumpang tetap tertib sambil menunggu arahan.
english_text: Keep passengers orderly while waiting for instructions.

source_text: Gangguan dapat berupa keterlambatan, kendaraan berhenti, atau perubahan layanan. Petugas operasi mengoordinasikan layanan; pengemudi memberi informasi yang telah dikonfirmasi dan tidak menjanjikan waktu atau rute yang belum pasti. Jika terjadi keadaan yang mengancam keselamatan, ikuti prosedur darurat perusahaan dan petunjuk petugas. Catat waktu, tempat, kondisi, serta tindakan yang dilakukan.
english_text: Disruptions may include delays, a stopped vehicle, or service changes. Operations staff coordinate the service; drivers provide confirmed information and do not promise an uncertain time or route. If a situation threatens safety, follow the company's emergency procedure and staff instructions. Record the time, place, condition, and actions taken.

source_text: Gunakan kalimat pendek dan jelas. Saat aman, hubungi petugas operasi dan sampaikan lokasi, nomor layanan, gejala, serta keadaan penumpang. Jangan menyebarkan dugaan sebagai fakta. Kasus: bus berhenti karena indikator menunjukkan gangguan dan penumpang bertanya kapan berangkat. Respons: amankan situasi, laporkan gejala, dan sampaikan bahwa waktu keberangkatan akan diumumkan setelah ada konfirmasi.
english_text: Use short, clear sentences. When safe, contact operations staff and provide the location, service number, symptoms, and passenger status. Do not present a guess as fact. Case: a bus stops because an indicator shows a fault, and a passenger asks when it will depart. Response: keep the situation safe, report the indicator, and explain that departure time will be announced once confirmed.
Make the situation safe under procedure.
Report the location and fault indicator.
Wait for instructions from operations staff.

source_text: Jangan menjanjikan waktu berangkat atau memulai kembali sebelum mendapat arahan.
english_text: Do not promise a departure time or resume service before receiving instructions.

source_text: Bus berhenti karena ada tanda gangguan; penumpang meminta kepastian waktu berangkat.
english_text: The bus has stopped because a fault indicator appeared; a passenger asks when it will depart.

source_text: Ikuti prosedur, hubungi petugas operasi, dan beri tahu penumpang bahwa informasi waktu akan disampaikan setelah dikonfirmasi.
english_text: Follow procedure, contact operations staff, and tell passengers that timing information will be shared once confirmed.

english_text: Politely confirm the order identity and destination.

source_text: Mengulang informasi tujuan untuk mengurangi salah paham.
english_text: Repeat destination information to reduce misunderstandings.

source_text: Mengikuti kebijakan perusahaan saat informasi penumpang belum jelas.
english_text: Follow company policy when passenger information is unclear.

source_text: Taksi melayani perjalanan penumpang berdasarkan permintaan atau pesanan. Sebelum mulai, cocokkan informasi pemesanan yang boleh diperiksa: nama atau tanda pengenal pesanan, titik jemput, dan tujuan. Tanyakan tujuan dengan jelas dan ulangi kembali. Bila penumpang ingin mengubah tujuan, pastikan bahwa perubahan dipahami dan ikuti proses perusahaan untuk tarif atau pencatatan.
english_text: Taxis provide passenger trips on request or by booking. Before starting, check the booking information you are authorized to verify: the name or booking identifier, pickup point, and destination. Ask clearly for the destination and repeat it back. If the passenger wants to change the destination, make sure the change is understood and follow company procedures for fares and records.

source_text: Jaga privasi penumpang dan hindari menyebut data pribadi dengan suara keras di tempat umum. Jika nama, lokasi, atau tujuan berbeda, jangan menebak; konfirmasikan dengan penumpang atau pusat layanan. Kasus: aplikasi menunjukkan alamat berbeda dari yang diucapkan penumpang. Respons: ulangi kedua alamat dan minta penumpang memastikan sebelum perjalanan dimulai.
english_text: Protect passenger privacy and avoid saying personal information aloud in public. If the name, location, or destination differs, do not guess; confirm with the passenger or service center. Case: the app shows a different address from the one the passenger gives. Response: repeat both addresses and ask the passenger to confirm before starting the trip.
Greet the passenger and confirm the destination.
Repeat the destination and any special needs.
Start the trip once the information is understood.

source_text: Jangan menganggap alamat pada layar benar bila penumpang menyebut tujuan lain.
english_text: Do not assume the address on the screen is correct if the passenger gives another destination.

source_text: Layar pesanan menunjukkan satu alamat, tetapi penumpang menyebut alamat yang berbeda.
english_text: The order screen shows one address, but the passenger gives a different one.

source_text: Ulangi alamat pada layar dan alamat yang diucapkan, lalu minta penumpang memastikan tujuan yang benar sebelum berangkat.
english_text: Repeat the address shown on the screen and the one the passenger gave, then ask them to confirm the correct destination before departure.
