english_text: Follow company procedures for routes, fares, and payments.

source_text: Menyerahkan pertanyaan yang tidak dapat dipastikan kepada petugas yang tepat.
english_text: Refer questions that cannot be confirmed to the appropriate staff member.

source_text: Pengemudi taksi menjalankan operasi dan pelayanan penumpang. Pastikan penumpang dapat mendengar penjelasan tentang tujuan atau pilihan rute. Gunakan alat navigasi sesuai aturan perusahaan dan tetap fokus pada jalan. Tarif, metode pembayaran, serta tanda terima ditangani menurut perangkat dan prosedur setempat; jangan menjanjikan harga yang tidak tercatat atau mengubahnya sendiri.
english_text: Taxi drivers perform driving duties and passenger service. Make sure passengers can hear explanations about the destination or route options. Use navigation equipment according to company rules and keep your attention on the road. Handle fares, payments, and receipts using the local equipment and procedures; do not promise an unrecorded fare or change it yourself.

source_text: Jika penumpang meminta rute tertentu, dengarkan saat aman dan ulangi permintaannya. Bila ada perbedaan antara navigasi dan arahan penumpang, berhenti di tempat aman bila perlu untuk mengklarifikasi. Untuk kesalahan alat pembayaran, ikuti prosedur dan hubungi pusat layanan. Kasus: perangkat pembayaran tidak merespons. Respons: jelaskan singkat, jangan mengulang penagihan tanpa pemeriksaan, lalu minta bantuan sesuai prosedur.
english_text: If a passenger requests a particular route, listen when it is safe and repeat the request. If the navigation system and the passenger's directions differ, stop in a safe place if necessary to clarify. For payment-terminal problems, follow procedure and contact the service center. Case: the payment terminal does not respond. Response: explain briefly, do not attempt the charge again without checking, and request assistance under procedure.
Listen to the passenger's request when safe.

source_text: Pastikan rute atau layanan yang disepakati
english_text: Confirm the agreed route or service.
Use navigation without diverting your attention.

source_text: Selesaikan pembayaran dan bukti transaksi sesuai prosedur
english_text: Complete payment and transaction records according to procedure.

source_text: Jangan melihat atau mengetik perangkat saat perhatian harus tertuju pada jalan.
english_text: Do not look at or type on a device when your attention must be on the road.

source_text: Setelah perjalanan, terminal pembayaran tidak menampilkan konfirmasi dan penumpang bertanya apakah sudah dibayar.
english_text: After the trip, the payment terminal shows no confirmation, and the passenger asks whether payment went through.

source_text: Periksa status transaksi sesuai prosedur perusahaan, jelaskan bahwa Anda sedang memastikan, dan hubungi petugas bila hasilnya belum jelas.
english_text: Check the transaction status under company procedure, explain that you are confirming it, and contact staff if the result remains unclear.

source_text: Mendengar permintaan penumpang tanpa menjanjikan bantuan yang belum dipastikan.
english_text: Listen to a passenger's request without promising unconfirmed assistance.

source_text: Mengambil langkah awal yang aman dan menghubungi petugas saat terjadi keadaan mendesak.
english_text: Take safe initial action and contact staff when an urgent situation occurs.

source_text: Penumpang mungkin membutuhkan bantuan karena sakit, barang tertinggal, atau kesulitan memahami informasi. Pengemudi berbicara dengan tenang, menilai apakah kendaraan dapat berhenti di tempat aman, dan mengikuti panduan perusahaan. Dalam keadaan darurat, hubungi layanan atau petugas yang ditetapkan; pengemudi tidak menggantikan tenaga medis atau memaksakan pertolongan di luar kemampuannya.
english_text: Passengers may need help because they feel ill, have left an item behind, or cannot understand information. Drivers speak calmly, assess whether the vehicle can stop in a safe place, and follow company guidance. In an emergency, contact the designated service or staff member; drivers do not replace medical professionals or attempt assistance beyond their abilities.

source_text: Tanyakan kebutuhan dengan kalimat sederhana. Jika penumpang sakit atau ada bahaya, hentikan kendaraan di tempat aman sesuai keadaan, hubungi pihak yang berwenang, dan sampaikan lokasi serta kondisi yang terlihat. Jangan mempublikasikan identitas atau keadaan penumpang. Kasus: penumpang mengeluh pusing mendadak. Respons: berhenti aman bila memungkinkan, tanyakan apakah perlu bantuan, dan segera hubungi sesuai prosedur.
english_text: Ask about needs in simple sentences. If a passenger becomes ill or there is danger, stop the vehicle in a safe place for the circumstances, contact the authorized party, and report the location and observable condition. Do not publicize the passenger's identity or condition. Case: a passenger suddenly complains of dizziness. Response: stop safely if possible, ask whether help is needed, and contact the designated party promptly under procedure.

source_text: Pindahkan kendaraan ke keadaan aman jika diperlukan
english_text: Move the vehicle to a safe state if needed.

source_text: Hubungi petugas atau layanan sesuai prosedur
english_text: Contact staff or the designated service under procedure.
Record and hand over important information.

source_text: Jangan menjanjikan diagnosis atau meninggalkan penumpang tanpa arahan yang sesuai.
english_text: Do not promise a diagnosis or leave a passenger without appropriate guidance.

source_text: Penumpang tiba-tiba mengeluh pusing dan meminta kendaraan berhenti.
english_text: A passenger suddenly says they feel dizzy and asks the vehicle to stop.

source_text: Hentikan kendaraan di tempat aman bila dapat dilakukan, tanyakan kebutuhan bantuan, dan hubungi pihak yang ditentukan oleh prosedur perusahaan.
english_text: Stop the vehicle in a safe place if possible, ask what help is needed, and contact the party specified by company procedure.

english_text: 安全な場所に止めます。助けを呼びますか。

source_text: Sesudah perjalanan, truk mencatat status barang dan serah terima; bus dan taksi mencatat perjalanan serta urusan penumpang menurut formulir masing-masing. Pengemudi juga melakukan pemeriksaan setelah operasi sesuai daftar. Catatan waktu, jarak, kendala, kerusakan, dan barang yang belum selesai membantu penanggung jawab giliran berikutnya.
english_text: After a trip, truck drivers record goods status and handover; bus and taxi drivers record trip and passenger matters using their respective forms. Drivers also carry out post-operation checks using the applicable checklist. Records of time, distance, problems, damage, and outstanding items help the person in charge of the next shift.

source_text: Isi catatan dekat dengan waktu kejadian dan gunakan fakta: apa yang terjadi, kapan, di mana, dan tindakan apa yang dilakukan. Jangan memakai tanda tangan atau bukti penerimaan yang belum benar-benar diterima. Kasus: pada tugas truk, satu paket tetap di kendaraan karena penerima tidak ada. english_text: Complete the record close to the time of the event and use facts: what happened, when and where it happened, and what action was taken. Do not use a signature or proof of receipt that was not actually received. Case: on a truck assignment, one package remains in the vehicle because the recipient is unavailable. Response: mark it as undelivered, note the approved temporary storage location, and hand over the information.

source_text: Kelelahan, sakit, emosi kuat, atau gangguan perhatian dapat memengaruhi pengemudian. Pengemudi memperhatikan kondisi diri dan mengikuti jadwal serta prosedur istirahat yang ditetapkan. Tidak ada satu perkiraan pribadi yang dapat menggantikan aturan kerja atau arahan medis. Keselamatan penumpang, barang, dan pengguna jalan lain harus menjadi prioritas.
english_text: Fatigue, illness, strong emotions, or distraction can affect driving. Drivers monitor their own condition and follow the established schedule and rest procedures. A personal estimate cannot replace work rules or medical advice. The safety of passengers, goods, and other road users must come first.

source_text: Jika mulai mengantuk atau merasa kondisi menurun, jangan menyembunyikannya untuk mengejar jadwal. Berhenti atau minta bantuan hanya dengan cara yang aman dan di tempat yang sesuai; hubungi pengatur dan ikuti instruksi. Kasus: mata terasa berat sebelum menyelesaikan rute. Respons: sampaikan kondisi dan lokasi aman, lalu minta arahan tentang istirahat atau penggantian.
english_text: If you become drowsy or feel your condition worsening, do not hide it to keep to the schedule. Stop or request assistance only in a safe way and at an appropriate location; contact the dispatcher and follow instructions. Case: your eyes feel heavy before the route is complete. Response: report your condition and safe location, then ask whether to rest or arrange a replacement.

source_text: Ketiga kelompok sama-sama menuntut operasi aman dan komunikasi, tetapi tugas utamanya berbeda. Truk membawa barang dan menangani muatan serta bukti serah barang. Bus membawa penumpang pada layanan dan rute yang dijadwalkan. Taksi melayani perjalanan penumpang per permintaan dengan konfirmasi tujuan dan layanan. Persyaratan lisensi dan pelatihan tiap kategori juga tidak sama.
english_text: All three vehicle groups require safe operation and communication, but their main duties differ. Trucks carry goods and handle cargo and proof of delivery. Buses carry passengers on scheduled services and routes. Taxis provide passenger trips on request, with destination and service confirmation. Licensing and training requirements also differ by category.

source_text: Baca jadwal dan penugasan sebelum giliran, lalu minta koreksi jika nama kendaraan atau jenis layanan tidak sesuai kompetensi dan lisensi. Respons: tahan keberangkatan dan minta penanggung jawab mengoreksi penugasan.
english_text: Review the schedule and assignment before your shift. Ask for a correction if the vehicle name or service type does not match your competence and license. Experience with one vehicle type does not automatically authorize you to operate another. Case: the duty list says bus, but the keys and instructions are for a truck. Response: hold departure and ask the person in charge to correct the assignment.

english_text: The 造船・舶用工業 field covers shipbuilding (造船), marine machinery (舶用機械), and marine electrical and electronic equipment (舶用電気電子機器). Processes vary by division and may include hull work, machinery, piping, painting, electrical assembly, or maintenance within the official scope.

source_text:

source_text: Divisi pekerjaan SSW berbeda dari trade yang dipakai untuk ujian keterampilan. Untuk No. 1, ujian trade yang dipublikasikan meliputi pengelasan, pengecatan, pekerjaan besi, finishing, permesinan, dan perakitan peralatan listrik. No. 2 memiliki kelompok trade berbeda.
english_text: SSW work divisions differ from the trades used for skills testing. Published No. 1 examination trades include welding, painting, ironwork, finishing, machining, and electrical equipment assembly. No. 2 has a different group of trades.

Response: Explain that work divisions and examination trades are different groupings, and check the official documents.

source_text: Galangan memiliki pekerjaan bersamaan: fabrikasi, pengangkatan, pengecatan, pemasangan mesin, dan pekerjaan listrik. Briefing harian mengomunikasikan urutan, zona, sinyal, perubahan cuaca, dan konflik antarpekerjaan. Tim mengikuti rencana serta prosedur lokasi.
english_text: Shipyards have overlapping tasks, including fabrication, lifting, painting, machinery installation, and electrical work. Daily briefings communicate sequence, zones, signals, weather changes, and conflicts between tasks. Teams follow the site plan and procedures.

source_text:
Kenali batas area, rute aman, metode komunikasi, dan pekerjaan berdekatan. Jika rencana pengangkatan atau urutan berubah, beri tahu tim dan hentikan aktivitas yang dapat berkonflik sampai koordinasi ulang.

Respons: Hentikan tugas yang memasuki zona terdampak dan koordinasikan kembali akses dengan penanggung jawab.
english_text:
Know the area boundaries, safe routes, communication methods, and nearby work. If the lifting plan or sequence changes, inform the team and stop any work that could conflict until coordination is complete.

Practice scenario: A ship-block move is starting in an area also used by your team.
Response: Stop tasks that enter the affected zone and coordinate access again with the person in charge.

source_text: Pengelasan adalah proses panas yang dapat menimbulkan luka bakar, kebakaran, asap, dan kerusakan pada material/struktur. english_text: Welding is a hot process that can cause burns, fires, fumes, and damage to materials or structures. Shipyard rules specify permits, area inspections, ignition-source controls, ventilation, PPE, and competence. A quiz does not train practical welding skills.

english_text: Ship painting protects surfaces and provides the specified finish. Follow product instructions and shipyard procedures for surface preparation, environmental conditions, coating system, drying time, and inspection. Dust, oil, moisture, and an incorrect coating can reduce quality.

source_text:

english_text: Ship electrical work includes cables, panels, sensors, and electrical or electronic equipment as designed. english_text: Outfitting installs equipment and interior or exterior ship components after coordinating with structures and other systems. Consider confined spaces, evacuation routes, protected surfaces, inspection access, and work sequence. Changes to a position require drawing approval.

source_text: Pemeriksaan dan pengujian kapal dilakukan sesuai titik tahan/inspeksi, kriteria, personel, alat, dan catatan yang ditetapkan. Hasil meragukan, cacat, atau uji gagal harus diidentifikasi, dipisahkan, dan dilaporkan. Perbaikan serta pengujian ulang menunggu keputusan dan metode yang disetujui.
english_text: Inspect and test the ship at the designated hold and inspection points using the specified criteria, personnel, tools, and records. Identify, segregate, and report questionable results, defects, and failed tests. Repairs and retesting must wait for a decision and approved method.

source_text:

Skenario latihan: Hasil uji sambungan menunjukkan kebocoran tetapi pekerjaan lanjutan menunggu.

english_text:

Practice scenario: A joint test reveals a leak, but follow-up work is waiting.
Response: Keep the system on hold and report the result; do not close it, repressurize it, or declare it passed yourself.

source_text: Bagian kapal dan peralatan dapat berat, memiliki titik angkat khusus, atau mudah rusak. Rencana rigging, alat terinspeksi, kapasitas, komunikasi, zona bebas orang, dan kondisi cuaca wajib mengikuti prosedur lokasi. Permukaan dan komponen perlu dilindungi selama penyimpanan.
english_text: Ship sections and equipment may be heavy, have designated lifting points, or be easily damaged. Follow site procedures for rigging plans, inspected equipment, capacity, communication, exclusion zones, and weather conditions. Protect surfaces and components during storage.

source_text:
Periksa penandaan berat/titik angkat dan rencana yang disetujui. Jangan memasuki beban tergantung atau mengarahkan operasi tanpa ditunjuk. Amankan komponen dalam penyangga yang tepat dan lindungi dari air, korosi, atau benturan.

Skenario latihan: Komponen menggantung dan pekerja meminta Anda melintas di bawahnya untuk mengambil alat.
Respons: Jangan melintas; tunggu beban diletakkan di posisi aman dan gunakan rute alternatif yang disetujui.
english_text:
Check weight and lifting-point marks and the approved plan. Do not enter beneath a suspended load or direct the operation unless designated. Secure components on suitable supports and protect them from water, corrosion, and impact.

Practice scenario: A component is suspended, and a worker asks you to pass underneath it to get a tool.
Response: Do not pass underneath; wait until the load is placed safely and use an approved alternative route.

source_text: Pekerjaan kapal berpindah antar-tim struktur, mesin, outfitting, listrik, dan inspeksi. Serah-terima mencantumkan nomor kapal/area, sistem, revisi, hasil pemeriksaan, status energi/isolasi, pekerjaan tertahan, dan batas akses. Catatan harus sesuai fakta agar tim berikutnya tidak mengandalkan asumsi.
english_text: Ship work passes between structural, machinery, outfitting, electrical, and inspection teams. Handovers identify the ship and area, system, revision, inspection results, energy and isolation status, work on hold, and access limits. Records must reflect the facts so the next team does not rely on assumptions.

source_text:
Pastikan label area dan status cocok dengan catatan. Sampaikan langsung isu keselamatan, bagian yang belum dilepas, dan izin yang masih berlaku. Minta penerima mengulang informasi kritis. Perbarui catatan melalui prosedur resmi.

Skenario latihan: Shift Anda berakhir saat panel masih diisolasi dan pekerjaan belum selesai.
Respons: Pertahankan label isolasi sesuai prosedur dan serahkan kondisi kepada petugas penerus yang berwenang.
english_text:
Make sure area labels and status match the records. Directly communicate safety issues, items not yet released, and permits still in effect. Ask the recipient to repeat critical information. Update records through the official procedure.

Practice scenario: Your shift ends while the panel is still isolated and the work is unfinished.
Response: Keep the isolation label in place according to procedure and hand over the status to an authorized successor.

source_text: Bahan yang datang dapat berupa kayu gelondongan, papan, lembaran venir, atau bahan lain sesuai proses. Nomor lot dan tanda asal menghubungkan bahan dengan rencana produksi. Saat menerima, pekerja memeriksa jumlah, ukuran, kerusakan yang terlihat, serta dokumen; bahan tanpa identitas tidak dicampur dengan kelompok yang sudah terverifikasi.
english_text: Incoming materials may include logs, boards, veneer sheets, or other items used in the process. Lot numbers and origin markings link materials to the production plan. At receipt, workers check the quantity, dimensions, visible damage, and documents; unidentified material must not be mixed with a verified lot.

source_text:
Gunakan area penerimaan yang ditandai dan cocokkan setiap tanda dengan dokumen kerja. Bila jumlah berbeda, label hilang, atau kayu pecah, catat apa yang terlihat dan pisahkan sesuai arahan. Jangan menebak jenis atau menyalin nomor dari tumpukan sebelah.

Kasus latihan: Satu tumpukan papan tidak memiliki label, tetapi pekerja diminta memindahkannya ke area bahan produksi.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan tumpukan, catat lokasinya, dan minta penanggung jawab menelusuri identitas sebelum pemindahan.
english_text:
Use the marked receiving area and match each marking to the work documents. If the quantity differs, a label is missing, or the wood is split, record what you observe and separate it as directed. Do not guess the type or copy a number from a neighboring stack.

Practice case: A stack of boards has no label, but a worker is asked to move it to the production-material area.
Recommended response: Separate the stack, record its location, and ask the person in charge to trace its identity before it is moved.

source_text: Kayu memiliki pola serat, lingkaran tahun, kadar air, dan variasi alami. Retak, mata kayu lepas, bengkok, atau perubahan permukaan dapat memengaruhi proses dan mutu. Pekerja memeriksa berdasarkan contoh dan kriteria produk; penilaian grade atau kegunaan akhir dilakukan sesuai prosedur dan peran yang ditetapkan.
english_text: Wood has grain patterns, growth rings, moisture content, and natural variation. Cracks, loose knots, warping, or surface changes can affect processing and quality. Workers inspect against product samples and criteria; final grading or decisions about use follow the designated procedure and role.

source_text:
Periksa permukaan dan ujung bahan sebelum memasukkannya ke proses, lalu tandai atau pisahkan cacat yang terlihat. Bila serat atau ukuran membuat pemotongan tidak sesuai instruksi, hentikan dan minta arahan. Jangan menyembunyikan cacat dengan menumpuk sisi bermasalah ke arah dalam.

Kasus latihan: Papan yang akan diproses memiliki retak panjang di ujung, tetapi dokumen tidak menjelaskan apakah retak itu dapat diterima.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan papan dan minta petugas mutu memeriksa sesuai kriteria sebelum diproses.
english_text:
Inspect the material's surfaces and ends before processing, then mark or separate visible defects. If the grain or dimensions make cutting inconsistent with the instructions, stop and ask for guidance. Do not conceal a defect by turning the affected side inward in the stack.

Practice case: A board to be processed has a long crack at one end, but the documents do not say whether it is acceptable.
Recommended response: Set the board aside and ask quality-control staff to check it against the criteria before processing.

source_text: Membaca target kadar air atau kondisi pengeringan yang diberikan dan menyimpan kayu agar tidak berubah bentuk.
english_text: Read the specified moisture target or drying condition and store wood to prevent deformation.

source_text: Kadar air memengaruhi berat, stabilitas dimensi, pemrosesan, dan mutu kayu. Pengeringan mengikuti jadwal serta target untuk jenis dan produk tertentu; pekerja tidak memakai satu angka untuk semua kayu. Cara menumpuk, sirkulasi udara, pelindung dari air, dan pencatatan lokasi ikut membantu menjaga kondisi bahan.
english_text: Moisture content affects wood weight, dimensional stability, processing, and quality. Drying follows the schedule and target for each type and product; workers must not use a single figure for all wood. Stacking methods, air circulation, protection from water, and location records also help preserve material condition.

source_text:
Periksa label tumpukan dan instruksi pengeringan, gunakan alat ukur sesuai pelatihan, lalu catat hasil aktual dan waktu. Susun spacer atau penyangga seperti yang ditunjukkan agar tumpukan stabil dan udara dapat bergerak. Bila hasil di luar target atau tumpukan basah dan miring, tandai serta laporkan.

Kasus latihan: Alat ukur menunjukkan hasil yang berbeda jauh dari kartu target pada satu tumpukan papan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Ulangi pemeriksaan hanya sesuai instruksi, catat pembacaan, dan tahan pemindahan sampai penanggung jawab menilai hasilnya.
english_text:
Check the stack label and drying instructions, use the measuring tool as trained, and record the actual result and time. Arrange spacers or supports as shown so the stack is stable and air can circulate. If the result is outside the target or the stack is wet or leaning, mark it and report the issue.

Practice case: A measuring tool gives a result far from the target on the card for a stack of boards.
Recommended response: Repeat the check only as instructed, record the reading, and hold the transfer until the person in charge evaluates the result.

source_text: Mesin penggergajian dan pemrosesan kayu memiliki mata potong, rol, konveyor, dan titik jepit yang berbahaya. Pemeriksaan awal memastikan pelindung terpasang, area bebas benda lepas, dan kontrol berfungsi sesuai daftar. Hanya operator yang telah dilatih menjalankan, membersihkan, atau menangani sumbatan sesuai prosedur fasilitas.
english_text: Woodworking and sawing machines have hazardous blades, rollers, conveyors, and pinch points. Initial checks confirm guards are fitted, the area is clear of loose objects, and controls work according to the checklist. Only trained operators may run, clean, or clear jams under facility procedures.

source_text:
Sebelum menyalakan, cocokkan mesin dan tugas pada instruksi, periksa pelindung serta tanda peringatan, dan pastikan pekerja lain di posisi aman. Bila suara, getaran, atau pelindung tidak normal, jangan hidupkan mesin. Jangan mencapai ke bagian dalam untuk membersihkan serbuk saat mesin masih bergerak.

Kasus latihan: Pelindung konveyor tidak menutup penuh, tetapi operator berikutnya sudah menyiapkan kayu untuk masuk.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tunda pengumpanan, jauhkan orang dari titik bahaya, dan laporkan pelindung agar diperiksa sebelum mesin dipakai.
english_text:
Before starting, match the machine and task to the instructions, check guards and warning signs, and make sure other workers are in safe positions. If the sound, vibration, or guard is abnormal, do not start the machine. Never reach inside to clear sawdust while the machine is moving.

Practice case: A conveyor guard does not close fully, but the next operator has already prepared wood to feed into it.
Recommended response: Hold the feed, keep people away from the hazard, and report the guard for inspection before using the machine.

source_text: Penggergajian mengubah bahan mentah menjadi ukuran produk yang direncanakan. Instruksi dapat menyebut panjang, lebar, ketebalan, orientasi, dan jumlah; angka perlu dibaca bersama satuannya. Toleransi dan cara ukur mengikuti spesifikasi produk, bukan perkiraan operator. Perubahan ukuran harus disetujui agar bahan tidak terbuang atau menjadi tidak sesuai.
english_text: Sawing converts raw material to planned product dimensions. Instructions may specify length, width, thickness, orientation, and quantity; read each number with its unit. Tolerances and measurement methods follow the product specification, not an operator's estimate. Changes to dimensions require approval to avoid waste or nonconforming products.

source_text:
Cocokkan kode produk dan bahan dengan lembar kerja sebelum mengumpan kayu. Gunakan alat ukur dan pembatas mesin yang diajarkan, lalu periksa sampel awal sesuai aturan. Bila angka atau satuan berbeda, hentikan sebelum memotong dan minta pemeriksaan kedua; jangan mengubah setelan diam-diam.

Kasus latihan: Lembar kerja menunjukkan ketebalan berbeda dari label pada tumpukan, dan pemotongan belum dimulai.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jangan memasukkan bahan. Tahan setelan, cocokkan kedua dokumen, dan minta penanggung jawab memastikan instruksi yang berlaku.
english_text:
Match the product and material codes to the work sheet before feeding the wood. Use the measuring tools and machine stops as trained, then inspect the initial sample as required. If a number or unit differs, stop before cutting and request a second check; do not quietly change the settings.

Practice case: The work sheet gives a thickness that differs from the stack label, and cutting has not started.
Recommended response: Do not feed the material. Keep the settings unchanged, compare both documents, and ask the person in charge to confirm the applicable instruction.

source_text: Industri kayu dapat mengolah lembaran venir, kayu lapis, LVL, atau kayu laminasi. Produk berbeda dalam susunan lapisan, orientasi, dan tujuan; urutan bahan serta identitas lembar penting untuk hasil dan ketertelusuran. Perekat dan tekanan ditangani sesuai instruksi serta pelatihan, dan hanya pekerja yang ditugaskan mengoperasikan alat terkait.
english_text: The wood industry may process veneer sheets, plywood, LVL, or laminated wood. Products differ in layer arrangement, orientation, and purpose; material sequence and sheet identity matter for results and traceability. Handle adhesives and pressure according to instructions and training; only assigned workers may operate the related equipment.

source_text:
Periksa tanda sisi, nomor lot, dan urutan tumpukan sebelum memasukkan lapisan. Jika lembar terbalik, rusak, atau tanda hilang, pisahkan untuk pemeriksaan. Jangan mengubah jenis perekat, jumlah lapisan, atau setelan mesin berdasarkan dugaan; laporkan perbedaan sebelum menekan atau merekatkan bahan.

Kasus latihan: Satu lembar venir memiliki tanda arah berbeda dari lembar lain dalam kelompok panel.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan penyusunan lapisan dan pisahkan lembar tersebut; minta operator atau pemimpin memastikan orientasi sebelum proses berlanjut.
english_text:
Check side markings, lot numbers, and stack order before feeding a layer. If a sheet is reversed, damaged, or missing a marking, set it aside for inspection. Do not change the adhesive type, number of layers, or machine settings based on a guess; report discrepancies before pressing or bonding the material.

Practice case: One veneer sheet has a direction marking that differs from the other sheets in the panel lot.
Recommended response: Stop arranging the layers and set the sheet aside; ask the operator or lead to confirm its orientation before continuing.

Sampel awal atau berkala membantu menemukan perubahan sebelum banyak bahan diproses.
english_text: Length, width, thickness, and shape affect whether a product is suitable for its next use. Each job has its own tolerances and measurement points; workers read the quality sheet and use checked tools. Initial or periodic samples help detect changes before large quantities are processed.

source_text:
Pastikan alat ukur bersih dan sesuai satuan, lalu ukur pada posisi yang dijelaskan. Catat hasil, waktu, mesin, dan kelompok produk. Bila hasil di luar toleransi atau alat ukur jatuh, hentikan pelepasan sampel terkait dan minta pemeriksaan; jangan menyesuaikan angka agar produk lulus.

Kasus latihan: Sampel pertama menunjukkan ketebalan di luar toleransi yang tercantum pada lembar kerja.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tahan produk sejak pemeriksaan terakhir, catat hasil sebenarnya, dan panggil petugas mutu atau pemimpin lini.
english_text:
Make sure the measuring tool is clean and set to the correct unit, then measure at the stated positions. Record the result, time, machine, and product lot. If the result is outside tolerance or the tool is dropped, stop releasing the affected samples and request an inspection; do not adjust figures to make a product pass.

Practice case: The first sample has a thickness outside the tolerance listed on the work sheet.
Recommended response: Hold products made since the last inspection, record the actual result, and call quality-control staff or the line lead.

source_text: Pemrosesan dapat menghasilkan cacat seperti tepi pecah, permukaan bergelombang, bekas pisau, atau serpihan. Pemeriksaan mengikuti sampel yang disetujui dan jenis penggunaan produk. Pekerja tidak menutup atau menghaluskan cacat di luar prosedur; bila tidak tahu apakah produk dapat diterima, ia meminta pemeriksaan petugas mutu.
english_text: Processing may cause defects such as chipped edges, wavy surfaces, knife marks, or splinters. Inspection follows approved samples and the product's intended use. Workers must not conceal or smooth defects outside procedure; if unsure whether a product is acceptable, request a quality-control inspection.

source_text:
Periksa sampel di area yang terang dengan cara aman, hindari menyentuh tepi tajam tanpa perlindungan, dan letakkan produk tidak sesuai pada area tahan. Catat letak cacat dan kode produk agar proses dapat ditinjau. Jangan memasukkan papan cacat kembali ke lini tanpa izin.

Kasus latihan: Beberapa papan memiliki serpihan tajam di tepi setelah proses planing, tetapi pekerja belum tahu apakah boleh dihaluskan sendiri.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Pisahkan papan dan minta petugas mutu menentukan perbaikan atau penolakan sesuai prosedur.
english_text:
Inspect samples safely in a well-lit area, avoid touching sharp edges without protection, and place nonconforming products in the hold area. Record the defect location and product code so the process can be reviewed. Do not return defective boards to the line without authorization.

Practice case: Several boards have sharp splinters along the edge after planing, and the worker does not know whether they may smooth them independently.
Recommended response: Set the boards aside and ask quality-control staff to determine repair or rejection under procedure.

source_text: Tanda produk dapat memuat jenis, ukuran, grade, lot, atau tujuan pelanggan. Kriteria grade berasal dari spesifikasi dan pemeriksaan yang ditetapkan; pekerja tidak menebak grade dari penampilan saja. Identitas harus tetap pada kelompok kayu saat berpindah dari proses ke pemeriksaan, penyimpanan, atau pengiriman.
english_text: Product markings may show type, dimensions, grade, lot, or customer destination. Grade criteria come from specifications and designated inspections; workers must not guess a grade from appearance alone. Keep the wood-lot identity attached as it moves from processing to inspection, storage, or dispatch.

source_text:
Cocokkan label dengan dokumen setelah proses dan sebelum pemindahan. Bila tanda lepas, rusak, atau jumlah tidak cocok, tahan kelompok dan tulis lokasi serta informasi yang masih terbaca. Jangan mencetak ulang atau mengubah grade tanpa izin petugas yang berwenang.

Kasus latihan: Label grade pada satu bundel basah dan tulisannya tidak dapat dibaca sebelum masuk ke area pengiriman.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tahan bundel di area pemeriksaan, catat nomor lot yang masih terlihat, dan minta petugas mutu memulihkan identitasnya.
english_text:
Compare the label with the documents after processing and before transfer. If a marking comes off, is damaged, or the quantity does not match, hold the lot and record its location and any readable information. Do not reprint a label or change the grade without authorization.

Practice case: The grade label on a bundle is wet and illegible before the bundle enters the dispatch area.
Recommended response: Hold the bundle in the inspection area, record any visible lot number, and ask quality-control staff to restore its identity.

source_text: Tumpukan kayu dapat roboh atau bergeser bila permukaan tidak rata, penyangga tidak sejajar, atau tinggi berlebihan. Batas tumpukan dan cara pengikatan mengikuti instruksi tempat kerja. Pekerja menjaga tangan dan kaki dari titik jepit serta tidak memanjat tumpukan; pemindahan memakai alat yang sesuai dan operator yang berwenang.
english_text: Wood stacks can collapse or shift if the surface is uneven, supports are misaligned, or the stack is too high. Stack limits and strapping methods follow workplace instructions. Keep hands and feet away from pinch points and never climb a stack; use suitable equipment operated by authorized personnel for transfers.

source_text:
Periksa lantai, penyangga, label, dan arah susunan sebelum menambah kayu. Jika bundel miring, tali rusak, atau kayu bergeser, jauhkan orang dan laporkan. Jangan mencoba menahan bundel berat dengan tubuh atau mengatur ulang tumpukan sambil alat bergerak.

Kasus latihan: Tumpukan papan mulai miring setelah satu penyangga bergeser, sementara pekerja hendak menaruh papan baru di atasnya.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Hentikan penambahan, jauhkan orang dari arah roboh, dan minta operator atau pemimpin menstabilkan tumpukan dengan prosedur yang sesuai.
english_text:
Check the floor, supports, labels, and stacking direction before adding wood. If a bundle leans, a strap is damaged, or wood shifts, keep people away and report it. Do not try to hold a heavy bundle with your body or rearrange a stack while equipment is moving.

Practice case: A stack of boards starts leaning after one support shifts, while a worker is about to place another board on top.
Recommended response: Stop adding boards, keep people clear of the fall path, and ask the operator or lead to stabilize the stack using the proper procedure.

source_text: Produk kayu disusun dan diikat sesuai ukuran pesanan, metode angkut, dan aturan fasilitas. Label tujuan harus tetap terbaca setelah kemasan selesai. Pemeriksaan jumlah dan kondisi ikatan mencegah salah kirim atau kayu jatuh selama pemindahan; kayu dengan identitas tidak cocok perlu ditahan sebelum dimuat.
english_text: Stack and strap wood products according to order dimensions, transport method, and facility rules. Keep destination labels readable after packaging. Checking the quantity and straps helps prevent shipping errors and falling wood during transfer; hold wood with mismatched identity before loading.

source_text:
Gunakan daftar pesanan, cocokkan jumlah dan nomor bundel, periksa ikatan serta pelindung tepi, lalu tempatkan di jalur pengiriman yang benar. Jangan memindahkan produk ke kendaraan sebelum tujuan dikonfirmasi. Bila satu bundel kurang atau label pelanggan tertukar, tahan di area pengiriman dan laporkan.

Kasus latihan: Satu bundel memiliki ukuran benar, tetapi labelnya menunjukkan pelanggan berbeda dari daftar muat.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Tahan bundel dan cocokkan nomor lot dengan pesanan serta catatan produksi sebelum pemuatan.
english_text:
Use the order list, check the quantity and bundle number, inspect the straps and edge protectors, and place the products in the correct dispatch lane. Do not move products to a vehicle until the destination is confirmed. If a bundle is short or customer labels are mixed up, hold it in the dispatch area and report the issue.

Practice case: A bundle has the correct dimensions, but its label shows a different customer from the loading list.
Recommended response: Hold the bundle and match its lot number to the order and production records before loading.

english_text: Clean the area within your duties, report worn equipment or leaks, and hand over machine and lot status.

source_text: Serbuk kayu, potongan sisa, dan debu perlu ditangani sesuai jadwal dan cara yang ditetapkan untuk menjaga jalur serta peralatan. Pembersihan mesin dilakukan hanya dalam kondisi dan wewenang yang sesuai, mengikuti prosedur isolasi bila diperlukan. Laporan giliran mencatat mesin yang perlu perhatian, bahan tertahan, dan tugas yang belum selesai.
english_text: Handle sawdust, offcuts, and dust according to the designated schedule and method to keep routes and equipment clear. Clean machinery only under the required conditions and within your authority, following isolation procedures when needed. Shift reports record machines needing attention, held materials, and unfinished tasks.

source_text:
Gunakan alat pembersih yang ditetapkan dan jangan meniup serbuk dengan cara yang menyebarkannya ke area kerja. Bila pelindung, mata potong, atau kabel tampak rusak, pasang tanda sesuai aturan dan beri tahu pemimpin. Sebelum pulang, serahkan status serta lokasi masalah dengan nomor mesin dan lot.

Kasus latihan: Pada akhir giliran, pekerja melihat kebocoran kecil dekat mesin dan belum tahu apakah lini harus dihentikan.
Respons yang dianjurkan: Jaga jarak dari area berisiko, ikuti prosedur penghentian atau tanda fasilitas, dan segera beri tahu pemimpin sebelum serah terima.
english_text:
Use designated cleaning tools and do not blow sawdust in a way that spreads it across the work area. If a guard, blade, or cable appears damaged, post a sign as required and notify the lead. Before leaving, hand over the status and location of the issue with the machine and lot numbers.

Practice case: At the end of the shift, a worker notices a small leak near a machine and is unsure whether the line must be stopped.
Recommended response: Keep clear of the risk area, follow the shutdown procedure or facility signage, and notify the lead promptly before handover.
